11.0.m: there practitioners frequently attain supreme perfection. (18)
In the Kali age, it should never be recited before those of defiled minds,
especially the māhātmya of the Lord of Praṇava before atheists. (19)

11.0.s: ye niṃdaṃti mahādevaṃ kṣetraṃ niṃdaṃti ye'dhiyaḥ ..
11.0.d: ये निंदंति महादेवं क्षेत्रं निंदंति येऽधियः ..
11.0.m: Those fools who revile Mahādeva, who revile the sacred field,

11.0.s: purāṇaṃ ye ca niṃdaṃti te saṃbhāṣyā na kutracit .. 4.2.74.120 ..
11.0.m: and who revile the Purāṇa—one should never converse with them anywhere. (4.2.74.120)
There is no liṅga equal to Oṃkāra anywhere on the surface of the earth:
thus was it decidedly proclaimed to Gaurī by the God of gods. (121)
A man who hears this chapter with his mind fixed upon it,
freed from all sins, reaches the world of Śiva. (122)

11.0.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthekāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdha oṃkāramāhātmyaṃ nāma catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 74 .. .. cha ..
11.0.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां चतुर्थेकाशीखंड उत्तरार्ध ओंकारमाहात्म्यं नाम चतुःसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः .. 74 .. .. छ ..
11.0.m: Thus ends the seventy-fourth chapter, named 'The Greatness of Oṃkāra,' in the latter half of the Kāśīkhaṇḍa, in the fourth [part] of the glorious Skandamahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. (74)

12.0.s:
.. .. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ..
āścaryaṃ sūtaputraitadyattvayā parikīrtitam ..
yatsthāpitāni liṃgāni rākṣasairapi vānaraiḥ .. 1 ..
12.0.d:
.. .. ऋषय ऊचुः ..
आश्चर्यं सूतपुत्रैतद्यत्त्वया परिकीर्तितम् ..
यत्स्थापितानि लिंगानि राक्षसैरपि वानरैः .. 1 ..
12.0.m: The seers said: / This is wonderful, O son of Sūta, which has been proclaimed by you: / That liṅgas were established even by rākṣasas and monkeys!

12.0.s:
tasmādvistarato brūhi yatrayatra yathāyathā ..
taiḥ sthāpitāni liṃgāni yeṣu sthāneṣu sūtaja .. 2 ..
12.0.d:
तस्माद्विस्तरतो ब्रूहि यत्रयत्र यथायथा ..
तैः स्थापितानि लिंगानि येषु स्थानेषु सूतज .. 2 ..
12.0.m: Therefore, tell in detail wherever and in whatever manner / Liṅgas were established by them, and in which places, O son of Sūta.

12.0.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..'
sugrīvaḥ saṃbhramitvātha kṣetraṃ sarvamaśeṣataḥ ..
bālamaṃḍanakaṃ prāpya tatra snātvā samāhitaḥ .. 3 .
12.0.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..'
सुग्रीवः संभ्रमित्वाथ क्षेत्रं सर्वमशेषतः ..
बालमंडनकं प्राप्य तत्र स्नात्वा समाहितः .. 3 .
12.0.m: Sūta said: / Then Sugrīva, having wandered completely over the entire sacred field, / Reached Bālamaṇḍanaka and bathed there with a concentrated mind.

12.0.s:
mukhaliṃgaṃ tatastatra sthāpayāmāsa śūlinaḥ ...
tathānyairvānaraiḥ sarvaimukhaliṃgāni śūlinaḥ ..
svasaṃjñārthaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ sthāpitāni yathecchayā .. 4 ..
12.0.d:
मुखलिंगं ततस्तत्र स्थापयामास शूलिनः ...
तथान्यैर्वानरैः सर्वैमुखलिंगानि शूलिनः ..
स्वसंज्ञार्थं द्विजश्रेष्ठाः स्थापितानि यथेच्छया .. 4 ..
12.0.m: Then he established there a mukhaliṅga of the Bearer of the Trident. / Likewise, mukhaliṅgas of the Bearer of the Trident were established at will / By all the other monkeys, O best of twice-born ones, for the sake of their own names.

12.0.s:
yasteṣāṃ mukhaliṃgānāṃ karoti ghṛtakaṃbalam...
makarasthena sūryeṇa śivalokaṃ sa gacchati .. 5 ..
12.0.d:
यस्तेषां मुखलिंगानां करोति घृतकंबलम्...
मकरस्थेन सूर्येण शिवलोकं स गच्छति .. 5 ..
12.0.m: Whoever covers those mukhaliṅgas with a blanket of clarified butter / While the sun is in the sign of Makara, goes to the world of Śiva.

12.0.s:
tataḥ paścimadigbhāge tasya kṣetrasya rākṣasaiḥ ..
saṃsthāpitāni liṅgāni caturvaktrāṇi ca dvijāḥ .._ .. 6 ..
12.0.d:
ततः पश्चिमदिग्भागे तस्य क्षेत्रस्य राक्षसैः ..
संस्थापितानि लिङ्गानि चतुर्वक्त्राणि च द्विजाः .._ .. 6 ..
12.0.m: Then, in the western direction of that sacred field, four-faced liṅgas / Were established by the rākṣasas, O twice-born ones.

12.0.s:
rāmeṇa pūrvadigbhāge prāsādānāṃ ca paṃcakam ..
sthāpitaṃ bhaktiyuktena sarvapātakanāśanam .. 7 ..
12.0.d:
रामेण पूर्वदिग्भागे प्रासादानां च पंचकम् ..
स्थापितं भक्तियुक्तेन सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 7 ..
12.0.m: In the eastern direction, a group of five temples / Was established by Rāma, endowed with devotion, destroying all sins.

12.0.s:
tathādakṣiṇadigbhāge kūpikā tena nirmitā...
ānarttīyataḍāgasya samīpe pāpanāśanī .. 8 ..
12.0.d:
तथादक्षिणदिग्भागे कूपिका तेन निर्मिता...
आनर्त्तीयतडागस्य समीपे पापनाशनी .. 8 ..
12.0.m: Likewise, in the southern direction, a small well was constructed by him / Near the Ānarttīya tank, destroying sins.

12.0.s:
yastasyāṃ kurute śrāddhaṃ saṃprāpte dakṣiṇāyane ..
so'śvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya pitṛloke mahīyate .. 9 ...
12.0.d:
यस्तस्यां कुरुते श्राद्धं संप्राप्ते दक्षिणायने ..
सोऽश्वमेधफलं प्राप्य पितृलोके महीयते .. 9 ...
12.0.m: Whoever performs a śrāddha in it when the southern solstice has arrived, / Having attained the fruit of a horse sacrifice, is honoured in the world of the ancestors.

12.0.s:
yastatra dīpakaṃ dadyātkārtike māsi ca dvijāḥ ..
na sa paśyati raudrāṃstānnarakānekaviṃśatim ..
na cāṃdho jāyate kvāpi yatrayatra prajāyate .. 6.103.10 .... ..
12.0.d:
यस्तत्र दीपकं दद्यात्कार्तिके मासि च द्विजाः ..
न स पश्यति रौद्रांस्तान्नरकानेकविंशतिम् ..
न चांधो जायते क्वापि यत्रयत्र प्रजायते .. 6.103.10 .... ..
12.0.m: Whoever offers a lamp there in the month of Kārtika, O twice-born ones, / Does not see those twenty-one dreadful hells, / Nor is he ever born blind, wherever he may be born.

12.0.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
ānarttīyataḍāgaṃ tatkena tatra vinirmitam ..
kiṃprabhāvaṃ ca kārtsnyena sūtaputra prakīrtaya .. 11 ..
12.0.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
आनर्त्तीयतडागं तत्केन तत्र विनिर्मितम् ..
किंप्रभावं च कार्त्स्न्येन सूतपुत्र प्रकीर्तय .. 11 ..
12.0.m: The seers said: / By whom was that Ānarttīya tank constructed there? / Proclaim in full, O son of Sūta, what its power is.

12.0.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ...
ānarttīyataḍāgasya mahimā dvijasattamāḥ ..
ekavaktreṇa no śakyo vaktuṃ varṣaśatairapi .. 12 ..
12.0.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ...
आनर्त्तीयतडागस्य महिमा द्विजसत्तमाः ..
एकवक्त्रेण नो शक्यो वक्तुं वर्षशतैरपि .. 12 ..
12.0.m: Sūta said: / The greatness of the Ānarttīya tank, O best of twice-born ones, / Cannot be told with a single mouth even in a hundred years.

12.0.s:
āśvinasya site pakṣe caturdaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ ..
snātvā devānpitṝṃścaiva tarpayedvidhipūrvakam .. 13 ..
12.0.d:
आश्विनस्य सिते पक्षे चतुर्दश्यां समाहितः ..
स्नात्वा देवान्पितॄंश्चैव तर्पयेद्विधिपूर्वकम् .. 13 ..
12.0.m: On the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight of Āśvina, collected in mind, / having bathed, one should offer water to the gods and ancestors according to the ritual rules.

12.0.s:
tato dīpotsavadine śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā samāhitaḥ ..
dāmodaraṃ yamaṃ pūjya dīpaṃ dadyātsvabhaktitaḥ .. .. 14 ..
12.0.d:
ततो दीपोत्सवदिने श्राद्धं कृत्वा समाहितः ..
दामोदरं यमं पूज्य दीपं दद्यात्स्वभक्तितः .. .. 14 ..
12.0.m: Then, on the day of the Festival of Lights, having performed a śrāddha with mind collected, / having worshipped Dāmodara and Yama, one should offer a lamp out of one's own devotion.

12.0.s:
saṃpūjyo dharmarājastu gandhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ ..
māṣāstilāśca dātavyā goviṃdaḥ prīyatāmiti .. 15 ..
12.0.d:
संपूज्यो धर्मराजस्तु गन्धपुष्पानुलेपनैः ..
माषास्तिलाश्च दातव्या गोविंदः प्रीयतामिति .. 15 ..
12.0.m: Dharmarāja should be worshipped with fragrant perfumes and unguents, / and black gram and sesame seeds must be given, saying, 'May Govinda be pleased!'

12.0.s:
tilamāṣapradānena dvijānāṃ tarpaṇena ca ..
yamena sahito devaḥ prīyate puruṣottamaḥ .. 16 ..
12.0.d:
तिलमाषप्रदानेन द्विजानां तर्पणेन च ..
यमेन सहितो देवः प्रीयते पुरुषोत्तमः .. 16 ..
12.0.m: By giving sesame seeds and black gram, and by satiating the twice-born with water offerings, / Lord Puruṣottama is pleased, together with Yama.

12.0.s:
ya evaṃ kurute viprāstīrtha ānarta saṃjñite ..
so'śvamedhaphalaṃ prāpyabrahmaloke mahīyate .. 17 ...
12.0.d:
य एवं कुरुते विप्रास्तीर्थ आनर्त संज्ञिते ..
सोऽश्वमेधफलं प्राप्यब्रह्मलोके महीयते .. 17 ...
12.0.m: Whoever acts thus, O brahmins, at the sacred ford named Ānarta, / obtains the fruit of an aśvamedha and is honored in the world of Brahmā.

12.0.s:
yasmindine samāyāto rāmastatra praharṣitaḥ ..
tasmindvijottamaiḥ sarvaiḥ proktaḥ so'bhyetya sādaram .. 18 ..
12.0.d:
यस्मिन्दिने समायातो रामस्तत्र प्रहर्षितः ..
तस्मिन्द्विजोत्तमैः सर्वैः प्रोक्तः सोऽभ्येत्य सादरम् .. 18 ..
12.0.m: On the day when Rāma arrived there filled with joy, / on that day, all the best twice-born approached him with respect and said:

12.0.s:
atrāgastyo muniśreṣṭhastiṣṭhate raghunaṃdana ..
taṃ gatvā paśya viprendra mitrāvaruṇasaṃbhavam .. 19 ..
12.0.d:
अत्रागस्त्यो मुनिश्रेष्ठस्तिष्ठते रघुनंदन ..
तं गत्वा पश्य विप्रेन्द्र मित्रावरुणसंभवम् .. 19 ..
12.0.m: 'Here stays Agastya, the best of sages, O joy of the Raghus! / Go and see that foremost twice-born who was born from Mitra and Varuṇa.'

12.0.s:
atha teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ ..
vānarai rākṣasaiḥ sārdhaṃ prahṛṣṭaḥ satvaraṃ yayau .. 6.103.20
aṣṭāṃgapraṇipātena taṃ praṇamya raghūttamaḥ ..
pariṣyakto dṛḍhaṃ tena sānandena mahātmanā .. 21 ..
12.0.d:
अथ तेषां वचः श्रुत्वा रामो राजीवलोचनः ..
वानरै राक्षसैः सार्धं प्रहृष्टः सत्वरं ययौ .. 6.103.20
अष्टांगप्रणिपातेन तं प्रणम्य रघूत्तमः ..
परिष्यक्तो दृढं तेन सानन्देन महात्मना .. 21 ..
12.0.m: Then, having heard their words, lotus-eyed Rāma / went quickly, overjoyed, along with the monkeys and rākṣasas. / Having bowed to him with prostration of the eight limbs, the best of the Raghus / was firmly embraced by that magnanimous sage with delight.

12.0.s:
nātidūre tatastasya vinayena samanvitaḥ ..
upaviṣṭo dharāpṛṣṭhe kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ .. 22 ..
12.0.d:
नातिदूरे ततस्तस्य विनयेन समन्वितः ..
उपविष्टो धरापृष्ठे कृतांजलिपुटः स्थितः .. 22 ..
12.0.m: Then, not far from him, endowed with modesty, / he sat down on the surface of the earth, remaining with folded hands.

12.0.s:
tataḥ pṛṣṭastu muninā kathayāmāsa vistarāt ..
vṛttāṃtaṃ sarvamātmīyaṃ svargasya gamanaṃ prati .. 23 ..
12.0.d:
ततः पृष्टस्तु मुनिना कथयामास विस्तरात् ..
वृत्तांतं सर्वमात्मीयं स्वर्गस्य गमनं प्रति .. 23 ..
12.0.m: Then, questioned by the sage, he related at length / his whole personal story concerning his departure to heaven:

12.0.s:
yathā sītā parityaktā yathā saumitriṇā kṛtaḥ ..
parityāgaḥ svakīyasya saṃtyaktena mahātmanā .. .. 24 ..
12.0.d:
यथा सीता परित्यक्ता यथा सौमित्रिणा कृतः ..
परित्यागः स्वकीयस्य संत्यक्तेन महात्मना .. .. 24 ..
12.0.m: how Sītā had been abandoned, how the abandonment of his own self / was made by the son of Sumitrā when abandoned by the magnanimous one;

12.0.s:
tathā sugrīvamāsādya tathaiva ca vibhīṣaṇam ..
saṃbhāṣya cāgamastvatra tataḥ puṣpakasaṃsthitiḥ ..25 ..
12.0.d:
तथा सुग्रीवमासाद्य तथैव च विभीषणम् ..
संभाष्य चागमस्त्वत्र ततः पुष्पकसंस्थितिः ..25 ..
12.0.m: likewise, having approached Sugrīva, and in the same way having spoken with Vibhīṣaṇa, / his arrival here, and then the waiting of the Puṣpaka chariot.

12.0.s:
tato'gastyaḥ kathāścitrāścakre tasya purastadā ..
rājarṣīṇāṃ purāṇānāṃ dṛṣṭāṃtairbahubhirmuniḥ .. 26 ..
12.0.d:
ततोऽगस्त्यः कथाश्चित्राश्चक्रे तस्य पुरस्तदा ..
राजर्षीणां पुराणानां दृष्टांतैर्बहुभिर्मुनिः .. 26 ..
12.0.m: Then Agastya told wonderful tales before him, / the sage [illustrating them] with many examples of royal seers of old.

12.0.s:
tataḥ kathāvasāne ca calacittaṃ raghūttamam ..
vilokya pradadau tasmai ratnābharaṇamuttamam .. 27 ..
12.0.d:
ततः कथावसाने च चलचित्तं रघूत्तमम् ..
विलोक्य प्रददौ तस्मै रत्नाभरणमुत्तमम् .. 27 ..
12.0.m: Then, at the end of the narrative, seeing that the mind of the best of the Raghus was unsettled, / he gave him an excellent ornament of jewels,

12.0.s:
yanna deveṣu yakṣeṣu siddhavidyādhareṣu ca ..
nāgeṣu rākṣasendreṣu mānuṣeṣu ca kā kathā .. 28 ..
12.0.d:
यन्न देवेषु यक्षेषु सिद्धविद्याधरेषु च ..
नागेषु राक्षसेन्द्रेषु मानुषेषु च का कथा .. 28 ..
12.0.m: such as was not found among the gods, yakṣas, siddhas, or vidyādharas, / nor among the nāgas or lords of rākṣasas—what to say of human beings?—

12.0.s:
yasyendrāyudhasaṃghāśca niṣkrāmaṃti sahasraśaḥ ..
rātrau tamisrapakṣe'pi lakṣyate'rkopamatviṣaḥ .. 29 ..
12.0.d:
यस्येन्द्रायुधसंघाश्च निष्क्रामंति सहस्रशः ..
रात्रौ तमिस्रपक्षेऽपि लक्ष्यतेऽर्कोपमत्विषः .. 29 ..
12.0.m: from which thousands of clusters of rainbows emanate, / and even at night in the dark fortnight it is seen having a splendor like the sun.

12.0.s:
tadrāmastu gṛhītvā'tha vismayotphullalocanaḥ ..
papraccha kautukāviṣṭaḥ kutastvetanmune tava .. .. 6.103.30 ..
12.0.d:
तद्रामस्तु गृहीत्वाऽथ विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनः ..
पप्रच्छ कौतुकाविष्टः कुतस्त्वेतन्मुने तव .. .. 6.103.30 ..
12.0.m: Then Rāma, having received it, his eyes opened wide with astonishment, / overcome with curiosity, asked: 'Whence do you have this, O sage?

12.0.s:
atyadbhutakaraṃ ratnairnirmitaṃ timirāpaham ..
kaṇṭhābharaṇamākhyāhi nedamasti jagattraye .. 31 ..
12.0.d:
अत्यद्भुतकरं रत्नैर्निर्मितं तिमिरापहम् ..
कण्ठाभरणमाख्याहि नेदमस्ति जगत्त्रये .. 31 ..
12.0.m: Explain [the origin of] this necklace made of jewels, highly wondrous, dispelling darkness; / such a thing does not exist in the three worlds.'

12.0.s:
.. agastiruvāca .. ..
yatpaśyasi raghuśreṣṭha taḍāgamidamuttamam ..
mamāśramasamīpasthaṃ taddevadevanirmitam .. 32 ..
12.0.d:
.. अगस्तिरुवाच .. ..
यत्पश्यसि रघुश्रेष्ठ तडागमिदमुत्तमम् ..
ममाश्रमसमीपस्थं तद्देवदेवनिर्मितम् .. 32 ..
12.0.m: Agastya said: / 'This excellent pond which you see, O best of the Raghus, / located near my hermitage, was made by the god of gods.

12.0.s:
tasya tīre mayā dṛṣṭaṃ yadāścaryamanuttamam ..
tatte'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva raghu nandana .. 33 ..
12.0.d:
तस्य तीरे मया दृष्टं यदाश्चर्यमनुत्तमम् ..
तत्तेऽहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्व रघु नन्दन .. 33 ..
12.0.m: The unexcelled marvel which was seen by me on its bank, / that I shall relate to you; listen, O joy of the Raghus!

12.0.s:
kadācidrāghavaśreṣṭha niśīthe'haṃ samutthitaḥ ..
paśyāmi vyomamārgeṇa pradyotaṃ bhāskaropamam .. 34 ..
12.0.d:
कदाचिद्राघवश्रेष्ठ निशीथेऽहं समुत्थितः ..
पश्यामि व्योममार्गेण प्रद्योतं भास्करोपमम् .. 34 ..
12.0.m: Once, O best of the Rāghavas, having risen at midnight, / I saw a radiance like the sun [traveling] along the path of the sky.

12.0.s:
yāvattāvadvimānaṃ tadapsarogaṇarājitam ..
tasya madhyagataścaikaḥ puruṣastaruṇastathā ..
andhastatra samārūḍhaḥ stūyate kinnarairnṛpaḥ .. 35 ..
12.0.d:
यावत्तावद्विमानं तदप्सरोगणराजितम् ..
तस्य मध्यगतश्चैकः पुरुषस्तरुणस्तथा ..
अन्धस्तत्र समारूढः स्तूयते किन्नरैर्नृपः .. 35 ..
12.0.m: In a moment, it was an aerial chariot shining with a host of apsarases, / and within it a certain young man, / a king mounted there, blind, praised by kinnaras.

12.0.s:
ratnābharaṇametacca bibhratkaṇṭhe sunirmalam ..
dvādaśārkapratīkāśaṃ kāmadeva ivāparaḥ .. 36 ..
12.0.d:
रत्नाभरणमेतच्च बिभ्रत्कण्ठे सुनिर्मलम् ..
द्वादशार्कप्रतीकाशं कामदेव इवापरः .. 36 ..
12.0.m: Wearing this very ornament of jewels, extremely bright, on his neck, / resembling twelve suns, he was like a second Kāmadeva.

12.0.s:
athottīrya vimānāgryātskaṃdhalagno raghūdvaha ..
ekasya devadūtasya salilāṃtamupāgataḥ .. 37 ..
12.0.d:
अथोत्तीर्य विमानाग्र्यात्स्कंधलग्नो रघूद्वह ..
एकस्य देवदूतस्य सलिलांतमुपागतः .. 37 ..
12.0.m: Then, having descended from the foremost aerial chariot while holding the shoulder / of a messenger of the gods, O bearer of the Raghu lineage, he approached the edge of the water.

12.0.s:
tataśca salilāttasmādākṛṣya ca kalevaram ..
mṛtakasya tato daṃtairbhakṣayāmāsa satvaram .. 38 ..
12.0.d:
ततश्च सलिलात्तस्मादाकृष्य च कलेवरम् ..
मृतकस्य ततो दंतैर्भक्षयामास सत्वरम् .. 38 ..
12.0.m: And then, having dragged out a corpse from that water, / he quickly devoured the body of the dead man with his teeth.

12.0.s:
yathāyathā mahāmāṃsaṃ sa bhakṣayati rāghava ..
tathātathā punaḥ kāyaṃ tadrūpaṃ tatprajāyate .. 39 ..
12.0.d:
यथायथा महामांसं स भक्षयति राघव ..
तथातथा पुनः कायं तद्रूपं तत्प्रजायते .. 39 ..
12.0.m: Just as he devoured that human flesh, O Rāghava, / so did the body immediately regenerate in that same form.

12.0.s:
tatastṛptiṃ cirātprāpya śucirbhūtvā praharṣitaḥ ..
niṣkamya salilādyāvadvimānamadhirohati .. 6.103.40 ..
12.0.d:
ततस्तृप्तिं चिरात्प्राप्य शुचिर्भूत्वा प्रहर्षितः ..
निष्कम्य सलिलाद्यावद्विमानमधिरोहति .. 6.103.40 ..
12.0.m: Then, having at last found satisfaction, having become pure and overjoyed, / emerging from the water, as he was mounting the aerial chariot,

12.0.s:
tāvanmayā drutaṃ gatvā sa pṛṣṭaḥ kautukānnṛpaḥ ..
sevyamāno'pi gandharvaiḥ samaṃtādbuddhitatparaiḥ .. 41 ..
12.0.d:
तावन्मया द्रुतं गत्वा स पृष्टः कौतुकान्नृपः ..
सेव्यमानोऽपि गन्धर्वैः समंताद्बुद्धितत्परैः .. 41 ..
12.0.m: just then, having gone swiftly, that king was questioned by me out of curiosity, / even as he was being attended on all sides by gandharvas intent on wisdom:

12.0.s:
bhobho vaimānikaśreṣṭha muhūrtaṃ pratipālaya ..
agastirnāma vipro'haṃ mitrāvaruṇasaṃbhavaḥ .. 42 .
12.0.d:
भोभो वैमानिकश्रेष्ठ मुहूर्तं प्रतिपालय ..
अगस्तिर्नाम विप्रोऽहं मित्रावरुणसंभवः .. 42 .
12.0.m: 'O foremost passenger of the aerial chariot, wait a moment! / I am a twice-born named Agastya, born from Mitra and Varuṇa.'

12.0.s:
tacchrutvā sammukho bhūtvā praṇāmamakarottataḥ ..
taiśca vaimānikaiḥ sārdhaṃ sarvaistaiḥ kinnarādibhiḥ .. 43 ..
12.0.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा सम्मुखो भूत्वा प्रणाममकरोत्ततः ..
तैश्च वैमानिकैः सार्धं सर्वैस्तैः किन्नरादिभिः .. 43 ..
12.0.m: Hearing that, he turned toward me and made obeisance, / together with all those occupants of aerial chariots, kinnaras, and others.

12.0.s:
so'yaṃ rājā mayā pṛṣṭaḥ kṛtānatiḥ puraḥ sthitaḥ ..
kastvamīdṛgvapuḥ śrīmānvimānavaramāśritaḥ ..
sevyamāno'psarobhiśca gandharvaiḥ kinnaraistathā .. .. 44 ..
12.0.d:
सोऽयं राजा मया पृष्टः कृतानतिः पुरः स्थितः ..
कस्त्वमीदृग्वपुः श्रीमान्विमानवरमाश्रितः ..
सेव्यमानोऽप्सरोभिश्च गन्धर्वैः किन्नरैस्तथा .. .. 44 ..
12.0.m: That king, having bowed and standing before me, was asked by me: / 'Who are you, possessed of such a splendid form, seated in an excellent aerial chariot, / attended by apsarases, gandharvas, and kinnaras?

12.0.s:
atrā''gatya taḍāgāṃte mahāmāṃsaprabhakṣaṇam ..
kṛtavānasi vaikalyaṃ kasmātte dṛṣṭisaṃbhavam .. 45 ..
12.0.d:
अत्रा'ऽगत्य तडागांते महामांसप्रभक्षणम् ..
कृतवानसि वैकल्यं कस्मात्ते दृष्टिसंभवम् .. 45 ..
12.0.m: Having come here to the edge of the pond, you have eaten human flesh; / why do you have this deficiency born of your sight?'

12.0.s:
.. vaimānika uvāca .. ..
sādhu sādhu muniśreṣṭha yattvaṃ prāpto mamāntikam ..
avaśyaṃ sānukūlo me vidhiryattvaṃ samāgataḥ .. 46 ..
12.0.d:
.. वैमानिक उवाच .. ..
साधु साधु मुनिश्रेष्ठ यत्त्वं प्राप्तो ममान्तिकम् ..
अवश्यं सानुकूलो मे विधिर्यत्त्वं समागतः .. 46 ..
12.0.m: The passenger of the aerial chariot said: / 'Well done, well done, O best of sages, that you have come into my presence! / Destiny is surely favorable to me, since you have arrived.

12.0.s:
sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthabhūtā hi sādhavaḥ ..
kālena phalate tīrthaṃ sadyaḥ sādhusamāgamaḥ .. 47 ..
12.0.d:
साधूनां दर्शनं पुण्यं तीर्थभूता हि साधवः ..
कालेन फलते तीर्थं सद्यः साधुसमागमः .. 47 ..
12.0.m: The darśana of good people is holy, for the virtuous are sacred fords personified; / a sacred ford yields its fruit in time, but the meeting with a virtuous person bears fruit instantly.

12.0.s:
tasmātsarvaṃ tavākhyānaṃ kathayāmi mahāmune .
yena me garhitaṃ bhojyaṃ vibhavaśca tathedṛśaḥ .. 48 ..
12.0.d:
तस्मात्सर्वं तवाख्यानं कथयामि महामुने .
येन मे गर्हितं भोज्यं विभवश्च तथेदृशः .. 48 ..
12.0.m: Therefore, I shall tell you my whole story, O great sage, / because of which I have this despicable food, and also such opulence.

12.0.s:
ahamāsaṃ purā rājā śvetonāma mahāmune ..
ānartādhipatiḥ pāpaḥ sarvalokanipīḍakaḥ .. 49 ..
12.0.d:
अहमासं पुरा राजा श्वेतोनाम महामुने ..
आनर्ताधिपतिः पापः सर्वलोकनिपीडकः .. 49 ..
12.0.m: Formerly, I was a king named Śveta, O great sage, / the ruler of Ānarta, sinful, an oppressor of all people.

12.0.s:
na kiṃcitprāṅmayā dattaṃ na hutaṃ jātavedasi ..
na ca rakṣā kṛtā loke na trātāḥ śaraṇāgatāḥ .. 6.103.50 ..
12.0.d:
न किंचित्प्राङ्मया दत्तं न हुतं जातवेदसि ..
न च रक्षा कृता लोके न त्राताः शरणागताः .. 6.103.50 ..
12.0.m: Formerly, nothing was given away by me, nor was an oblation cast into the fire, / nor was protection given to the world, nor were those who came for refuge saved.

12.0.s:
dṛṣṭvādṛṣṭvā mayā ratnaṃ yatkiṃciddharaṇītale .. .
tadvai balāddhṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sarveṣāmiha dehinām .. 51 ..
12.0.d:
दृष्ट्वादृष्ट्वा मया रत्नं यत्किंचिद्धरणीतले .. .
तद्वै बलाद्धृतं सर्वं सर्वेषामिह देहिनाम् .. 51 ..
12.0.m: Whatever jewel I repeatedly saw upon the surface of the earth, / all that was forcibly seized by me from all embodied beings here.

12.0.s:
tataḥ kālena dīrgheṇa jarāgrastasya me balāt ..
hṛtaṃ rājyaṃ svaputreṇa māṃ nirvāsya vigarhitam .. .. 52 ..
12.0.d:
ततः कालेन दीर्घेण जराग्रस्तस्य मे बलात् ..
हृतं राज्यं स्वपुत्रेण मां निर्वास्य विगर्हितम् .. .. 52 ..
12.0.m: Then, after a long time, when I was seized by old age, / my kingdom was taken by force by my own son, who banished me in disgrace.

12.0.s:
tato'haṃ jarayā grasto vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ..
samāyāto'tra vipreṃdra bhramamāṇa itastataḥ .. 53 ..
12.0.d:
ततोऽहं जरया ग्रस्तो वैराग्यं परमं गतः..
समायातोऽत्र विप्रेंद्र भ्रममाण इतस्ततः .. 53 ..
12.0.m: Then, seized by old age, I attained supreme dispassion; / wandering here and there, O foremost of twice-born, I arrived here.

12.0.s:
tataḥ kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭho'haṃ snātvā'tra salile śubhe..
mṛtaśca saṃniviṣṭohaṃ kṣudhayā paripīḍitaḥ.. 54..
12.0.d:
ततः क्षुत्क्षामकण्ठोऽहं स्नात्वाऽत्र सलिले शुभे..
मृतश्च संनिविष्टोहं क्षुधया परिपीडितः.. 54..
12.0.m: Then, my throat parched with hunger, having bathed here in the auspicious water / and settled down, afflicted with hunger, I died.

12.0.s:
prāviśyā'tra jale puṇye paṃcatvaṃ samupāgataḥ ..
tataśca tatkṣaṇādeva vimānaṃ samupasthitam .. . .. 55 ..
12.0.d:
प्राविश्याऽत्र जले पुण्ये पंचत्वं समुपागतः ..
ततश्च तत्क्षणादेव विमानं समुपस्थितम् .. . .. 55 ..
12.0.m: Having entered this holy water, I met my death. / And then, that very instant, an aerial chariot appeared. . .. 55 ..

12.0.s:
māmanyena śarīreṇa samādāya ca kiṃkarāḥ ..
tatrāropya tataḥ prāptā brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ prati .. 56 ..
12.0.d:
मामन्येन शरीरेण समादाय च किंकराः ..
तत्रारोप्य ततः प्राप्ता ब्रह्मणः सदनं प्रति .. 56 ..
12.0.m: Attendants took me up in another body, / placed me upon it, and then reached the abode of Brahmā. .. 56 ..

12.0.s:
divyamālyāvaradharaṃdivyagandhānulepanam ..
divyābharaṇasaṃjuṣṭaṃ stūyamānaṃ ca kinnaraiḥ .. 57 ..
12.0.d:
दिव्यमाल्यावरधरंदिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम् ..
दिव्याभरणसंजुष्टं स्तूयमानं च किन्नरैः .. 57 ..
12.0.m: Wearing divine garlands and garments, anointed with divine fragrant pastes, / graced with divine ornaments, and praised by kinnaras, .. 57 ..

12.0.s:
tato brahmasabhāmadhye hyahaṃ tairdevakiṃkaraiḥ ..
tādṛgrūpo vicakṣuśca dhārito brahmaṇaḥ puraḥ .. 58 ..
12.0.d:
ततो ब्रह्मसभामध्ये ह्यहं तैर्देवकिंकरैः ..
तादृग्रूपो विचक्षुश्च धारितो ब्रह्मणः पुरः .. 58 ..
12.0.m: I was then brought into the midst of Brahmā's assembly by those divine attendants, / in such a form, sightless, and placed before Brahmā. .. 58 ..

12.0.s:
sarvaiḥ sabhāgatairdṛṣṭā vismitāsyaiḥ parasparam ..
anyaiśca nindamānaiśca dhikchabdasya prajalpakaiḥ .. 59 ..
12.0.d:
सर्वैः सभागतैर्दृष्टा विस्मितास्यैः परस्परम् ..
अन्यैश्च निन्दमानैश्च धिक्छब्दस्य प्रजल्पकैः .. 59 ..
12.0.m: Seen by all present in the assembly with astonished faces, looking at one another, / and by others reproaching [me] and muttering cries of 'Shame!' .. 59 ..

12.0.s:
.. kiṃkarā ūcuḥ .. ..
eṣa devaścaturvaktraḥ sabheyaṃ tasya sambhavā ..
sarvairdevagaṇairjuṣṭā praṇāmaḥ kriyatāmiti .. 6.103.60 ..
12.0.d:
.. किंकरा ऊचुः .. ..
एष देवश्चतुर्वक्त्रः सभेयं तस्य सम्भवा ..
सर्वैर्देवगणैर्जुष्टा प्रणामः क्रियतामिति .. 6.103.60 ..
12.0.m: The attendants said: / 'This is the four-faced god; this is his assembly, / attended by all the hosts of gods. Make your obeisance!' .. 6.103.60 ..

12.0.s:
tato'haṃ praṇipatyoccaistaṃ devaṃ devasaṃyutam ..
upaviṣṭaḥ sabhāmadhye vrīḍayā'vanataḥ sthitaḥ .. 61 ..
12.0.d:
ततोऽहं प्रणिपत्योच्चैस्तं देवं देवसंयुतम् ..
उपविष्टः सभामध्ये व्रीडयाऽवनतः स्थितः .. 61 ..
12.0.m: Then, having bowed low before that god accompanied by the gods, / I sat down in the midst of the assembly, remaining bowed with shame. .. 61 ..

12.0.s:
yathāyathā kathāstatra prajāyante sabhātale ..
devadvijanarendrāṇāṃ dharmākhyānāni kuṃbhaja .. 62 ..
12.0.d:
यथायथा कथास्तत्र प्रजायन्ते सभातले ..
देवद्विजनरेन्द्राणां धर्माख्यानानि कुंभज .. 62 ..
12.0.m: Just as stories arose there on the floor of the assembly— / tales of dharma concerning gods, twice-born, and kings, O pitcher-born [sage]— .. 62 ..

12.0.s:
tathātathā mamātīva kṣudvṛddhiṃ saṃpragacchati ..
jāne kiṃ bhakṣayāmyāśu dṛṣadaḥ kāṣṭhameva vā .. 63 ..
12.0.d:
तथातथा ममातीव क्षुद्वृद्धिं संप्रगच्छति ..
जाने किं भक्षयाम्याशु दृषदः काष्ठमेव वा .. 63 ..
12.0.m: even so did my hunger grow exceedingly. / I wondered, what could I eat at once—stones or even wood? .. 63 ..

12.0.s:
tato mayā praṇamyoccairvijñaptaḥ prapitāmahaḥ ..
prāṇipatya muniśreṣṭha lajjāṃ tyaktvā sudūrataḥ ..64..
12.0.d:
ततो मया प्रणम्योच्चैर्विज्ञप्तः प्रपितामहः ..
प्राणिपत्य मुनिश्रेष्ठ लज्जां त्यक्त्वा सुदूरतः ..64..
12.0.m: Then, having bowed low, I addressed the great-grandfather; / having prostrated myself, O best of sages, casting shame far away: .. 64 ..

12.0.s:
kṣudhā māṃ bādhate atīva sāṃprataṃ prapitāmaha ..
tathā paśyāmi no kiṃcittādṛgbhojyaṃ prayaccha me ..65..
12.0.d:
क्षुधा मां बाधते अतीव सांप्रतं प्रपितामह ..
तथा पश्यामि नो किंचित्तादृग्भोज्यं प्रयच्छ मे ..65..
12.0.m: 'Hunger torments me exceedingly right now, O great-grandfather! / Likewise, I see nothing; grant me food suited [to my state]! .. 65 ..

12.0.s:
kṣutpipāsādayo doṣā na vidyaṃte'tra te kila ..
svarge sthitasya yaccaitattatkimevaṃvidhaṃ mama..66..
12.0.d:
क्षुत्पिपासादयो दोषा न विद्यंतेऽत्र ते किल ..
स्वर्गे स्थितस्य यच्चैतत्तत्किमेवंविधं मम..66..
12.0.m: Faults such as hunger and thirst surely do not exist for you here; / since I dwell in heaven, why is it thus with me?' .. 66 ..

12.0.s:
.. pitāmaha uvāca .. ..
tvayā nānnaṃ kvaciddattaṃ kasyacitpṛthivītale .
tenātrāpi bubhukṣā te vṛddhiṃ gacchati durmate .. 67 ..
12.0.d:
.. पितामह उवाच .. ..
त्वया नान्नं क्वचिद्दत्तं कस्यचित्पृथिवीतले .
तेनात्रापि बुभुक्षा ते वृद्धिं गच्छति दुर्मते .. 67 ..
12.0.m: The grandfather said: / 'You never gave food to anyone anywhere on the earth. / Therefore, even here, your hunger increases, O evil-minded one! .. 67 ..

12.0.s:
tathā hṛtāni ratnāni yāni dṛṣṭigatāni te ..
cakṣurhīnastato jāto mama loke gato'pi ca .. 68 ..
12.0.d:
तथा हृतानि रत्नानि यानि दृष्टिगतानि ते ..
चक्षुर्हीनस्ततो जातो मम लोके गतोऽपि च .. 68 ..
12.0.m: Likewise, jewels that came into your sight were stolen [by you]; / therefore you have become sightless, even though you have gone to my realm. .. 68 ..

12.0.s:
yastvaṃ pātakayukto'pi saṃprāpto mama maṃdiram..
tadvakṣyāmyakhilaṃ te'haṃ śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ sthitaḥ.. 69 ..
12.0.d:
यस्त्वं पातकयुक्तोऽपि संप्राप्तो मम मंदिरम्..
तद्वक्ष्याम्यखिलं तेऽहं शृणुष्वैकमनाः स्थितः.. 69 ..
12.0.m: As to why you, though steeped in sins, have reached my abode— / that I shall tell you in full; listen, remaining attentive: .. 69 ..

12.0.s:
yasmiñjale tvayā muktāḥ prāṇāḥ pāpā tmanāpica ..
śvetadvīpapatistatra kalikālabhayāturaḥ .. 6.103.70 ..
12.0.d:
यस्मिञ्जले त्वया मुक्ताः प्राणाः पापा त्मनापिच ..
श्वेतद्वीपपतिस्तत्र कलिकालभयातुरः .. 6.103.70 ..
12.0.m: In the water where you, though a sinner, abandoned your life-breaths, / the lord of Śvetadvīpa [dwells], anxious from fear of the Kali age. .. 6.103.70 ..

12.0.s:
tato'sya sparśanātsadyo vimuktaḥ sarvapātakaiḥ ..
annādānātparā pīḍā jāyate kṣutsamu dbhavā ..71..
12.0.d:
ततोऽस्य स्पर्शनात्सद्यो विमुक्तः सर्वपातकैः ..
अन्नादानात्परा पीडा जायते क्षुत्समु द्भवा ..71..
12.0.m: Therefore, through touch of it, you were instantly freed from all sins. / [Yet] from not giving food arises this supreme torment caused by hunger, .. 71 ..

12.0.s:
tathā ratnāpahāreṇa sañjātā cāṃdhatā tava ..
naivānyatkāraṇaṃ kiṃcitsatyametanmayoditam ..72 ..
12.0.d:
तथा रत्नापहारेण सञ्जाता चांधता तव ..
नैवान्यत्कारणं किंचित्सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् ..72 ..
12.0.m: and through the theft of jewels your blindness was produced. / There is no other cause whatsoever; this which I have spoken is true.' .. 72 ..

12.0.s:
tato mayā vidhiḥ proktaḥ punareva dvijottama ..
eṣo'pi brahmalokaste narakādatiricyate ..
tasmāttatraiva māṃ deva preṣayasva kimatra vai .. 73 ..
12.0.d:
ततो मया विधिः प्रोक्तः पुनरेव द्विजोत्तम ..
एषोऽपि ब्रह्मलोकस्ते नरकादतिरिच्यते ..
तस्मात्तत्रैव मां देव प्रेषयस्व किमत्र वै .. 73 ..
12.0.m: Then the creator was addressed again by me, O best of the twice-born: / 'Even this Brahmaloka of yours is worse than hell! / Therefore send me right back there, O god! What [is the use of staying] here?' .. 73 ..

12.0.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
tasmāttatraiva gaccha tvaṃ preṣi to'si kimatra vai ..
narake tava vāso na śvetadvīpasamudbhavam ..74..
12.0.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
तस्मात्तत्रैव गच्छ त्वं प्रेषि तोऽसि किमत्र वै ..
नरके तव वासो न श्वेतद्वीपसमुद्भवम् ..74..
12.0.m: Brahmā said: / 'Therefore go right back there; you are sent! What [need is there to remain] here? / Your dwelling is not in hell, [lest] the power arising from Śvetadvīpa .. 74 ..

12.0.s:
māhātmyaṃ nāśamāyāti śāstraṃ syātsatyavarjitam ..
tasmāttvaṃ nityamārūḍho vimā ne traivasundare .. 75 ..
12.0.d:
माहात्म्यं नाशमायाति शास्त्रं स्यात्सत्यवर्जितम् ..
तस्मात्त्वं नित्यमारूढो विमा ने त्रैवसुन्दरे .. 75 ..
12.0.m: be destroyed, and scripture become void of truth. / Therefore, constantly mounted upon this beautiful aerial chariot, .. 75 ..

12.0.s:
gatvā jalāśaye tasminyatra prāṇāḥ samujjhitāḥ ..
tameva nijadehaṃ ca bhakṣayasva yathecchayā .. 76 ..
12.0.d:
गत्वा जलाशये तस्मिन्यत्र प्राणाः समुज्झिताः ..
तमेव निजदेहं च भक्षयस्व यथेच्छया .. 76 ..
12.0.m: having gone to that pool of water where you abandoned your life-breaths, / eat that very corpse of your own as you wish. .. 76 ..

12.0.s:
tadbhaviṣyati madvākyā dakṣayaṃ jalamadhyagam..
tāvatkālaṃ ca dṛṣṭiste bhojyakāle bhaviṣyati .. 77 ..
12.0.d:
तद्भविष्यति मद्वाक्या दक्षयं जलमध्यगम्..
तावत्कालं च दृष्टिस्ते भोज्यकाले भविष्यति .. 77 ..
12.0.m: By my word, that [body] lying in the water will become inexhaustible, / and for that long, at the time of eating, your sight will return.' .. 77 ..

12.0.s:
tato'haṃ tasya vākyena dīpotsavadine sadā ..
niśīthe'tra samā gatya bhakṣayāmi nijāṃ tanum .. 78 ..
12.0.d:
ततोऽहं तस्य वाक्येन दीपोत्सवदिने सदा ..
निशीथेऽत्र समा गत्य भक्षयामि निजां तनुम् .. 78 ..
12.0.m: Then, according to his word, constantly on the day of the Festival of Lights, / coming here at midnight, I eat my own body. .. 78 ..

12.0.s:
tatastṛptiṃ pragacchāmi yāvaddaivaṃ dinaṃ sthitam ..
mānuṣaṃ ca tathā varṣamīdṛgrūpo vyavasthitaḥ .. 79 ..
12.0.d:
ततस्तृप्तिं प्रगच्छामि यावद्दैवं दिनं स्थितम् ..
मानुषं च तथा वर्षमीदृग्रूपो व्यवस्थितः .. 79 ..
12.0.m: Then I attain satisfaction as long as a divine day lasts, / and likewise a human year, remaining in such a form. .. 79 ..

12.0.s:
nāstyasādhyaṃ muniśreṣṭha tava kiṃcijjagattraye ..
yenaikaṃ culukaṃ kṛtvā nipītaḥ payasāṃnidhiḥ .. 6.103.80 ..
12.0.d:
नास्त्यसाध्यं मुनिश्रेष्ठ तव किंचिज्जगत्त्रये ..
येनैकं चुलुकं कृत्वा निपीतः पयसांनिधिः .. 6.103.80 ..
12.0.m: There is nothing impossible for you in the three worlds, O best of sages, / by whom the ocean was drunk up, making of it a single sip! .. 6.103.80 ..

12.0.s:
tasmānmune dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari mahattarām ..
akṛtyā drakṣa māmasmātsarvalokavigarhitāt .. 81 ..
12.0.d:
तस्मान्मुने दयां कृत्वा ममोपरि महत्तराम् ..
अकृत्या द्रक्ष मामस्मात्सर्वलोकविगर्हितात् .. 81 ..
12.0.m: Therefore, O sage, having shown very great compassion upon me, / protect me from this improper act, condemned by all the world! .. 81 ..

12.0.s:
tathā dṛṣṭipradānaṃ me kuruṣva munisattama ..
nirviṇṇo'smyaṃdhabhāvena nānyā tvatto'sti me gatiḥ .. .. 82 ..
12.0.d:
तथा दृष्टिप्रदानं मे कुरुष्व मुनिसत्तम ..
निर्विण्णोऽस्म्यंधभावेन नान्या त्वत्तोऽस्ति मे गतिः .. .. 82 ..
12.0.m: Likewise, bestow sight upon me, O most excellent sage! / I am despondent on account of blindness; I have no other refuge than you!' .. 82 ..

12.0.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kṛpayā mama mānasam..
dravībhūtaṃ tadā vākyamavocaṃ taṃ raghūttama .. 83 ..
12.0.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा कृपया मम मानसम्..
द्रवीभूतं तदा वाक्यमवोचं तं रघूत्तम .. 83 ..
12.0.m: Hearing those words of his, my mind melted with pity; / then I spoke these words to him, O best of Raghu's line: .. 83 ..

12.0.s:
tvamannaniṣkrayaṃ dehi kaṇṭhasthamiha bhūṣaṇam ..
yena nāśaṃ prayātyeṣā bubhukṣā jaṭharodbhavā .. 84 ..
12.0.d:
त्वमन्ननिष्क्रयं देहि कण्ठस्थमिह भूषणम् ..
येन नाशं प्रयात्येषा बुभुक्षा जठरोद्भवा .. 84 ..
12.0.m: 'Give this ornament on your neck as the price of food, / so that this hunger born of the belly goes to destruction. .. 84 ..

12.0.s:
tathā'dyaprabhṛti prājña ratnadīpānsunirmalān ..
atraiva sarasastīre dehi dāmodarāya ca .. 85 ..
12.0.d:
तथाऽद्यप्रभृति प्राज्ञ रत्नदीपान्सुनिर्मलान् ..
अत्रैव सरसस्तीरे देहि दामोदराय च .. 85 ..
12.0.m: Likewise, from this day forth, O wise one, offer very pure jeweled lamps / to Dāmodara right here on the bank of the lake, .. 85 ..

12.0.s:
ddha?sa yena saṃjāyate dṛṣṭiḥ śāśvatī tava nirmalā ..
mama vākyādasaṃdigdhaṃ satyenātmānamālabhe .. 86 ..
12.0.d:
द्ध?स येन संजायते दृष्टिः शाश्वती तव निर्मला ..
मम वाक्यादसंदिग्धं सत्येनात्मानमालभे .. 86 ..
12.0.m: so that your clear, eternal sight may be produced. / By my word, beyond doubt, I swear upon myself in truth.' .. 86 ..

12.0.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
mamopari dayāṃ kṛtvā tvameva munisattama ..
gṛhāṇa ratnasaṃbhūtaṃ kaṇṭhābharaṇamuttamam .. 87 ..
12.0.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
ममोपरि दयां कृत्वा त्वमेव मुनिसत्तम ..
गृहाण रत्नसंभूतं कण्ठाभरणमुत्तमम् .. 87 ..
12.0.m: The king said: / 'Having taken pity upon me, you yourself, O most excellent sage, / take this excellent neck-ornament made of jewels!' .. 87 ..

12.0.s:
tato dayābhibhūtena mayā tasya pratigrahaḥ ..
niḥspṛheṇāpi saṃcīrṇo muninā raṇyavāsinā.
tataḥ prakṣālya me pādau yāvattenānnaniṣkraye.
vibhūṣaṇamidaṃ dattaṃ sadbhaktyā bhāvitātmane..
tatastasya praṇaṣṭā sā bubhukṣā tatkṣaṇānnṛpa ..
saṃjātā paramā tṛptirdevapīyūṣasaṃbhavā .. 6.103.90 ..
12.0.d:
ततो दयाभिभूतेन मया तस्य प्रतिग्रहः ..
निःस्पृहेणापि संचीर्णो मुनिना रण्यवासिना.
ततः प्रक्षाल्य मे पादौ यावत्तेनान्ननिष्क्रये.
विभूषणमिदं दत्तं सद्भक्त्या भावितात्मने..
ततस्तस्य प्रणष्टा सा बुभुक्षा तत्क्षणान्नृप ..
संजाता परमा तृप्तिर्देवपीयूषसंभवा .. 6.103.90 ..
12.0.m: Then, overcome with compassion, its acceptance / was undertaken by me, an ascetic living in the forest, though desireless. / Then, having washed my feet, as soon as he gave this ornament / as the price of food, with true devotion to me whose mind was purified, / then, O king, that hunger of his vanished in that very instant, / and supreme satisfaction arose, born of divine nectar. .. 6.103.90 ..

12.0.s:
tasya naṣṭaṃ mṛtaṃ kāyaṃ tacca jīrṇaṃ purodbhavam ..
yadāsīdakṣayaṃ nityaṃ tasmiṃstoye vyavasthitam .. 91 ..
12.0.d:
तस्य नष्टं मृतं कायं तच्च जीर्णं पुरोद्भवम् ..
यदासीदक्षयं नित्यं तस्मिंस्तोये व्यवस्थितम् .. 91 ..
12.0.m: His dead, decayed body of former times vanished, / which had remained inexhaustible and constant in that water. .. 91 ..

12.0.s:
tataḥ saṃsthāpitastena tasminsthāne subhaktitaḥ ..
dāmodaro raghuśreṣṭha kṛtvā prāsādamuttamam 92 ..
12.0.d:
ततः संस्थापितस्तेन तस्मिन्स्थाने सुभक्तितः ..
दामोदरो रघुश्रेष्ठ कृत्वा प्रासादमुत्तमम् 92 ..
12.0.m: Then, having built an excellent temple in that place, / Dāmodara was established [there] by him with great devotion, O best of the Raghus. .. 92 ..

12.0.s:
tasyāgre śraddhayā yukto dīpaṃ dayādyathāyathā ..
tathātathā bhaveddṛṣṭistasya nityaṃ sunirmalām .. 93 ..
12.0.d:
तस्याग्रे श्रद्धया युक्तो दीपं दयाद्यथायथा ..
तथातथा भवेद्दृष्टिस्तस्य नित्यं सुनिर्मलाम् .. 93 ..
12.0.m: As he offered a lamp before him with faith, / in just that measure his sight became constantly very pure. .. 93 ..

12.0.s:
tato māsātsamāsādya divyacakṣurmahīpatiḥ ..
sa babhūva nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ spṛhaṇīyatamaḥ satām.. 94 ..
12.0.d:
ततो मासात्समासाद्य दिव्यचक्षुर्महीपतिः ..
स बभूव नृपश्रेष्ठः स्पृहणीयतमः सताम्.. 94 ..
12.0.m: Then, having obtained divine vision within a month, the ruler of the earth / became the best of kings, most coveted by the virtuous. .. 94 ..

12.0.s:
tataḥ provāca māṃ hṛṣṭaḥ praṇipatya kṛtāṃjaliḥ ..
harṣagadgadayā vācā prasthitastridivaṃ prati .. 95 ..
12.0.d:
ततः प्रोवाच मां हृष्टः प्रणिपत्य कृतांजलिः ..
हर्षगद्गदया वाचा प्रस्थितस्त्रिदिवं प्रति .. 95 ..
12.0.m: Then, delighted, having bowed down with folded palms, / he spoke to me with a voice choked with joy, setting out for heaven: .. 95 ..

12.0.s:
tvatprasādātpraṇaṣṭā me bubhukṣā'tisudāruṇā ..
tathā dṛṣṭiśca saṃjātā divyā brāhmaṇasattama .. 96 ..
12.0.d:
त्वत्प्रसादात्प्रणष्टा मे बुभुक्षाऽतिसुदारुणा ..
तथा दृष्टिश्च संजाता दिव्या ब्राह्मणसत्तम .. 96 ..
12.0.m: 'By your grace, my exceedingly terrible hunger has vanished, / and divine sight has arisen, O best of brahmins! .. 96 ..

12.0.s:
anujñāṃ dehi me tasmādyena gacchāmi sāṃpratam ..
brahmalokaṃ muniśreṣṭha tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ .. 97 ..
12.0.d:
अनुज्ञां देहि मे तस्माद्येन गच्छामि सांप्रतम् ..
ब्रह्मलोकं मुनिश्रेष्ठ तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावतः .. 97 ..
12.0.m: Therefore give me permission so that I may go now / to Brahmaloka, O best of sages, through the power of this sacred ford.' .. 97 ..

12.0.s:
tato mayā vinirmuktaḥ praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ ..
sa jagāma prahṛṣṭātmā brahmalokaṃ sanātanam .. 98 ..
12.0.d:
ततो मया विनिर्मुक्तः प्रणिपत्य मुहुर्मुहुः ..
स जगाम प्रहृष्टात्मा ब्रह्मलोकं सनातनम् .. 98 ..
12.0.m: Then, released by me, bowing down again and again, / he went, joyful in spirit, to the eternal realm of Brahmā.

12.0.s:
evaṃ me bhūṣaṇamidaṃ jātaṃ hastagataṃ purā ..
tava yogyamidaṃ jñātvā tubhyaṃ tena niveditam .. 99 ..
12.0.d:
एवं मे भूषणमिदं जातं हस्तगतं पुरा ..
तव योग्यमिदं ज्ञात्वा तुभ्यं तेन निवेदितम् .. 99 ..
12.0.m: In this way, this ornament previously came into my hand. / Knowing that it was suitable for you, it was offered to you by that [reason].

12.0.s:
tataḥ prabhṛti rājeṃdra samāgatyātra mānavāḥ ..
ratnadīpānpradāyoccaiḥ snātvā'tra salile śubhe ..
kārtike māsi niryāṃti dehāṃte tridivālayam .. 6.103.100 ..
12.0.d:
ततः प्रभृति राजेंद्र समागत्यात्र मानवाः ..
रत्नदीपान्प्रदायोच्चैः स्नात्वाऽत्र सलिले शुभे ..
कार्तिके मासि निर्यांति देहांते त्रिदिवालयम् .. 6.103.100 ..
12.0.m: From that time forth, O king of kings, human beings who gather here, / offering jeweled lamps with great reverence after having bathed here in the auspicious water / in the month of Kārtika, go at the end of their bodies to the abode of heaven.

12.0.s:
ye punaḥ prāṇasaṃtyāgaṃ prakurvaṃti samāhitāḥ ..
pāpātmāno'pi te yāṃti brahmalokaṃ raghūttama .. 101 ..
12.0.d:
ये पुनः प्राणसंत्यागं प्रकुर्वंति समाहिताः ..
पापात्मानोऽपि ते यांति ब्रह्मलोकं रघूत्तम .. 101 ..
12.0.m: Moreover, those who, concentrated in mind, abandon their life-breaths, / even if sinful souls, go to the realm of Brahmā, O best of the Raghu lineage.

12.0.s:
tato dṛṣṭvā sahasrākṣaḥ prabhāvaṃ tajjalodbhavam ..
pāṃsubhiḥ pūrayāmāsa samaṃtādbhayasaṃkulam .. 102 ..
12.0.d:
ततो दृष्ट्वा सहस्राक्षः प्रभावं तज्जलोद्भवम् ..
पांसुभिः पूरयामास समंताद्भयसंकुलम् .. 102 ..
12.0.m: Then, seeing the power born of that water, the thousand-eyed [Indra], / agitated with fear, filled [it] all around with dust.

12.0.s:
tadadya divasaḥ prāpto dīpotsavasamudbhavaḥ ..
supuṇyo'tra mamādeśāttvaṃ kuruṣva sukūpikām .. 103 ..
tasyāṃ snānaṃ vidhāyātha pitṝṃstarpaya rāghava ..
devasyāsya puro dehi ratnadīpamanuttamam ....4..
yena saṃjāyate siddhirbrahmalokasamudbhavā ..
anenaiva śarīreṇa satyametanmayoditam ....5..
tataste rāghavādeśā tsarve rākṣasavānarāḥ ..
tasmindeśe vinidadhuḥ kūpikāṃ vimalodakām ....6..
12.0.d:
तदद्य दिवसः प्राप्तो दीपोत्सवसमुद्भवः ..
सुपुण्योऽत्र ममादेशात्त्वं कुरुष्व सुकूपिकाम् .. 103 ..
तस्यां स्नानं विधायाथ पितॄंस्तर्पय राघव ..
देवस्यास्य पुरो देहि रत्नदीपमनुत्तमम् ....4..
येन संजायते सिद्धिर्ब्रह्मलोकसमुद्भवा ..
अनेनैव शरीरेण सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् ....5..
ततस्ते राघवादेशा त्सर्वे राक्षसवानराः ..
तस्मिन्देशे विनिदधुः कूपिकां विमलोदकाम् ....6..
12.0.m:
Therefore, today has arrived the day arising for the festival of lamps, / exceedingly meritorious. Here, by my command, make a fine small well.
Having performed a ritual ablution in it, then gratify the ancestors, O descendant of Raghu; / offer an unexcelled jeweled lamp before this deity,
by which siddhi born of the realm of Brahmā is accomplished / even with this very body: this has been spoken truthfully by me.
Then, by the command of the descendant of Raghu, all those rākṣasas and monkeys / constructed a small well with clear water in that place.

12.0.s:
tatra snātvā pitṝṃstarpya ratnadīpaṃ pradāya ca ..
samastaṃ kārtikaṃ yāvadayodhyāṃ prasthitāstataḥ . 107 ..
12.0.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा पितॄंस्तर्प्य रत्नदीपं प्रदाय च ..
समस्तं कार्तिकं यावदयोध्यां प्रस्थितास्ततः . 107 ..
12.0.m: Having bathed there, gratified the ancestors, and offered a jeweled lamp / throughout the whole of Kārtika, they then departed for Ayodhyā.

12.0.s:
tato vibhīṣaṇaṃ muktvā hanūmaṃtaṃ ca vānaram ..
brahmalokaṃ gatāḥ sarve tattīrthasya prabhāvataḥ .. 108 ..
12.0.d:
ततो विभीषणं मुक्त्वा हनूमंतं च वानरम् ..
ब्रह्मलोकं गताः सर्वे तत्तीर्थस्य प्रभावतः .. 108 ..
12.0.m: Then, excepting Vibhīṣaṇa and Hanūmat the monkey, / all went to the realm of Brahmā through the power of that sacred ford.

12.0.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
adyāpi dīpadānaṃ yaḥ kurute tatra sādaram ..
saṃprāpte kārtike māsi snātvā tatra jale śubhe ..
sa sarvapātakairmukto brahmaloke mahīyate .. 109 ..
12.0.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अद्यापि दीपदानं यः कुरुते तत्र सादरम् ..
संप्राप्ते कार्तिके मासि स्नात्वा तत्र जले शुभे ..
स सर्वपातकैर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते .. 109 ..
12.0.m: Sūta said: / Even today, whoever reverently offers a lamp there, / having bathed there in the auspicious water when the month of Kārtika has arrived, / is freed from all sins and honored in the realm of Brahmā.

12.0.s:
evaṃ tatra samutpannaṃ tattaḍāgaṃ śubhāvaham ..
ānarttīyaṃ tathā viṣṇukūpikā sā ca śobhanā .. 6.103.110 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāharuyāṃ saṃhi tāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye ānartakatīrthakūpikāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tryadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 103 .. .. cha .. .. ..
12.0.d:
एवं तत्र समुत्पन्नं तत्तडागं शुभावहम् ..
आनर्त्तीयं तथा विष्णुकूपिका सा च शोभना .. 6.103.110 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहरुयां संहि तायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये आनर्तकतीर्थकूपिकामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्र्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः .. 103 .. .. छ .. .. ..
12.0.m:
Thus that auspicious pond was created there, / known as Ānarttīya, as well as that beautiful well of Viṣṇu.
Thus ends the one hundred and third chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Sacred Ford and Well of Ānarta,' in the Glorious Māhātmya of the Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Sixth Section, the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, of the eighty-one-thousand-[verse] collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

14.0.s: adhyāyaḥ 1 arbudācalamāhātmyavarṇanopakramaḥ, tatrādau vasiṣṭhasyārbudācale gamanam, tatra tapastaptvā yajñārthaṃ pālitāyā dhenoraraṇye tṛṇādi carituṃ gatāyāḥ śvabhre patanam, sāyaṃ dhenorapratyāgamanādvasiṣṭhena cintākaraṇam, tato vasiṣṭhena śvabhrasamīpametya svadhenorbhuṃbhārāvaṃ śrutvā tasyā bahirnirgamanārthaṃ sarasvatīdhyānakaraṇam, tena dhyānena sarasvatyā svajalena śvabhraṃ pūrayitvā gorbahirniḥsaraṇakaraṇam, tāṃ dhenuṃ gṛhītvā vasiṣṭhasya svāśrame gamanam, tato vasiṣṭhena tacchvabhra pūraṇāya himavantaṃ gatvā śvabhrāyāmavistāraṃ himavate kathayitvā himavadvacanācchvabhrotpattithanam, vasiṣṭhāśramasamīpavarti vivaravṛttāntopakramavarṇanama
14.0.d: अध्यायः 1 अर्बुदाचलमाहात्म्यवर्णनोपक्रमः, तत्रादौ वसिष्ठस्यार्बुदाचले गमनम्, तत्र तपस्तप्त्वा यज्ञार्थं पालिताया धेनोररण्ये तृणादि चरितुं गतायाः श्वभ्रे पतनम्, सायं धेनोरप्रत्यागमनाद्वसिष्ठेन चिन्ताकरणम्, ततो वसिष्ठेन श्वभ्रसमीपमेत्य स्वधेनोर्भुंभारावं श्रुत्वा तस्या बहिर्निर्गमनार्थं सरस्वतीध्यानकरणम्, तेन ध्यानेन सरस्वत्या स्वजलेन श्वभ्रं पूरयित्वा गोर्बहिर्निःसरणकरणम्, तां धेनुं गृहीत्वा वसिष्ठस्य स्वाश्रमे गमनम्, ततो वसिष्ठेन तच्छ्वभ्र पूरणाय हिमवन्तं गत्वा श्वभ्रायामविस्तारं हिमवते कथयित्वा हिमवद्वचनाच्छ्वभ्रोत्पत्तिथनम्, वसिष्ठाश्रमसमीपवर्ति विवरवृत्तान्तोपक्रमवर्णनम
14.0.m: Chapter 1: The beginning of the description of the māhātmya of Mount Arbuda; therein, first, the going of Vasiṣṭha to Mount Arbuda; having performed austerity there, the cow reared for the sake of the sacrifice, having gone to graze on grass and the like in the forest, falling into a chasm; because the cow did not return in the evening, Vasiṣṭha experiencing worry; then Vasiṣṭha, having approached near the chasm and heard the lowing sound of his own cow, performing meditation on Sarasvatī for the sake of her coming out; through that meditation, Sarasvatī filling the chasm with her own water and causing the cow's emergence; taking that cow, Vasiṣṭha going to his own hermitage; then Vasiṣṭha going to Himavat to fill that chasm, telling the length and breadth of the chasm to Himavat, and the telling of the origin of the chasm by the word of Himavat; the beginning of the description of the account of the cavern situated near Vasiṣṭha's hermitage.

14.0.s:
adhyāyaḥ 2 gautamaśiṣyasyottaṃkasya gurudakṣiṇāṃ dātuṃ gurupatnyā saudāsapatnīmadayantīkuṇḍalānayane pracoditasya saudāsagṛhaṃ prati gamanam, tatra svasya dehaṃ bhakṣitumāgataṃ vyāghrāsyaṃ saudāsaṃ dṛṣṭvā svātmapradānāya tasmai pratijñākaraṇam, tatastatpatnyāḥ sakāśātkuṇḍalalabdhiḥ, saudāsasya śāpādvimuktiḥ, tataḥ kuṇḍale gṛhītvā gatena gautama-śiṣyeṇa madhyemārgaṃ nihitayostayoḥ kuṃḍalayostakṣakeṇa haraṇam, tatastakṣakasya pṛṣṭhatastatpratyānayanārthaṃ pātāle gamanam, tasminneva samaye tatra gartotpādanam, gautamaśiṣyottaṃkacaritravarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 3 vasiṣṭhājñayā himavadvacanānnaṃdivardhanaparvatenārbudanāganītena śvabhrapūraṇakaraṇam, arbudācalamāhātmyavarṇanam
14.0.d:
अध्यायः 2 गौतमशिष्यस्योत्तंकस्य गुरुदक्षिणां दातुं गुरुपत्न्या सौदासपत्नीमदयन्तीकुण्डलानयने प्रचोदितस्य सौदासगृहं प्रति गमनम्, तत्र स्वस्य देहं भक्षितुमागतं व्याघ्रास्यं सौदासं दृष्ट्वा स्वात्मप्रदानाय तस्मै प्रतिज्ञाकरणम्, ततस्तत्पत्न्याः सकाशात्कुण्डललब्धिः, सौदासस्य शापाद्विमुक्तिः, ततः कुण्डले गृहीत्वा गतेन गौतम-शिष्येण मध्येमार्गं निहितयोस्तयोः कुंडलयोस्तक्षकेण हरणम्, ततस्तक्षकस्य पृष्ठतस्तत्प्रत्यानयनार्थं पाताले गमनम्, तस्मिन्नेव समये तत्र गर्तोत्पादनम्, गौतमशिष्योत्तंकचरित्रवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 3 वसिष्ठाज्ञया हिमवद्वचनान्नंदिवर्धनपर्वतेनार्बुदनागनीतेन श्वभ्रपूरणकरणम्, अर्बुदाचलमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
14.0.m:
Chapter 2: Gautama's pupil Uttaṅka, urged by the guru's wife to bring the earrings of Madayantī, wife of Saudāsa, in order to give the fee to the guru, going toward Saudāsa's house; there seeing Saudāsa with a tiger's face who had come to eat his body, making a promise to him to surrender himself; then the acquisition of the earrings from his wife; the release of Saudāsa from the curse; then Gautama's pupil, having gone taking the two earrings, their being stolen by Takṣaka when placed midway on the path; then the going to Pātāla behind Takṣaka in order to bring them back; at that very time, the creation of a pit there; the description of the deeds of Gautama's pupil Uttaṅka.
Chapter 3: The filling of the chasm by the mountain Nandivardhana brought by the serpent Arbuda at the command of Vasiṣṭha by the word of Himavat; the description of the māhātmya of Mount Arbuda.

14.0.s:
adhyāyaḥ 4 tatrārbudānītanaṃdivardhanākhyaparvate śivāvāsārthaṃ vasiṣṭhena tapaḥkaraṇam, vasiṣṭhena śivastavakaraṇam, tato vasiṣṭhena śivaprasādenācaleśvaretināmnā liṃgasthāpanam, śivena mandākinyā vāsakaraṇam, acaleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 5 arbudācale nāgatīrthamāhātmyavarṇane yayātipulastvasaṃvāde gautamyā nāgatīrthe snānārthaṃ gamanavarṇanam, tatra snātuṃ pravṛttāyāstasyāḥ putrecchāvyākulitahṛdayatvātkevalasnānena garbhadhāraṇam, tato lajjayā citāṃ praveṣṭukāmāyāstasyā nabhovāṇīśravaṇānmaraṇato nivartanam, nāgatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 6 vasiṣṭhāśramamāhātmyavarṇanama,
adhyāyaḥ 7 acaleśvaraprabhāvavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 8 bhadrakarṇahradatrinetramāhātmyavarṇanam
14.0.d:
अध्यायः 4 तत्रार्बुदानीतनंदिवर्धनाख्यपर्वते शिवावासार्थं वसिष्ठेन तपःकरणम्, वसिष्ठेन शिवस्तवकरणम्, ततो वसिष्ठेन शिवप्रसादेनाचलेश्वरेतिनाम्ना लिंगस्थापनम्, शिवेन मन्दाकिन्या वासकरणम्, अचलेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 5 अर्बुदाचले नागतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णने ययातिपुलस्त्वसंवादे गौतम्या नागतीर्थे स्नानार्थं गमनवर्णनम्, तत्र स्नातुं प्रवृत्तायास्तस्याः पुत्रेच्छाव्याकुलितहृदयत्वात्केवलस्नानेन गर्भधारणम्, ततो लज्जया चितां प्रवेष्टुकामायास्तस्या नभोवाणीश्रवणान्मरणतो निवर्तनम्, नागतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 6 वसिष्ठाश्रममाहात्म्यवर्णनम,
अध्यायः 7 अचलेश्वरप्रभाववर्णनम्
अध्यायः 8 भद्रकर्णह्रदत्रिनेत्रमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
14.0.m:
Chapter 4: There, on the mountain named Nandivardhana brought by Arbuda, Vasiṣṭha performing austerity for the sake of Śiva's residence; Vasiṣṭha offering praise to Śiva; then, by the grace of Śiva, the installation of a liṅga by Vasiṣṭha under the name Acaleśvara; Śiva's dwelling with the Mandākinī; the description of the māhātmya of Acaleśvara.
Chapter 5: In the description of the māhātmya of the Nāgatīrtha on Mount Arbuda, in the dialogue of Yayāti and Pulastya, the description of Gautamī's going to the Nāgatīrtha for a ritual ablution; of her who had set out to bathe there, because her heart was agitated by the desire for a son, the conceiving of a child merely by bathing; then, of her who wished out of shame to enter the funeral pyre, the turning back from death upon hearing a voice from the sky; the description of the māhātmya of the Nāgatīrtha.
Chapter 6: The description of the māhātmya of Vasiṣṭha's hermitage.
Chapter 7: The description of the power of Acaleśvara.
Chapter 8: The description of the māhātmya of Bhadrakarṇahrada and Trinetra.

14.0.s:
adhyāyaḥ 9 kedāramāhātmyavarṇane'jāpālaṃ prati vasiṣṭhena 'prāgjanmani śūdratvaṃ prāptena tvayā kamalaiḥ kedāreśvarapūjaneneha janmani te rājyapadaprāptiḥ iti kathanam, kedāreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 10 yugakālapramāṇādivarṇanam, caturyugadharmādharmavivecanam , kaliyugaprabhāvātsarvatīrthāgamanavarṇanam
|
adhyāyaḥ 11 koṭīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 12 vapurnāmakāpsarasā rūpatīrthe snānakaraṇena susvarūpaprāptiḥ, rūpatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 13 hṛṣīkeśamāhātmyavarṇane'mbarīṣarājarṣiṇā tapaḥ kṛtvā harimūrtisthāpanam, hṛṣīkeśa-māhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 14 viśvāvasunāmakasiddhena śivamārādhya śivakṛpayā liṃgasthāpanam, siddheśvaraliṃga-māhātmyavarṇanam
14.0.d:
अध्यायः 9 केदारमाहात्म्यवर्णनेऽजापालं प्रति वसिष्ठेन ऽप्राग्जन्मनि शूद्रत्वं प्राप्तेन त्वया कमलैः केदारेश्वरपूजनेनेह जन्मनि ते राज्यपदप्राप्तिः इति कथनम्, केदारेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 10 युगकालप्रमाणादिवर्णनम्, चतुर्युगधर्माधर्मविवेचनम् , कलियुगप्रभावात्सर्वतीर्थागमनवर्णनम्
|
अध्यायः 11 कोटीश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 12 वपुर्नामकाप्सरसा रूपतीर्थे स्नानकरणेन सुस्वरूपप्राप्तिः, रूपतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 13 हृषीकेशमाहात्म्यवर्णनेऽम्बरीषराजर्षिणा तपः कृत्वा हरिमूर्तिस्थापनम्, हृषीकेश-माहात्म्यवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 14 विश्वावसुनामकसिद्धेन शिवमाराध्य शिवकृपया लिंगस्थापनम्, सिद्धेश्वरलिंग-माहात्म्यवर्णनम्
14.0.m:
Chapter 9: In the description of the māhātmya of Kedāra, the statement by Vasiṣṭha to Ajāpāla: 'In a previous birth, having attained the status of a Śūdra, by your worship of Kedāreśvara with lotuses, your attainment of the rank of kingship has occurred in this birth'; the description of the māhātmya of Kedāreśvara.
Chapter 10: The description of the duration of the yugas and the like; the examination of virtue and non-virtue in the four yugas; the description of the arrival of all sacred fords due to the power of the Kali yuga. / Chapter 11: The description of the māhātmya of Koṭīśvara.
Chapter 12: The attainment of a beautiful form by the apsaras named Vapuḥ by performing a ritual ablution at the Rūpatīrtha; the description of the māhātmya of Rūpatīrtha.
Chapter 13: In the description of the māhātmya of Hṛṣīkeśa, the installation of the image of Hari by the royal seer Ambarīṣa having performed austerity; the description of the māhātmya of Hṛṣīkeśa.
Chapter 14: By the perfected being named Viśvāvasu, having worshipped Śiva, the installation of a liṅga by the grace of Śiva; the description of the māhātmya of the Siddheśvara liṅga.

14.0.s:
adhyāyaḥ 15 daityāndevairnirjitāndṛṣṭvā ciṃtayā daityajayaprāptyarthaṃ daityaguruṇā śukrācāryeṇa devamārādhya varaṃ labdhā daityajayakaraṇaṃ tatraiva śukreśvaretināmnā liṃgasthāpanaṃ ca, śukreśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 16 kayācinmaṇikarṇikākhyayā striyā snānakaraṇena tasyāḥ susvarūpaprāptirato maṇikarṇiketināmnā kuṇḍakhyātikathanam, maṇikarṇikeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 17 kenacitpaṃgunāmakena paṃgutvaṃ gatena vipreṇa śivaṃ prasādya paṃgutvaṃ nirākṛtya svanāmnā tīrthasthāpanam, paṃgutīrthamāhātmyavarṇanama,
14.0.d:
अध्यायः 15 दैत्यान्देवैर्निर्जितान्दृष्ट्वा चिंतया दैत्यजयप्राप्त्यर्थं दैत्यगुरुणा शुक्राचार्येण देवमाराध्य वरं लब्धा दैत्यजयकरणं तत्रैव शुक्रेश्वरेतिनाम्ना लिंगस्थापनं च, शुक्रेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 16 कयाचिन्मणिकर्णिकाख्यया स्त्रिया स्नानकरणेन तस्याः सुस्वरूपप्राप्तिरतो मणिकर्णिकेतिनाम्ना कुण्डख्यातिकथनम्, मणिकर्णिकेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 17 केनचित्पंगुनामकेन पंगुत्वं गतेन विप्रेण शिवं प्रसाद्य पंगुत्वं निराकृत्य स्वनाम्ना तीर्थस्थापनम्, पंगुतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम,
14.0.m:
Chapter 15: Seeing the Daityas defeated by the gods, Śukrācārya, the preceptor of the Daityas, with anxiety in order to gain victory for the Daityas, propitiated the God, received a boon, and caused the Daityas to be victorious, and the installation of a liṅga there named Śukreśvara; description of the māhātmya of the Śukreśvara liṅga.
Chapter 16: By performing a bath, a certain woman named Maṇikarṇikā attained a beautiful form, and therefore the narration of the renown of the pool by the name of Maṇikarṇikā; description of the māhātmya of Maṇikarṇikeśvara.
Chapter 17: A certain brahmin who had become lame, having propitiated Śiva, got rid of his lameness and established a sacred ford in his own name; description of the māhātmya of the Paṅgutīrtha.

14.0.s:
adhyāyaḥ 18 atīvapāpakāriṇaścitrāṃgadasya jalaṃ praviṣṭasya tṛṣārtasya grāheṇa haraṇam, tato yama-dūtaiḥ pāpinaścitrāṃgadasya narake prakṣepaṇam, citrāṃgadasya narake prakṣepaṇena tatratyajīvānāṃ sukhaprāptiḥ, tata āścaryaṃ dṛṣṭvā yamena jñānekṣaṇena samavalokya mattīrthasnānakaraṇena tatraivāsya mṛtiprāpternāyaṃ narakalokaduḥkhabhāgiti manasi vicārya tasya narakato mocanam, tatastasya citrāṃgadasyāpsarogaṇaveṣṭitavimānena svarge gamanam, yamatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 19 vārāhatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 20 dakṣeṇa candraṃ prati svakanyāsu viṣamatvena vartanadarśanādyakṣmajanakaśāpapradānam, tataścandreṇa tapastapanam, tena tapasā tasya yakṣmaroganivṛttiḥ, candreṇa candraprabhāseti nāmnā liṃgasthāpanam, candraprabhāsatīrthaliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam
14.0.d:
अध्यायः 18 अतीवपापकारिणश्चित्रांगदस्य जलं प्रविष्टस्य तृषार्तस्य ग्राहेण हरणम्, ततो यम-दूतैः पापिनश्चित्रांगदस्य नरके प्रक्षेपणम्, चित्रांगदस्य नरके प्रक्षेपणेन तत्रत्यजीवानां सुखप्राप्तिः, तत आश्चर्यं दृष्ट्वा यमेन ज्ञानेक्षणेन समवलोक्य मत्तीर्थस्नानकरणेन तत्रैवास्य मृतिप्राप्तेर्नायं नरकलोकदुःखभागिति मनसि विचार्य तस्य नरकतो मोचनम्, ततस्तस्य चित्रांगदस्याप्सरोगणवेष्टितविमानेन स्वर्गे गमनम्, यमतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 19 वाराहतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 20 दक्षेण चन्द्रं प्रति स्वकन्यासु विषमत्वेन वर्तनदर्शनाद्यक्ष्मजनकशापप्रदानम्, ततश्चन्द्रेण तपस्तपनम्, तेन तपसा तस्य यक्ष्मरोगनिवृत्तिः, चन्द्रेण चन्द्रप्रभासेति नाम्ना लिंगस्थापनम्, चन्द्रप्रभासतीर्थलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
14.0.m:
Chapter 18: The seizing by an alligator of Citrāṅgada, a great committer of sin, when he entered the water afflicted by thirst; then the throwing into hell of the sinner Citrāṅgada by Yama's messengers; the attainment of comfort by the beings residing there by the throwing of Citrāṅgada into hell; then, seeing the wonder, Yama looked with the eye of knowledge and, reflecting in his mind, 'Because of his taking a bath in my sacred ford and attaining death right there, he is not one to share in the suffering of the world of hell,' liberated him from hell; then the departure of Citrāṅgada to heaven in an aerial chariot surrounded by a host of apsarases; description of the māhātmya of the Yamatīrtha.
Chapter 19: Description of the māhātmya of the Vārāhatīrtha.
Chapter 20: Dakṣa giving a curse causing consumption to Candra on seeing his unequal conduct towards his own daughters; then Candra performing austerity, and by that austerity the cure of his disease of consumption; the installation of a liṅga by Candra under the name Candraprabhāsa; description of the māhātmya of the Candraprabhāsatīrtha and liṅga.

14.0.s:
adhyāyaḥ 21 piṇḍodakatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 22 kaliṃganāmakadānavena jitairdevairdevyārādhanāṃ kṛtvā devīkṛpayā svargaprāpaṇam, kaliṃgadehopari parvataśṛṃga nidhāya tacchikhare devyā svāvasthānakaraṇam, devaiḥ śrīmātādevīstavanakaraṇam, śrīmātāmāhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 23 atha śuklatīrthamāhātmyam, tatra rajakena nīlīmadhye prakṣiptānāṃ vastrāṇāṃ śuklatvaprāptyā tasya tīrthasya śuklatīrtheti nāmakaraṇam, śuklatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 24 niśuṃbhadaityaṃ hatvā devyāstatrārbudācale'vasthānāttasyāḥ kātyāyanītināmnā devaiḥ sthāpanam, kātyāyanīmāhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 25 piṇḍārakatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam.
adhyāyaḥ 26 kanakhalatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 27 cakratīrthaprabhāvavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 28 manuṣyatīrthaprabhāvavarṇanam
14.0.d:
अध्यायः 21 पिण्डोदकतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 22 कलिंगनामकदानवेन जितैर्देवैर्देव्याराधनां कृत्वा देवीकृपया स्वर्गप्रापणम्, कलिंगदेहोपरि पर्वतशृंग निधाय तच्छिखरे देव्या स्वावस्थानकरणम्, देवैः श्रीमातादेवीस्तवनकरणम्, श्रीमातामाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 23 अथ शुक्लतीर्थमाहात्म्यम्, तत्र रजकेन नीलीमध्ये प्रक्षिप्तानां वस्त्राणां शुक्लत्वप्राप्त्या तस्य तीर्थस्य शुक्लतीर्थेति नामकरणम्, शुक्लतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 24 निशुंभदैत्यं हत्वा देव्यास्तत्रार्बुदाचलेऽवस्थानात्तस्याः कात्यायनीतिनाम्ना देवैः स्थापनम्, कात्यायनीमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 25 पिण्डारकतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्.
अध्यायः 26 कनखलतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 27 चक्रतीर्थप्रभाववर्णनम्
अध्यायः 28 मनुष्यतीर्थप्रभाववर्णनम्
14.0.m:
Chapter 21: Description of the māhātmya of the Piṇḍodakatīrtha.
Chapter 22: The gods, defeated by the Dānava named Kaliṅga, having worshipped the Goddess, gained heaven through the Goddess's grace; having placed a mountain peak upon the body of Kaliṅga, the Goddess established her abode upon that summit; the gods offering praise to the goddess Śrīmātā; description of the māhātmya of Śrīmātā.
Chapter 23: Now, the māhātmya of Śuklatīrtha; there, the naming of that sacred ford as Śuklatīrtha because of clothes thrown into indigo by a washerman becoming white; description of the māhātmya of the Śuklatīrtha.
Chapter 24: Having slain the Daitya Niśumbha, because the Goddess stayed there on Mount Arbuda, her establishment by the gods under the name Kātyāyanī; description of the māhātmya of Kātyāyanī.
Chapter 25: Description of the māhātmya of the Piṇḍārakatīrtha.
Chapter 26: Description of the māhātmya of the Kanakhalatīrtha.
Chapter 27: Description of the efficacy of the Cakratīrtha.
Chapter 28: Description of the efficacy of the Manuṣyatīrtha.

14.0.s: adhyāyaḥ 29 mṛgayāsaktena suprabhanṛpatinā bālaṃ stanaṃ dhayaṃtīṃ mṛgīṃ prati bāṇena vedhakaraṇam, tato mṛgyā rājñe raudravyāghro bhaviṣyasi iti śāpapradānam, tatkāla eva rājño vyāghratvaprāptiḥ, tatraivāraṇye gokulato bhraṣṭāyāḥ kasyāścitkapilānāmnyā gorāga-manam, vyāghrakapilayoḥ saṃvādavarṇanam, tataḥ kapilayā vyāghrasamīpe śapathaṃ kṛtvā svasthānaṃ goṣṭhaṃ gatvā dugdhaṃ bālāya pāyayitvā vatsāya vanagatavṛttāntaṃ śrāvayitvā vanametuṃ vatsāgrahaṃ dṛṣṭvā tato vatsasya nivāraṇaṃ kṛtvā svasakhīḥ pratyetya sarvaṃ kathayitvā sakhībhirvyāghrasannidhau gantuṃ nivāritayāpi tayā sakhīvacanamavamanya vyāghrasamīpe pratyāgamanam, goḥ satyavaktrītvaṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayotphullamānasenavyāghreṇa gave jīvadānam, suprabhasya śāpānmuktiḥ, tasyaiva sthānasya kapilātīrthetināmnā prasiddhiḥ, kapilātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam
14.0.d: अध्यायः 29 मृगयासक्तेन सुप्रभनृपतिना बालं स्तनं धयंतीं मृगीं प्रति बाणेन वेधकरणम्, ततो मृग्या राज्ञे रौद्रव्याघ्रो भविष्यसि इति शापप्रदानम्, तत्काल एव राज्ञो व्याघ्रत्वप्राप्तिः, तत्रैवारण्ये गोकुलतो भ्रष्टायाः कस्याश्चित्कपिलानाम्न्या गोराग-मनम्, व्याघ्रकपिलयोः संवादवर्णनम्, ततः कपिलया व्याघ्रसमीपे शपथं कृत्वा स्वस्थानं गोष्ठं गत्वा दुग्धं बालाय पाययित्वा वत्साय वनगतवृत्तान्तं श्रावयित्वा वनमेतुं वत्साग्रहं दृष्ट्वा ततो वत्सस्य निवारणं कृत्वा स्वसखीः प्रत्येत्य सर्वं कथयित्वा सखीभिर्व्याघ्रसन्निधौ गन्तुं निवारितयापि तया सखीवचनमवमन्य व्याघ्रसमीपे प्रत्यागमनम्, गोः सत्यवक्त्रीत्वं दृष्ट्वा विस्मयोत्फुल्लमानसेनव्याघ्रेण गवे जीवदानम्, सुप्रभस्य शापान्मुक्तिः, तस्यैव स्थानस्य कपिलातीर्थेतिनाम्ना प्रसिद्धिः, कपिलातीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
14.0.m: Chapter 29: King Suprabha, addicted to hunting, striking with an arrow a doe suckling her young; then the doe cursing the king, saying, 'You shall become a fierce tiger'; at that very moment the king becoming a tiger; the coming into that very forest of a certain cow named Kapilā who had strayed from the cow-herd; description of the dialogue between the tiger and Kapilā; then Kapilā, having made an oath before the tiger, went to her own place, the cow-pen, suckled her young with milk, narrated the forest event to her calf, saw the calf's insistence on going to the forest, dissuaded the calf, went to her female friends, told everything, and though dissuaded by her friends from going near the tiger, disregarded her friends' words and returned near the tiger; seeing the truthfulness of the cow, the tiger, with a heart blossoming with wonder, granted life to the cow; Suprabha was freed from the curse; the renown of that very place by the name Kapilātīrtha; description of the māhātmya of the Kapilātīrtha.

14.0.s:
adhyāyaḥ 30 agnitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam
|
adhyāyaḥ 31 indrasenasya śatruvināśārtha dhanaharaṇārtha paradeśe gamanam, tato dūtamukhenendrasenenendraseno mṛt iti tatpatnyai kathanakaraṇādindrasenapatnīvināśaḥ, indrasenasya strīhatyāvināśārthaṃ somatīrthādiprabhāsasthasarvatīrtheṣu gamanakaraṇam, indrasenasya tatra gatvā pāpahānerabhāvādraktānubaṃdhartārthe snānakaraṇenaiva pāpamuktivarṇanam, raktānubandhatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 32 uddhartanajaṃ lepaṃ gṛhītvā pārvatyā bālakanirmāṇakaraṇam, pārvatyā lepābhāvācchirohīno bālako'yamiti matvā tatkabaṃdhena saha kasyacinmattagajamastakasya saṃdhānakaraṇam, tataḥ śivena mahāvināyaketi tasya nāmakaraṇam, mahāvaināyakīśāntikathanam, mahāvināyakamāhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 33 pārtheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam
14.0.d:
अध्यायः 30 अग्नितीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
|
अध्यायः 31 इन्द्रसेनस्य शत्रुविनाशार्थ धनहरणार्थ परदेशे गमनम्, ततो दूतमुखेनेन्द्रसेनेनेन्द्रसेनो मृत् इति तत्पत्न्यै कथनकरणादिन्द्रसेनपत्नीविनाशः, इन्द्रसेनस्य स्त्रीहत्याविनाशार्थं सोमतीर्थादिप्रभासस्थसर्वतीर्थेषु गमनकरणम्, इन्द्रसेनस्य तत्र गत्वा पापहानेरभावाद्रक्तानुबंधर्तार्थे स्नानकरणेनैव पापमुक्तिवर्णनम्, रक्तानुबन्धतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 32 उद्धर्तनजं लेपं गृहीत्वा पार्वत्या बालकनिर्माणकरणम्, पार्वत्या लेपाभावाच्छिरोहीनो बालकोऽयमिति मत्वा तत्कबंधेन सह कस्यचिन्मत्तगजमस्तकस्य संधानकरणम्, ततः शिवेन महाविनायकेति तस्य नामकरणम्, महावैनायकीशान्तिकथनम्, महाविनायकमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 33 पार्थेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
14.0.m:
Chapter 30: Description of the māhātmya of the Agnitīrtha. / Chapter 31: Indrasena going to a foreign country to destroy his enemies and take their wealth; then, because of the messenger telling Indrasena's wife from Indrasena's mouth that 'Indrasena is dead,' the death of Indrasena's wife; Indrasena's going to all the sacred fords situated in Prabhāsa, such as Somatīrtha, to destroy the sin of killing a woman; because of the non-elimination of sin upon going there, Indrasena's liberation from sin precisely through taking a bath in the Raktānubandha sacred ford is described; description of the māhātmya of the Raktānubandhatīrtha.
Chapter 32: Taking the cosmetic paste derived from cleansing powder, Pārvatī fashioned a boy; considering, 'This boy is headless for lack of paste,' Pārvatī joined the head of a certain rutting elephant with that trunk; then Śiva named him Mahāvināyaka; narration of the pacification rite of Mahāvināyaka; description of the māhātmya of Mahāvināyaka.
Chapter 33: Description of the māhātmya of Pārtheśvara.

14.0.s:
adhyāyaḥ 34 mahattvākāṃkṣayā brahmaviṣṇvoḥ parasparaṃ kalahāyamānayoryudhyatośca madhya ekasyānādyantasya liṃgasyotpattivarṇanam, tata ākāśavāṇyā tayoryuddhaparāvartanaṃ kārayitvā 'yo liṃgāntaṃ paśyetsa mahān ' iti paṇakathanam, tatra brahmaṇā śivasaṃnidhau mithyā liṃgordhvaparyantadarśanavṛttakathanācchivena brahmaṇe'pūjyatvaprāpakaśāpadānama, tathaiva brahmaṇo mithyāsākṣyaṃ dātuṃ pravṛttasya ketakasyāpi śāpadānam, tato viṣṇave śaṃkareṇa varapradānam, kṛṣṇatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 35 māmuhradotpattivṛttāntavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 36 mahiṣāsurapīḍitairdevaiḥ kṛtenārādhanena prasannayā devyā mahiṣāsuravadhakaraṇam, tatraiva devaiścaṇḍikāśrametināmnā sthāpanavṛttāntavarṇanam, caṇḍikāśramamāhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 37 nāgodbhavatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam
14.0.d:
अध्यायः 34 महत्त्वाकांक्षया ब्रह्मविष्ण्वोः परस्परं कलहायमानयोर्युध्यतोश्च मध्य एकस्यानाद्यन्तस्य लिंगस्योत्पत्तिवर्णनम्, तत आकाशवाण्या तयोर्युद्धपरावर्तनं कारयित्वा ऽयो लिंगान्तं पश्येत्स महान् ' इति पणकथनम्, तत्र ब्रह्मणा शिवसंनिधौ मिथ्या लिंगोर्ध्वपर्यन्तदर्शनवृत्तकथनाच्छिवेन ब्रह्मणेऽपूज्यत्वप्रापकशापदानम, तथैव ब्रह्मणो मिथ्यासाक्ष्यं दातुं प्रवृत्तस्य केतकस्यापि शापदानम्, ततो विष्णवे शंकरेण वरप्रदानम्, कृष्णतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 35 मामुह्रदोत्पत्तिवृत्तान्तवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 36 महिषासुरपीडितैर्देवैः कृतेनाराधनेन प्रसन्नया देव्या महिषासुरवधकरणम्, तत्रैव देवैश्चण्डिकाश्रमेतिनाम्ना स्थापनवृत्तान्तवर्णनम्, चण्डिकाश्रममाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 37 नागोद्भवतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
14.0.m:
Chapter 34: Description of the origin of a single liṅga without beginning or end in the midst of Brahmā and Viṣṇu, who were quarrelling and fighting with each other out of a desire for greatness; then, an incorporeal voice causing their fight to stop, stating the wager: 'He who sees the end of the liṅga shall be the greater'; there, because Brahmā falsely related in Śiva's presence the incident of seeing the upper limit of the liṅga, Śiva gave Brahmā a curse causing him to be unworthy of worship; likewise, the giving of a curse also to the Ketaka flower who had come forward to give false witness for Brahmā; then Śaṃkara granting a boon to Viṣṇu; description of the māhātmya of the Kṛṣṇatīrtha.
Chapter 35: Description of the account of the origin of Māmuhrada.
Chapter 36: The slaying of Mahiṣāsura by the Goddess, who was pleased by the worship performed by the gods afflicted by Mahiṣāsura; the description of the account of the establishment right there by the gods under the name Caṇḍikāśrama; description of the māhātmya of Caṇḍikāśrama.
Chapter 37: Description of the māhātmya of the Nāgodbhavatīrtha.

14.0.s:
adhyāyaḥ 38 śivagaṃgākuṇḍotpattimāhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 39 śivaliṃgamāheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanapuraḥsarasaktudānamāhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 40 śaṃkareṇa kāmadahanakaraṇādratyā śokakaraṇam, taṃ ratikṛtaṃ śokaṃ śrutvā nabhovāṇyā kāmasvānaṅgatvapūrvakasaṃjīvanavarṇanam, tayā ratyā saha kāmena liṃgasthāpanam , kāme-śvaramāhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 41 mārkaṇḍajanmādikathānidarśanapūrvakaṃ mārkaṇḍeyāśramapadotpattivṛttāntavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 42 uddālakeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam
adhyāyaḥ 43 siddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam

अध्यायः 52 ईशानीशिखरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 53 ब्रह्मपदोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
अध्यायः 54 त्रिपुष्करमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्

14.1.s:
.. vyāsa uvāca .. ..
oṃnamonaṃtāya sūkṣmāya jñānagamyāya vedhase ..
śuddhāya viśvarūpāya devadevāya śaṃbhave .. 1 ..
14.1.d:
.. व्यास उवाच .. ..
ओंनमोनंताय सूक्ष्माय ज्ञानगम्याय वेधसे ..
शुद्धाय विश्वरूपाय देवदेवाय शंभवे .. 1 ..
14.1.m:
Vyāsa said:
Om, reverence to the infinite, subtle Creator, attainable through knowledge, / to the pure, universal-formed Śambhu, god of gods.

14.1.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kathito vaṃśavistāro bhavatā somasūryayoḥ ..
manvaṃtarāṇi sarvāṇi sṛṣṭiścaiva pṛthagvidhā .. 2 ..
14.1.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
कथितो वंशविस्तारो भवता सोमसूर्ययोः ..
मन्वंतराणि सर्वाणि सृष्टिश्चैव पृथग्विधा .. 2 ..
14.1.m:
The seers said:
The expansion of the lineages of the Moon and the Sun has been related by you, / along with all the Manvantaras and the manifold creation.

14.1.s:
adhunā śrotumicchāmastīrthamāhātmyamuttamam ..
kāni tīrthāni puṇyāni bhūtale'sminmahāmate .. 3 ..
14.1.d:
अधुना श्रोतुमिच्छामस्तीर्थमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् ..
कानि तीर्थानि पुण्यानि भूतलेऽस्मिन्महामते .. 3 ..
14.1.m: Now we wish to hear the supreme māhātmya of sacred fords: / which sacred fords on this earth are meritorious, O wise one?

14.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
nānā tīrthāni loke'sminyeṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate ..
tisraḥ koṭyo'rddhakoṭiśca teṣāṃ saṃkhyā kṛtā purā .. 4 ..
14.1.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
नाना तीर्थानि लोकेऽस्मिन्येषां संख्या न विद्यते ..
तिस्रः कोट्योऽर्द्धकोटिश्च तेषां संख्या कृता पुरा .. 4 ..
14.1.m:
Sūta said:
There are various sacred fords in this world, of which there is no [finite] count; / formerly their number was counted as thirty-five million.

14.1.s:
kṣetrāṇi saritaścaiva parvatāśca nadā stathā ..
ṛṣīṇāṃ tapaso vīryānmāhātmyaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ .. 5 ..
14.1.d:
क्षेत्राणि सरितश्चैव पर्वताश्च नदा स्तथा ..
ऋषीणां तपसो वीर्यान्माहात्म्यं परमं गताः .. 5 ..
14.1.m: Sacred fields, rivers, mountains, and streams / have attained supreme greatness by the power of the seers' austerity.

14.1.s:
teṣāṃ madhye'rbudonāma sarvapāpaharo'naghaḥ ..
aspṛṣṭaḥ kalidoṣeṇa vasiṣṭhasya prabhāvataḥ .. 6 ..
14.1.d:
तेषां मध्येऽर्बुदोनाम सर्वपापहरोऽनघः ..
अस्पृष्टः कलिदोषेण वसिष्ठस्य प्रभावतः .. 6 ..
14.1.m: Among them, the one named Arbuda destroys all sins, is sinless, / and remains untouched by the defect of Kali due to the power of Vasiṣṭha.

14.1.s:
punaṃti sarvatīrthāni snānadānādikairyathā ..
arbudo darśanādeva sarvapāpaharo nṛṇām .. 7 ..
14.1.d:
पुनंति सर्वतीर्थानि स्नानदानादिकैर्यथा ..
अर्बुदो दर्शनादेव सर्वपापहरो नृणाम् .. 7 ..
14.1.m: Just as all sacred fords purify through ritual ablution, giving gifts, and the like, / Arbuda destroys all sins of men merely by being seen.

14.1.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kiṃ pramāṇo'rbudo nāma kasmindeśe vyavasthitaḥ ..
kathaṃ vāsiṣṭhamāhātmyātprathito dharaṇītale .. 8 ..
14.1.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
किं प्रमाणोऽर्बुदो नाम कस्मिन्देशे व्यवस्थितः ..
कथं वासिष्ठमाहात्म्यात्प्रथितो धरणीतले .. 8 ..
14.1.m:
The seers said:
Of what size is Arbuda, in what region is it situated, / and how has it become celebrated upon the earth through the māhātmya of Vasiṣṭha?

14.1.s:
kāni tīrthāni mukhyāni hyarbude saṃti parvate ..
sarvaṃ vistarato brūhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ .. 9 ..
14.1.d:
कानि तीर्थानि मुख्यानि ह्यर्बुदे संति पर्वते ..
सर्वं विस्तरतो ब्रूहि परं कौतूहलं हि नः .. 9 ..
14.1.m: What principal sacred fords are there on Mount Arbuda? / Tell us everything in detail, for great indeed is our curiosity.

14.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ahaṃ ca saṃpravakṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm ..
arbudasya dvijaśreṣṭhā māhātmyaṃ ca yathā śrutam .. 7.3.1.10 ..
14.1.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अहं च संप्रवक्ष्यामि कथां पापप्रणाशिनीम् ..
अर्बुदस्य द्विजश्रेष्ठा माहात्म्यं च यथा श्रुतम् .. 7.3.1.10 ..
14.1.m:
Sūta said:
And I shall relate the sin-destroying story, / O best of the twice-born, and the māhātmya of Arbuda just as it was heard.

14.1.s:
vasiṣṭho nāma devarṣiḥ pitāmahasamudbhavaḥ ..
sa pūrvaṃ bhūtalaṃ prāptastapastepe sudāruṇam .. 11 ..
14.1.d:
वसिष्ठो नाम देवर्षिः पितामहसमुद्भवः ..
स पूर्वं भूतलं प्राप्तस्तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम् .. 11 ..
14.1.m: There was a divine seer named Vasiṣṭha, born from the Grandfather [Brahmā]; / he formerly came to the earth and performed very severe austerity.

14.1.s:
niyato niyatāhāraḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ ..
varṣāsvākāśavāsī ca hemaṃte salilāśayaḥ .. 12 ..
14.1.d:
नियतो नियताहारः सर्वभूतहिते रतः ..
वर्षास्वाकाशवासी च हेमंते सलिलाशयः .. 12 ..
14.1.m: Restrained, eating regulated food, devoted to the welfare of all beings, / he dwelt in the open air during the rains, and stayed in water in winter;

14.1.s:
paṃcāgnisādhako grīṣme japahomaparāyaṇaḥ ..
kenacittvatha kālena tasya dhenuḥ payasvinī ..
naṃdinīti suvikhyātā sā vai kāmadughā śubhā .. 13 ..
14.1.d:
पंचाग्निसाधको ग्रीष्मे जपहोमपरायणः ..
केनचित्त्वथ कालेन तस्य धेनुः पयस्विनी ..
नंदिनीति सुविख्याता सा वै कामदुघा शुभा .. 13 ..
14.1.m: He practiced the five fires in summer, devoted to silent recitation and oblations. / Then after some time, his milch-cow— / the auspicious, wish-yielding cow well-known as Nandinī—

14.1.s:
sā kadāciddharāpṛṣṭhe bhramamāṇā tṛṇāśayā ..
patitā dāruṇe śvabhre agādhe timirāvṛte .. 14 ..
14.1.d:
सा कदाचिद्धरापृष्ठे भ्रममाणा तृणाशया ..
पतिता दारुणे श्वभ्रे अगाधे तिमिरावृते .. 14 ..
14.1.m: Once wandering upon the surface of the earth in search of grass, / fell into a terrible, bottomless chasm shrouded in darkness.

14.1.s:
etasminneva kāle tu bhagavāṃstīkṣṇadīdhitiḥ ..
astaṃ gato na saṃprāptā naṃdinī munisattamāḥ .. 15 ..
14.1.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु भगवांस्तीक्ष्णदीधितिः ..
अस्तं गतो न संप्राप्ता नंदिनी मुनिसत्तमाः .. 15 ..
14.1.m: At that very time, the lord of sharp rays [the Sun] / set, O best of sages, and Nandinī had not returned.

14.1.s:
tasyāḥ kṣīreṇa nityaṃ sa sāyaṃ prātardvijo muniḥ ..
karoti homamagnau hi susamiddhe jitavrataḥ .. 16 ..
14.1.d:
तस्याः क्षीरेण नित्यं स सायं प्रातर्द्विजो मुनिः ..
करोति होममग्नौ हि सुसमिद्धे जितव्रतः .. 16 ..
14.1.m: With her milk, morning and evening every day, that twice-born sage, / having mastered his vows, would offer oblations into the well-kindled fire.

14.1.s:
atha ciṃtāparo vipraḥ prāyaścittabhayāddhruvam ..
vīkṣāṃcakre vane tasminsameṣu viṣameṣu ca .. 17 ..
14.1.d:
अथ चिंतापरो विप्रः प्रायश्चित्तभयाद्ध्रुवम् ..
वीक्षांचक्रे वने तस्मिन्समेषु विषमेषु च .. 17 ..
14.1.m: Then, anxious out of fear of [incurring] expiation, / the brahmin searched in that forest, through even and uneven ground.

14.1.s:
sa tacchvabhramathāsādya bhūṃbhārāvamathāśṛṇot ..
tāṃ provāca muniśreṣṭhaḥ kathaṃ tvaṃ patitā śubhe .. 18 ..
14.1.d:
स तच्छ्वभ्रमथासाद्य भूंभारावमथाशृणोत् ..
तां प्रोवाच मुनिश्रेष्ठः कथं त्वं पतिता शुभे .. 18 ..
14.1.m: Arriving at that chasm, he heard a lowing sound. / The best of sages said to her, “How did you fall, auspicious one?

14.1.s:
ahaṃ homasya codvegānniḥsṛtastvāmavekṣitum..
sā'bravīdbhakṣamāṇāhaṃ viprarṣe tṛṇavāṃchayā .. 19 ..
14.1.d:
अहं होमस्य चोद्वेगान्निःसृतस्त्वामवेक्षितुम्..
साऽब्रवीद्भक्षमाणाहं विप्रर्षे तृणवांछया .. 19 ..
14.1.m: Distressed about the fire sacrifice, I came out to look for you.” / She said, “O brahmin seer, grazing in desire for grass,

14.1.s:
patitātra vibho trāhi kṛcchrādasmātsuduḥsahāt ..
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa munirdhyāna māsthitaḥ .. 7.3.1.20 ..
14.1.d:
पतितात्र विभो त्राहि कृच्छ्रादस्मात्सुदुःसहात् ..
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा स मुनिर्ध्यान मास्थितः .. 7.3.1.20 ..
14.1.m: I fell in here, O lord; save me from this intolerable distress!” / Hearing that speech of hers, that sage entered into meditation.

14.1.s:
sarasvatīṃ samādadhyau nadīṃ trailokyapāvanīm ..
sā dhyātā manasā tena muninā tatra tatkṣaṇāt .. 21 ..
14.1.d:
सरस्वतीं समादध्यौ नदीं त्रैलोक्यपावनीम् ..
सा ध्याता मनसा तेन मुनिना तत्र तत्क्षणात् .. 21 ..
14.1.m: He fixed his mind on the Sarasvatī, the river that purifies the three worlds; / contemplated with the mind by that sage, she, at that very moment there,

14.1.s:
śvabhraṃ tatpūrayāmāsa samaṃtādvimalairjalaiḥ ..
paripūrṇaṃ tataḥ śvabhre niṣkrāṃtā naṃdinī tadā .. 22 ..
14.1.d:
श्वभ्रं तत्पूरयामास समंताद्विमलैर्जलैः ..
परिपूर्णं ततः श्वभ्रे निष्क्रांता नंदिनी तदा .. 22 ..
14.1.m: Filled that chasm all around with spotless waters; / then, when the chasm was completely filled, Nandinī emerged.

14.1.s: saṃhṛṣṭā muninā sārddhaṃ yayāvāśramasammukham .. 23 ..
14.1.d: संहृष्टा मुनिना सार्द्धं ययावाश्रमसम्मुखम् .. 23 ..
14.1.m: Rejoicing, she went towards the hermitage together with the sage.

14.1.s:
sa dṛṣṭvā śvabhramadhyaṃ taṃ gaṃbhīraṃ ca mahāmuniḥ ..
ciṃtayāmāsa medhāvī śvabhrasyaiva prapūraṇe .. 24 ..
14.1.d:
स दृष्ट्वा श्वभ्रमध्यं तं गंभीरं च महामुनिः ..
चिंतयामास मेधावी श्वभ्रस्यैव प्रपूरणे .. 24 ..
14.1.m: Seeing that interior of the chasm deep [and perilous], the great sage, / being wise, thought about completely filling the chasm.

14.1.s:
tasya ciṃtayato viprā buddhireṣodapadyata ..
ānīya parvataṃ muktvā śvabhrametatprapūryate ..
tasmādgacchāmyahaṃ śīghraṃ himavantaṃ nagottamam .. 25 ..
14.1.d:
तस्य चिंतयतो विप्रा बुद्धिरेषोदपद्यत ..
आनीय पर्वतं मुक्त्वा श्वभ्रमेतत्प्रपूर्यते ..
तस्माद्गच्छाम्यहं शीघ्रं हिमवन्तं नगोत्तमम् .. 25 ..
14.1.m: As he reflected, O brahmins, this thought arose: / “Only by bringing a mountain and placing it [here] can this chasm be filled; / therefore, I shall go quickly to Himavat, the best of mountains.

14.1.s:
sa eva parvataṃ cātra preṣayiṣyati bhūdharaḥ ..
yena syātparipūrṇaṃ ca śvabhrametanmahātmanā .. 26 ..
14.1.d:
स एव पर्वतं चात्र प्रेषयिष्यति भूधरः ..
येन स्यात्परिपूर्णं च श्वभ्रमेतन्महात्मना .. 26 ..
14.1.m: That mountain-king himself will send a mountain here, / so that by that noble one this chasm may be filled.”

14.1.s:
tato jagāma sa munirhimavantaṃ nagottamam ..
dṛṣṭvā vasiṣṭhamāyāṃtaṃ hima vānhṛṣṭamānasaḥ ..
arghyapādyādisaṃskāraiḥ saṃpūjya idamabravīt .. 27 ..
14.1.d:
ततो जगाम स मुनिर्हिमवन्तं नगोत्तमम् ..
दृष्ट्वा वसिष्ठमायांतं हिम वान्हृष्टमानसः ..
अर्घ्यपाद्यादिसंस्कारैः संपूज्य इदमब्रवीत् .. 27 ..
14.1.m: Then that sage went to Himavat, the best of mountains; / seeing Vasiṣṭha coming, Himavat, joyful in mind, / honored him with water for hospitality, water for the feet, and other rites, and said this:

14.1.s:
svāgataṃ te muniśreṣṭha saphalaṃ me'dya jīvitam ..
yadbhavānme gṛhe prāptaḥ pūjyaḥ sarvadivaukasām .. 28 ..
14.1.d:
स्वागतं ते मुनिश्रेष्ठ सफलं मेऽद्य जीवितम् ..
यद्भवान्मे गृहे प्राप्तः पूज्यः सर्वदिवौकसाम् .. 28 ..
14.1.m: “Welcome to you, O best of sages! Today my life is fruitful, / since you, who are worthy of worship by all the gods, have arrived at my home.

14.1.s:
brūhi kāryaṃ muniśreṣṭha api jīvitamātmanaḥ ..
nūnaṃ tubhyaṃ pradāsyāmi niyogo dīyatāṃ mama ..29..
14.1.d:
ब्रूहि कार्यं मुनिश्रेष्ठ अपि जीवितमात्मनः ..
नूनं तुभ्यं प्रदास्यामि नियोगो दीयतां मम ..29..
14.1.m: State your business, O best of sages! Even my own life / I will surely give to you; give me a command.”

14.1.s:
..vasiṣṭha uvāca.. ..
mamāśramasya sāṃnidhye śvabhramasti sudāruṇam ..
agādhaṃ nandinī tatra patitā dhenuruttamā .. 7.3.1.30 ..
14.1.d:
..वसिष्ठ उवाच.. ..
ममाश्रमस्य सांनिध्ये श्वभ्रमस्ति सुदारुणम् ..
अगाधं नन्दिनी तत्र पतिता धेनुरुत्तमा .. 7.3.1.30 ..
14.1.m:
Vasiṣṭha said:
Near my hermitage there is a very dreadful, / bottomless chasm; Nandinī, the excellent cow, fell into it.

14.1.s:
yatnādākarṣitā tasmādbhūyaḥ patanajādbhayāt ..
tavāṃtikamanuprāpto nānyo yogyo mahīpatiḥ .. 31 ..
14.1.d:
यत्नादाकर्षिता तस्माद्भूयः पतनजाद्भयात् ..
तवांतिकमनुप्राप्तो नान्यो योग्यो महीपतिः .. 31 ..
14.1.m: With effort she was pulled out from it; out of fear of her falling again, / I have come to your presence; no other lord of the earth is fit [for this].

14.1.s:
tasmātkañcinnagaśreṣṭhaṃ tatra preṣaya bhūdharam..
yena tatpūryate śvabhraṃ bhṛśaṃ preṣaya tādṛśam .. 32 ..
14.1.d:
तस्मात्कञ्चिन्नगश्रेष्ठं तत्र प्रेषय भूधरम्..
येन तत्पूर्यते श्वभ्रं भृशं प्रेषय तादृशम् .. 32 ..
14.1.m: Therefore, send some excellent mountain, a mountain-bearer, there, / by which that chasm may be filled; send such a one quickly.”

14.1.s:
.. himavānuvāca .. ..
kiṃpramāṇaṃ mune śvabhraṃ vistārāyāmato vada ..
tatpramāṇaṃ nagaṃ kaṃcitpreṣayāmi viciṃtya ca .. 33 ..
14.1.d:
.. हिमवानुवाच .. ..
किंप्रमाणं मुने श्वभ्रं विस्तारायामतो वद ..
तत्प्रमाणं नगं कंचित्प्रेषयामि विचिंत्य च .. 33 ..
14.1.m:
Himavat said:
What are the dimensions of the chasm, O sage? Tell me its breadth and length; / after considering, I will send some mountain of that measure.

14.1.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
dvisahasraṃ tu dairghyeṇa vistareṇa trisahasrakam..
na saṃkhyā vidyate'dhastāttasya parvatasattama .. 34 ..
14.1.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
द्विसहस्रं तु दैर्घ्येण विस्तरेण त्रिसहस्रकम्..
न संख्या विद्यतेऽधस्तात्तस्य पर्वतसत्तम .. 34 ..
14.1.m:
Vasiṣṭha said:
It is two thousand [yojanas] in length and three thousand in width; / below, there is no limit to it, O best of mountains.

14.1.s:
.. himavānuvāca .. ..
