kathaṃ tena pramāṇena sañjāto vivaro mahān..
abhūtkautūhalaṃ tena sarvaṃ vistarato vada .. 35 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe vasiṣṭhāśramasamīpavarti vivaravṛttāntopakramavarṇanaṃnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 1 ..
14.1.d:
.. हिमवानुवाच .. ..
कथं तेन प्रमाणेन सञ्जातो विवरो महान्..
अभूत्कौतूहलं तेन सर्वं विस्तरतो वद .. 35 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे वसिष्ठाश्रमसमीपवर्ति विवरवृत्तान्तोपक्रमवर्णनंनाम प्रथमोऽध्यायः .. 1 ..
14.1.m:
Himavat said:
How was a great hole formed of such dimensions? / A curiosity has arisen concerning it; tell me everything in detail.
Thus ends the first chapter, named 'Description of the Origin of the Account of the Hole Situated Near Vasiṣṭha's Hermitage', in the third Arbuda Section of the seventh Prabhāsa Section in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses.

14.2.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
āsītpūrvaṃ munirnāmnā gautamaśca mahātapāḥ ..
ahilyā dayitā tasya dharmapatnī yaśasvinī .. 1 ..
14.2.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
आसीत्पूर्वं मुनिर्नाम्ना गौतमश्च महातपाः ..
अहिल्या दयिता तस्य धर्मपत्नी यशस्विनी .. 1 ..
14.2.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / “Formerly there was a sage named Gautama, of great austerity. / His beloved, lawful, and renowned wife was Ahilyā.

14.2.s:
śiṣyānadhyāpayāmāsa sa muniḥ śataśastadā ..
śrutādhyayanasaṃpannānvisasarja tato gṛhān.. 2 ..
14.2.d:
शिष्यानध्यापयामास स मुनिः शतशस्तदा ..
श्रुताध्ययनसंपन्नान्विससर्ज ततो गृहान्.. 2 ..
14.2.m: That sage then instructed hundreds of disciples. / When they were accomplished in sacred learning and study, he dismissed them to their homes.

14.2.s:
tasyānyo'pi ca yaḥ śiṣyo gurubhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ..
uttaṃko nāma medhāvī nyavasattasya mandire .. 3 ..
14.2.d:
तस्यान्योऽपि च यः शिष्यो गुरुभक्तिपरायणः ..
उत्तंको नाम मेधावी न्यवसत्तस्य मन्दिरे .. 3 ..
14.2.m: There was also another disciple of his, devoted to service of the guru; / intelligent, named Uttaṅka, he dwelt in his abode.

14.2.s:
na taṃ visarjayāmāsa jarayāpi pariplutam..
uttaṃko'pi suśiṣyatvānno vetti palitaṃ śiraḥ .. 4 ..
14.2.d:
न तं विसर्जयामास जरयापि परिप्लुतम्..
उत्तंकोऽपि सुशिष्यत्वान्नो वेत्ति पलितं शिरः .. 4 ..
14.2.m: He did not dismiss him, even though overwhelmed by old age; / and Uttaṅka, because of being an exemplary disciple, did not even notice his graying head.

14.2.s:
jātakāryasamāyukto vidyāpāraṃgato'pi saḥ ..
kenacittvatha kālena kāṣṭhārthaṃ sa bahiryayau .. 5 ..
14.2.d:
जातकार्यसमायुक्तो विद्यापारंगतोऽपि सः ..
केनचित्त्वथ कालेन काष्ठार्थं स बहिर्ययौ .. 5 ..
14.2.m: Though he had mastered all knowledge and was equipped to perform his duties, / once, with the passing of time, he went outside for firewood.

14.2.s:
prabhūtāni samādāya āśramaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ..
athāsau nyakṣipattatra bhūtale kāṣṭhasaṃcayam.. 6 ..
14.2.d:
प्रभूतानि समादाय आश्रमं परमं गतः ..
अथासौ न्यक्षिपत्तत्र भूतले काष्ठसंचयम्.. 6 ..
14.2.m: Gathering a large quantity, he returned to the excellent hermitage. / Then he threw that bundle of firewood down upon the ground.

14.2.s:
kāṣṭhalagnāṃ tadā śvetāṃ jaṭāmekāṃ dadarśa saḥ ..
sa dṛṣṭvā duḥkhamāpannaḥ kṛpaṇaṃ paryacintayat ..7..
14.2.d:
काष्ठलग्नां तदा श्वेतां जटामेकां ददर्श सः ..
स दृष्ट्वा दुःखमापन्नः कृपणं पर्यचिन्तयत् ..7..
14.2.m: Then he saw a single white braid of matted hair caught in the firewood. / Seeing that, he was stricken with grief and thought miserably:

14.2.s:
dhigdhiṅme jīvitaṃ naṣṭaṃ kutaḥ kāryaratasya ca ..
kalatra saṃgrahaṃ naiva mayā kṛtamabuddhinā..8..
14.2.d:
धिग्धिङ्मे जीवितं नष्टं कुतः कार्यरतस्य च ..
कलत्र संग्रहं नैव मया कृतमबुद्धिना..8..
14.2.m: ‘Fie, fie! My life is ruined! For what purpose have I been occupied with work? / Senseless as I am, I have not even taken a wife!

14.2.s:
bhaviṣyati kulacchedaḥ śaithilyānmama durmateḥ..
gurupatnyā ca saṃdṛṣṭa uttaṃko duḥkhitastadā..9..
14.2.d:
भविष्यति कुलच्छेदः शैथिल्यान्मम दुर्मतेः..
गुरुपत्न्या च संदृष्ट उत्तंको दुःखितस्तदा..9..
14.2.m: There will be an end to my lineage through the negligence of my foolish mind!’ / Then Uttaṅka, being distressed, was seen by the wife of the guru.

14.2.s:
tasya duḥkhaṃ tathā kṣipraṃ gautamāya nieveditam..
gautamena tathetyuktvā mṛduvāṇyā sa bhāṣitaḥ..7.3.2.10..
14.2.d:
तस्य दुःखं तथा क्षिप्रं गौतमाय निएवेदितम्..
गौतमेन तथेत्युक्त्वा मृदुवाण्या स भाषितः..7.3.2.10..
14.2.m: His grief was promptly reported to Gautama. / Gautama, saying ‘So be it,’ spoke to him with gentle words:

14.2.s:
vatsa gaccha gṛhaṃ tvaṃ ca agnihotrādikāḥ kriyāḥ..
pālayasva vidhānena patnyā saha na saṃśayaḥ .. 11 ..
14.2.d:
वत्स गच्छ गृहं त्वं च अग्निहोत्रादिकाः क्रियाः..
पालयस्व विधानेन पत्न्या सह न संशयः .. 11 ..
14.2.m: ‘Child, go home, and duly perform the agnihotra and other rites / together with a wife, without a doubt.’

14.2.s:
ityukto guruṇā so'pi pratyuvāca guruṃ prati ..
dakṣiṇāṃ prārthaya svāminnahaṃ dāsyāmyasaṃśayam .. 12 ..
14.2.d:
इत्युक्तो गुरुणा सोऽपि प्रत्युवाच गुरुं प्रति ..
दक्षिणां प्रार्थय स्वामिन्नहं दास्याम्यसंशयम् .. 12 ..
14.2.m: Having been spoken to thus by his guru, he replied to the guru: / ‘Ask for your sacrificial gift, master, and I will surely give it!’

14.2.s:
.. gautama uvāca .. ..
sevā kṛtā tvayā vatsa mahatī mama sarvadā ..
tenaiva paripūrṇatvaṃ jātaṃ me nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 13 .. ..
14.2.d:
.. गौतम उवाच .. ..
सेवा कृता त्वया वत्स महती मम सर्वदा ..
तेनैव परिपूर्णत्वं जातं मे नात्र संशयः .. 13 .. ..
14.2.m: Gautama said: / ‘Great service has always been done by you, my child; / by that alone my fullness is achieved, of this there is no doubt.’

14.2.s:
.. uttaṃka uvāca .. ..
kiṃcidgrāhyaṃ tvayā svāminsantoṣo jāyate mama ..
tvatprasādānmuniśreṣṭha vidyāpāraṃgato'smyaham .. 14 ..
14.2.d:
.. उत्तंक उवाच .. ..
किंचिद्ग्राह्यं त्वया स्वामिन्सन्तोषो जायते मम ..
त्वत्प्रसादान्मुनिश्रेष्ठ विद्यापारंगतोऽस्म्यहम् .. 14 ..
14.2.m: Uttaṅka said: / ‘Something must be accepted by you, master, so that I may find satisfaction. / By your favor, best of sages, I have mastered all knowledge.’

14.2.s:
.. gautama uvāca .. ..
na grāhyaṃ ca mayā putra santuṣṭaḥ sevayāsmyaham ..
necchāmyahaṃ dhanaṃ tvattaḥ sukhaṃ gaccha gṛhaṃ prati .. 15 ..
14.2.d:
.. गौतम उवाच .. ..
न ग्राह्यं च मया पुत्र सन्तुष्टः सेवयास्म्यहम् ..
नेच्छाम्यहं धनं त्वत्तः सुखं गच्छ गृहं प्रति .. 15 ..
14.2.m: Gautama said: / ‘Nothing is to be accepted by me, son; I am satisfied with your service. / I desire no wealth from you; go happily to your home.’

14.2.s:
ityukto guruṇā so'pi mātaraṃ cābhyabhāṣata ..
kiṃcidgrāhyaṃ mayā mātaḥ santoṣo dīyatāṃ mama .. 16 ..
14.2.d:
इत्युक्तो गुरुणा सोऽपि मातरं चाभ्यभाषत ..
किंचिद्ग्राह्यं मया मातः सन्तोषो दीयतां मम .. 16 ..
14.2.m: Having been addressed thus by his guru, he also spoke to the mother: / ‘Something must be received [from me], Mother; let satisfaction be granted to me!’

14.2.s:
.. gurupatnyuvāca .. ..
saudāsaṃ gaccha putra tvaṃ mamājñāṃ kuru satvaram ..
madayantī priyā tasya dharmapatnī yaśasvinī .. 17 ..
14.2.d:
.. गुरुपत्न्युवाच .. ..
सौदासं गच्छ पुत्र त्वं ममाज्ञां कुरु सत्वरम् ..
मदयन्ती प्रिया तस्य धर्मपत्नी यशस्विनी .. 17 ..
14.2.m: The guru's wife said: / ‘Go to Saudāsa, son; quickly carry out my order. / His beloved, lawful, and renowned wife is Madayantī.

14.2.s:
kuṇḍale'thānaya kṣipraṃ madayaṃtyāśca putraka ..
no cecchāpaṃ pradāsyāmi pañcame'hni na āgataḥ .. 18 ..
14.2.d:
कुण्डलेऽथानय क्षिप्रं मदयंत्याश्च पुत्रक ..
नो चेच्छापं प्रदास्यामि पञ्चमेऽह्नि न आगतः .. 18 ..
14.2.m: Bring quickly the two earrings of Madayantī, my dear boy; / otherwise I will pronounce a curse, if you have not returned by the fifth day.’

14.2.s:
ityukto gurupatnyā sa prasthitaḥ satvaraṃ tadā ..
saudāsasyagṛhaṃ prāpa vyāghrāsyaṃ taṃ ca dṛṣṭavān .. 19 ..
14.2.d:
इत्युक्तो गुरुपत्न्या स प्रस्थितः सत्वरं तदा ..
सौदासस्यगृहं प्राप व्याघ्रास्यं तं च दृष्टवान् .. 19 ..
14.2.m: Addressed thus by the guru's wife, he immediately departed. / He reached Saudāsa's house and saw that he had the face of a tiger.

14.2.s:
dṛṣṭvā prāha tadā vipraṃ bhakṣaṇārthamupasthitam ..
bhakṣayiṣyāmi vai vipra tvāmahaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 7.3.2.20 ..
14.2.d:
दृष्ट्वा प्राह तदा विप्रं भक्षणार्थमुपस्थितम् ..
भक्षयिष्यामि वै विप्र त्वामहं नात्र संशयः .. 7.3.2.20 ..
14.2.m: Seeing him, he then said to the brahmin who had approached to be eaten: / ‘I shall certainly devour you, O brahmin; there is no doubt about this.’

14.2.s:
.. uttaṃka uvāca .. ..
avaśyaṃ bhakṣaya tvaṃ māmekaṃ śṛṇu narādhipa ..
dehi me kuṇḍale tāta dattvā'haṃ gurave punaḥ ..
āgamiṣyāmi bhakṣasva mā tvaṃ kāryavivarjitam .. 21 ..
14.2.d:
.. उत्तंक उवाच .. ..
अवश्यं भक्षय त्वं मामेकं शृणु नराधिप ..
देहि मे कुण्डले तात दत्त्वाऽहं गुरवे पुनः ..
आगमिष्यामि भक्षस्व मा त्वं कार्यविवर्जितम् .. 21 ..
14.2.m: Uttaṅka said: / ‘Devour me by all means, but hear one thing, O lord of men: / give me the two earrings, friend; having given them to my guru, / I will return. Devour me then, when my task is done.’

14.2.s:
.. saudāsa uvāca .. ..
gaccha tvaṃ mandire durge yatrā''ste dayitā mama ..
tāṃ tvamāsādya yatnena jīvitavyabhayāddvija .. 22 ..
14.2.d:
.. सौदास उवाच .. ..
गच्छ त्वं मन्दिरे दुर्गे यत्रा'ऽस्ते दयिता मम ..
तां त्वमासाद्य यत्नेन जीवितव्यभयाद्द्विज .. 22 ..
14.2.m: Saudāsa said: / ‘Go to the fortress-abode where my beloved resides. / Approaching her with effort, O twice-born, out of fear for your life,

14.2.s:
yācyatāṃ mama vākyena sā te dāsyati kuṇḍale ..
tvayā ca nānyathā kāryaṃ yatsatyaṃ dvijasattama .. 23 ..
14.2.d:
याच्यतां मम वाक्येन सा ते दास्यति कुण्डले ..
त्वया च नान्यथा कार्यं यत्सत्यं द्विजसत्तम .. 23 ..
14.2.m: let her be asked in my name; she will give you the two earrings. / And you must not act contrary to what is true, O best of the twice-born.’

14.2.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
madayantyāḥ samīpaṃ tu gatvovāca dvijottamaḥ ..
dehi me kuṇḍale devi saudāsastvāṃ samādiśat ..24..
14.2.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
मदयन्त्याः समीपं तु गत्वोवाच द्विजोत्तमः ..
देहि मे कुण्डले देवि सौदासस्त्वां समादिशत् ..24..
14.2.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / Having gone into the presence of Madayantī, the best of the twice-born said: / ‘Give me the two earrings, O queen; Saudāsa has commanded you.’

14.2.s:
.. madayaṃtyuvāca .. ..
sandeho'dyāpi me vipra kuṇḍale dvijasattama ..
abhijñānaṃ tvamānīya nṛpasya dvija darśaya .. 25 ..
14.2.d:
.. मदयंत्युवाच .. ..
सन्देहोऽद्यापि मे विप्र कुण्डले द्विजसत्तम ..
अभिज्ञानं त्वमानीय नृपस्य द्विज दर्शय .. 25 ..
14.2.m: Madayantī said: / ‘I still have doubt, O brahmin, best of the twice-born, regarding the earrings. / Bring a token of recognition from the king and show it [to me], O twice-born!’

14.2.s: sa gatvā tvaritaṃ bhūpamabhijñānamayācata .. 26 ..
14.2.d: स गत्वा त्वरितं भूपमभिज्ञानमयाचत .. 26 ..
14.2.m: He went swiftly to the king and asked for a token of recognition.

14.2.s:
.. saudāsa uvāca .. ..
yairvinā sugatirnāsti durgatiṃ ye nayaṃti vai ..
gatvaivaṃ brūhi tāṃ sādhvīṃ mama vākyaṃ dvijottama ..
pradāsyati tato nūnaṃ kuṇḍale ratnamaṃḍite .. 27 ..
14.2.d:
.. सौदास उवाच .. ..
यैर्विना सुगतिर्नास्ति दुर्गतिं ये नयंति वै ..
गत्वैवं ब्रूहि तां साध्वीं मम वाक्यं द्विजोत्तम ..
प्रदास्यति ततो नूनं कुण्डले रत्नमंडिते .. 27 ..
14.2.m: Saudāsa said: / ‘Without whom there is no good state, and who surely lead to a wretched state— / go and speak my words thus to that virtuous lady, O best of the twice-born; / then she will certainly give the two gem-studded earrings.’

14.2.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
pratyabhijñānamādāya gatvā tasyai nyavedayat .. 28 ..
14.2.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
प्रत्यभिज्ञानमादाय गत्वा तस्यै न्यवेदयत् .. 28 ..
14.2.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / Taking the token of recognition, he went and reported it to her.

14.2.s:
tato'sau pradadau tasmai gṛhṇa me kuṇḍale dvija ..
uvāca yatnamāsthāya nīyatāṃ dvijasattama .. 29 ..
14.2.d:
ततोऽसौ प्रददौ तस्मै गृह्ण मे कुण्डले द्विज ..
उवाच यत्नमास्थाय नीयतां द्विजसत्तम .. 29 ..
14.2.m: Then she gave them to him: ‘Take my two earrings, O twice-born.’ / She said, ‘Taking great care, let them be carried away, O best of the twice-born.

14.2.s:
ete ca vāṃchate nityaṃ takṣako dvija kuṇḍale ..
sa tatheti samādāya vismayotphullalocanaḥ ..
kautukātpunarāgatya rājānaṃ vākyamabravīt..7.3.2.30..
14.2.d:
एते च वांछते नित्यं तक्षको द्विज कुण्डले ..
स तथेति समादाय विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनः ..
कौतुकात्पुनरागत्य राजानं वाक्यमब्रवीत्..7.3.2.30..
14.2.m: Takṣaka constantly desires these two earrings, O twice-born.’ / Agreeing with ‘So be it,’ his eyes wide with wonder, / he returned to the king out of curiosity and spoke these words:

14.2.s:
abhijñānānmayā bhūpa samprāpte dīptakuṇḍale ..
vākyārthastu na vijñātastato'haṃ punarāgataḥ ..31..
14.2.d:
अभिज्ञानान्मया भूप सम्प्राप्ते दीप्तकुण्डले ..
वाक्यार्थस्तु न विज्ञातस्ततोऽहं पुनरागतः ..31..
14.2.m: ‘By means of the token of recognition, O king, the two radiant earrings have been obtained by me; / but the meaning of the words was not understood, and therefore I have come back.’

14.2.s:
kautukādvada me rājansvakārye ca yathāsthitam ..
kairvinā sugatirnāsti durgatiṃ ke nayaṃti ca .. 32 ..
14.2.d:
कौतुकाद्वद मे राजन्स्वकार्ये च यथास्थितम् ..
कैर्विना सुगतिर्नास्ति दुर्गतिं के नयंति च .. 32 ..
14.2.m: Out of curiosity, tell me, O king, how it truly stands in your own case: / Without whom is there no good realm, and who leads one into misfortune?

14.2.s:
.. saudāsa uvāca .. ..
ārādhitā dvijā vipra bhavaṃti sugatipradāḥ ..
asantuṣṭā durgatidāḥ sadyo mama yathā purā ..33 ..
14.2.d:
.. सौदास उवाच .. ..
आराधिता द्विजा विप्र भवंति सुगतिप्रदाः ..
असन्तुष्टा दुर्गतिदाः सद्यो मम यथा पुरा ..33 ..
14.2.m: Saudāsa said: / When gratified, O brahmin, the twice-born grant a good realm; / when displeased, they grant misfortune at once, just as befell me long ago.

14.2.s:
etāvānmama śāpo'yaṃ vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ..
tenoktaṃ tvāṃ yadā kaścitpraśnaṃ vikhyāpayiṣyati .. 34 ..
14.2.d:
एतावान्मम शापोऽयं वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः..
तेनोक्तं त्वां यदा कश्चित्प्रश्नं विख्यापयिष्यति .. 34 ..
14.2.m: This curse of mine from the great-souled Vasiṣṭha was to last only until now. / By him it was said: ‘When someone shall set forth a question to you,

14.2.s:
tadā doṣavinirmukto bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ..
tvatprasādādvinirmukto hyahaṃ śāpāddvijottama ..
sāttvikaṃ dhāma cāpanno gaccha vipra namo'stu te .. 35 ..
14.2.d:
तदा दोषविनिर्मुक्तो भविष्यसि न संशयः ..
त्वत्प्रसादाद्विनिर्मुक्तो ह्यहं शापाद्द्विजोत्तम ..
सात्त्विकं धाम चापन्नो गच्छ विप्र नमोऽस्तु ते .. 35 ..
14.2.m: then you shall be freed from your transgression, without a doubt.’ / By your favor, indeed, I am freed from the curse, O best of brahmins, / and have attained the sāttvika abode. Go, O brahmin, homage to you!

14.2.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca.. ..
uttaṃkastena nirmuktaḥ satvaraṃ pathamāśritaḥ ..
gacchaṃścātikṣudhāviṣṭo 'paśyadbilvaphalāni saḥ .. 36 ..
14.2.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच.. ..
उत्तंकस्तेन निर्मुक्तः सत्वरं पथमाश्रितः ..
गच्छंश्चातिक्षुधाविष्टो ऽपश्यद्बिल्वफलानि सः .. 36 ..
14.2.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / Released by him, Uttaṅka quickly set out upon the path. / As he went, overcome with intense hunger, he saw bilva fruits.

14.2.s:
tataḥ kṛṣṇājine baddhvā kuṇḍale nyasya bhūtale ..
āruroha phalākāṃkṣī sa muniḥ kṣudhayā'nvitaḥ .. 37 ..
14.2.d:
ततः कृष्णाजिने बद्ध्वा कुण्डले न्यस्य भूतले ..
आरुरोह फलाकांक्षी स मुनिः क्षुधयाऽन्वितः .. 37 ..
14.2.m: Then, having tied the two earrings in a black antelope skin and placed them on the ground, / that sage, afflicted with hunger and desiring fruit, climbed [the tree].

14.2.s:
etasminneva kāle tu takṣakaḥ pannagottamaḥ ..
gṛhītvā kuṇḍale tūrṇamagamaddakṣiṇāmukhaḥ .. 38 ..
14.2.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु तक्षकः पन्नगोत्तमः ..
गृहीत्वा कुण्डले तूर्णमगमद्दक्षिणामुखः .. 38 ..
14.2.m: At that very moment, Takṣaka, the best of serpents, / took the two earrings and swiftly went facing the south.

14.2.s:
athottaṃkaḥ phalāhārī avatīrya dharātale ..
sarvato'nveṣayāmāsa vegena mahatā vṛtaḥ .. 39 ..
14.2.d:
अथोत्तंकः फलाहारी अवतीर्य धरातले ..
सर्वतोऽन्वेषयामास वेगेन महता वृतः .. 39 ..
14.2.m: Then Uttaṅka, having eaten the fruit and descended to the surface of the earth, / searched everywhere, filled with great haste.

14.2.s:
sa dṛṣṭvā sammukhaṃ prāptaṃ samīpaṃ pannagottamaḥ ..
praviveśa bilaṃ raudramandhakāreṇa saṃvṛtam .. 7.3.2.40 ..
14.2.d:
स दृष्ट्वा सम्मुखं प्राप्तं समीपं पन्नगोत्तमः ..
प्रविवेश बिलं रौद्रमन्धकारेण संवृतम् .. 7.3.2.40 ..
14.2.m: Having seen him coming near and facing him, the best of serpents / entered a dread chasm enveloped in darkness.

14.2.s:
uttaṃko'pi bilaṃ prāptaḥ praviśya tamasāvṛtam..
daṇḍakāṣṭhaṃ samādāya kupitohyakhanattadā .. .. 41 ..
14.2.d:
उत्तंकोऽपि बिलं प्राप्तः प्रविश्य तमसावृतम्..
दण्डकाष्ठं समादाय कुपितोह्यखनत्तदा .. .. 41 ..
14.2.m: Uttaṅka also reached the chasm, and entering it, filled with darkness, / he took a wooden staff and, furious, began to dig.

14.2.s:
taṃ tathā duḥkhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sakleśaṃ gurukāryataḥ ..
vajramāropayāmāsa daṇḍāṃte pākaśāsanaḥ ..42..
14.2.d:
तं तथा दुःखितं दृष्ट्वा सक्लेशं गुरुकार्यतः ..
वज्रमारोपयामास दण्डांते पाकशासनः ..42..
14.2.m: Seeing him so distressed, suffering on account of his guru's business, / Indra placed the thunderbolt at the end of the staff.

14.2.s:
tato vidārayāmāsa sa śīghraṃ dharaṇītalam ..
praviṣṭaścaiva pātālaṃ kuṇḍalārthaṃ paribhraman ..43..
14.2.d:
ततो विदारयामास स शीघ्रं धरणीतलम् ..
प्रविष्टश्चैव पातालं कुण्डलार्थं परिभ्रमन् ..43..
14.2.m: Then he swiftly tore open the surface of the earth, / and, wandering about for the sake of the earrings, entered Pātāla.

14.2.s:
so'paśyadvājinaṃ tatra sarvaśvetaṃ guṇānvitam..
tenoktaḥ spṛśa me guhyaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati ..44..
14.2.d:
सोऽपश्यद्वाजिनं तत्र सर्वश्वेतं गुणान्वितम्..
तेनोक्तः स्पृश मे गुह्यं ततः कार्यं भविष्यति ..44..
14.2.m: There he saw an entirely white horse endowed with fine qualities. / He was told by it: ‘Touch my anus; then your purpose will be achieved.’

14.2.s:
sa cakāra tathā śīghraṃ tato dhūmo vyajāyata ..
pātālaṃ tena sarvatra vyāptaṃ bhūdhara vahninā .. 45 ..
14.2.d:
स चकार तथा शीघ्रं ततो धूमो व्यजायत ..
पातालं तेन सर्वत्र व्याप्तं भूधर वह्निना .. 45 ..
14.2.m: He quickly did so, and from it smoke arose; / through it, O mountain, Pātāla was everywhere filled with fire.

14.2.s:
tataśca vyākulāḥ sarve pannagāḥ samupādravan..
takṣakaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā saṃprāptāḥ kuṇḍalānvitāḥ ..
uttaṃkāya tato dattvā praṇipatya yayurgṛham.. 46 ..
14.2.d:
ततश्च व्याकुलाः सर्वे पन्नगाः समुपाद्रवन्..
तक्षकं पुरतः कृत्वा संप्राप्ताः कुण्डलान्विताः ..
उत्तंकाय ततो दत्त्वा प्रणिपत्य ययुर्गृहम्.. 46 ..
14.2.m: Then all the serpents, bewildered, came running; / placing Takṣaka at their head, they arrived with the earrings. / Giving them to Uttaṅka and bowing down, they went home.

14.2.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
athāśvastamuvācedamahamagnirdvijottama ..
yastvayā''rādhitaḥ pūrvamupādhyāyanideśataḥ .. 47 ..
14.2.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
अथाश्वस्तमुवाचेदमहमग्निर्द्विजोत्तम ..
यस्त्वया'ऽराधितः पूर्वमुपाध्यायनिदेशतः .. 47 ..
14.2.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / Then the horse spoke to him: ‘I am Agni, O best of brahmins, / who was propitiated by you previously at the instruction of your teacher.

14.2.s:
jñātvā tvāṃ duḥkhitaṃ prāptamiha prāptaḥ kṛpāparaḥ ..
sarvathā tvaṃ ca me pṛṣṭhaṃ bhagavañchīghramāruha .. 48 ..
14.2.d:
ज्ञात्वा त्वां दुःखितं प्राप्तमिह प्राप्तः कृपापरः ..
सर्वथा त्वं च मे पृष्ठं भगवञ्छीघ्रमारुह .. 48 ..
14.2.m: Knowing that you had arrived distressed, I have come here out of deep compassion. / By all means, O venerable one, quickly mount my back.

14.2.s:
nayāmi tatra yatrāste guruḥ sarvaguṇālayaḥ ..
ārūḍhastasya pṛṣṭhe sa pratasthe hyāśramaṃ prati .. 49 ..
14.2.d:
नयामि तत्र यत्रास्ते गुरुः सर्वगुणालयः ..
आरूढस्तस्य पृष्ठे स प्रतस्थे ह्याश्रमं प्रति .. 49 ..
14.2.m: I will take you to where your guru, the abode of all virtues, dwells.’ / Having mounted its back, he departed toward the hermitage.

14.2.s:
tatkṣaṇātsamanuprāpto gautamasya niveśanam ..
etasminneva kāle tu ahilyā kṛtamaṃḍanā ..7.3.2.50..
14.2.d:
तत्क्षणात्समनुप्राप्तो गौतमस्य निवेशनम् ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु अहिल्या कृतमंडना ..7.3.2.50..
14.2.m: In that very moment he reached the dwelling of Gautama. / At that very time, Ahilyā, having adorned herself

14.2.s:
snātā cābhyetya bhartāraṃ sādhvī vākyamuvāca ha ..
uttaṃko'dya na saṃprāptaḥ śāpaṃ dāsyāmyahaṃ dhruvam .. 51 ..
14.2.d:
स्नाता चाभ्येत्य भर्तारं साध्वी वाक्यमुवाच ह ..
उत्तंकोऽद्य न संप्राप्तः शापं दास्याम्यहं ध्रुवम् .. 51 ..
14.2.m: and bathed, approached her husband and spoke these words, virtuous woman: / ‘Uttaṅka has not arrived today; I will surely cast a curse [on him]!

14.2.s:
śithilo gurukṛtyeṣu sa yadālakṣito mayā ..
tasyā vākyāvasāne tu uttaṃkaḥ paryyadṛśyata .. 52 ..
14.2.d:
शिथिलो गुरुकृत्येषु स यदालक्षितो मया ..
तस्या वाक्यावसाने तु उत्तंकः पर्य्यदृश्यत .. 52 ..
14.2.m: For he has been seen by me to be lax in his duties toward his guru.’ / But as her words ended, Uttaṅka came into view.

14.2.s:
prasannavadano hṛṣṭaḥ kuṇḍalābhyāṃ samanvitaḥ ..
praṇipatya sa tāṃ bhaktyā kuṇḍale saṃnyavedayat .. 53 ..
14.2.d:
प्रसन्नवदनो हृष्टः कुण्डलाभ्यां समन्वितः ..
प्रणिपत्य स तां भक्त्या कुण्डले संन्यवेदयत् .. 53 ..
14.2.m: With a serene face, delighted, possessing the two earrings, / having bowed down to her with devotion, he presented the earrings.

14.2.s:
sā dṛṣṭvā tatkṣaṇātsādhvī karṇābhyāṃ saṃnyaveśayat..
svagṛhāya tatastūrṇamuttaṃkaṃ visasarja ha .. 54 ..
14.2.d:
सा दृष्ट्वा तत्क्षणात्साध्वी कर्णाभ्यां संन्यवेशयत्..
स्वगृहाय ततस्तूर्णमुत्तंकं विससर्ज ह .. 54 ..
14.2.m: Seeing them, that virtuous woman immediately placed them on her two ears. / Then she swiftly dismissed Uttaṅka to his own home.

14.2.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
evaṃ sa vivaro jātastakṣakottaṃkakāraṇāt ..
yathā me ciṃtyate nityaṃ dhenvarthaṃ śvabhrapūraṇe .. 55 ..
14.2.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
एवं स विवरो जातस्तक्षकोत्तंककारणात् ..
यथा मे चिंत्यते नित्यं धेन्वर्थं श्वभ्रपूरणे .. 55 ..
14.2.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / Thus that chasm was created on account of Takṣaka and Uttaṅka, / about which I constantly worry regarding the filling of the pit for the cow's sake.

14.2.s:
tasmāttvaṃ pūraya kṣipraṃ nānyaḥ śakto'tra karmaṇi ..
śīghraṃ kuru nagaśreṣṭha mama kāryamasaṃśayam .. 56 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekā śītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe vivarotpattivṛttāṃte gautamaśiṣyottaṃkacaritravarṇanaṃnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ .. 2 ..
14.2.d:
तस्मात्त्वं पूरय क्षिप्रं नान्यः शक्तोऽत्र कर्मणि ..
शीघ्रं कुरु नगश्रेष्ठ मम कार्यमसंशयम् .. 56 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एका शीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडे विवरोत्पत्तिवृत्तांते गौतमशिष्योत्तंकचरित्रवर्णनंनाम द्वितीयोऽध्यायः .. 2 ..
14.2.m:
Therefore, fill it quickly; no other is capable of this task. / Quickly perform my business, O best of mountains, without a doubt.
Thus ends the second chapter, entitled ‘The Description of the Deeds of Gautama's Disciple Uttaṅka, in the Account of the Origin of the Chasm,’ in the Arbuda Section of the third Prabhāsa Section, in the Great Purāṇa of Śrī Skanda, in the collection of eighty-one thousand verses.

14.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
śrutvā himācalo vākyaṃ vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ..
cintayāmāsa tatkāryaṃ vivarasya prapūraṇe..1..
14.3.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
श्रुत्वा हिमाचलो वाक्यं वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः..
चिन्तयामास तत्कार्यं विवरस्य प्रपूरणे..1..
14.3.m: Sūta said: / Having heard the word of the great-souled Vasiṣṭha, Himācala / reflected on that task of filling the chasm.

14.3.s:
ciraṃ vicārya tamṛṣimidamāha nagottamaḥ..
ka upāyo nagānāṃ vai tatra gaṃtuṃ vadasva me ..2..
14.3.d:
चिरं विचार्य तमृषिमिदमाह नगोत्तमः..
क उपायो नगानां वै तत्र गंतुं वदस्व मे ..2..
14.3.m: Having reflected for a long time, the best of mountains said this to the ṛṣi: / ‘Tell me, what means is there for mountains to go there?

14.3.s:
pakṣacchedastu śakreṇa sarveṣāṃ ca purā kṛtaḥ ..
tasmādasya muniśreṣṭha kāryasya paśya niścayam..3.. ..
14.3.d:
पक्षच्छेदस्तु शक्रेण सर्वेषां च पुरा कृतः ..
तस्मादस्य मुनिश्रेष्ठ कार्यस्य पश्य निश्चयम्..3.. ..
14.3.m: For Indra cut off the wings of all [mountains] long ago. / Therefore, O best of sages, see the determination of this task.’

14.3.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
astyupāyo nagānāṃ tu tatra netuṃ mahānaga ..
tavāyaṃ tanayastatra vikhyāto naṃdivarddhanaḥ ..4..
14.3.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
अस्त्युपायो नगानां तु तत्र नेतुं महानग ..
तवायं तनयस्तत्र विख्यातो नंदिवर्द्धनः ..4..
14.3.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / There is a means, O great mountain, to convey mountains there: / this famous son of yours, Nandivardhana, is there.

14.3.s:
tasyārbuda iti khpāto vayasyaḥ paramaṃ priyaḥ ..
nāgaḥ prāṇabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ khecaro'pi ca vīryavān ..5..
14.3.d:
तस्यार्बुद इति ख्पातो वयस्यः परमं प्रियः ..
नागः प्राणभृतां श्रेष्ठः खेचरोऽपि च वीर्यवान् ..5..
14.3.m: He has an exceedingly dear friend known as Arbuda, / a serpent, the best of living beings, who moves through the sky and is mighty.

14.3.s:
sa vā ūrdhvagatiḥ kṣipraṃ kṣaṇānneṣyatyasaṃśayaḥ ..
līlayā sarvakṛtyeṣu taṃ viditvā'hamāgataḥ ..6..
14.3.d:
स वा ऊर्ध्वगतिः क्षिप्रं क्षणान्नेष्यत्यसंशयः ..
लीलया सर्वकृत्येषु तं विदित्वाऽहमागतः ..6..
14.3.m: Possessing upward flight, he will quickly carry [him] in a moment, without a doubt. / Knowing that he is effortless in all tasks, I have come.

14.3.s:
ādeśo dīyatāmasya duḥkhaṃ kartuṃ ca nārhasi ..
avaśyaṃ yadi bhakto'si tatra preṣaya satvaram..7..
14.3.d:
आदेशो दीयतामस्य दुःखं कर्तुं च नार्हसि ..
अवश्यं यदि भक्तोऽसि तत्र प्रेषय सत्वरम्..7..
14.3.m: Let an order be given to him; you ought not to cause sorrow. / If you are truly devoted, send him there quickly.

14.3.s:
..sūta uvāca.. ..
vasiṣṭhasya vacaḥ śrutvā himavānputravatsalaḥ ..
duḥkhena mahatā''viṣṭaściṃtayāmāsa bhūdharaḥ ..8..
14.3.d:
..सूत उवाच.. ..
वसिष्ठस्य वचः श्रुत्वा हिमवान्पुत्रवत्सलः ..
दुःखेन महता'ऽविष्टश्चिंतयामास भूधरः ..8..
14.3.m: Sūta said: / Hearing the words of Vasiṣṭha, Himavat, who loves his sons, / was overcome with great grief, and the mountain thought:

14.3.s:
mainākastanayo'smākaṃ praviṣṭaḥ sāgare bhayāt ..
jyeṣṭhaṃ tu sarvathā cātha vasiṣṭho netumāgataḥ ..
kiṃ kṛtyamadhunā'smākaṃ kathaṃ śreyo bhaviṣyati .. 9 ..
14.3.d:
मैनाकस्तनयोऽस्माकं प्रविष्टः सागरे भयात् ..
ज्येष्ठं तु सर्वथा चाथ वसिष्ठो नेतुमागतः ..
किं कृत्यमधुनाऽस्माकं कथं श्रेयो भविष्यति .. 9 ..
14.3.m: ‘Our son Maināka has entered the ocean out of fear; / and now Vasiṣṭha has come to take away the eldest by all means. / What is our duty now? How will welfare arise?

14.3.s:
itaḥ śāpabhayaṃ tīvramito duḥkhaṃ ca putrajam..
varaṃ putraviyogo'stu na śāpo dvijasaṃbhavaḥ .. 7.3.3.10 ..
14.3.d:
इतः शापभयं तीव्रमितो दुःखं च पुत्रजम्..
वरं पुत्रवियोगोऽस्तु न शापो द्विजसंभवः .. 7.3.3.10 ..
14.3.m: On this side is the fierce fear of a curse; on that side is the sorrow born of [losing] a son. / Better that separation from a son should occur, not a curse born of a twice-born.’

14.3.s:
sa evaṃ niścayaṃ kṛtvā naṃdivardhanamuktavān ..
gaccha tvaṃ putra me vākyādvasiṣṭhasyāśramaṃ prati .. 11 ..
14.3.d:
स एवं निश्चयं कृत्वा नंदिवर्धनमुक्तवान् ..
गच्छ त्वं पुत्र मे वाक्याद्वसिष्ठस्याश्रमं प्रति .. 11 ..
14.3.m: Having thus made a decision, he said to Nandivardhana: / ‘Go, my son, at my word, toward the hermitage of Vasiṣṭha.

14.3.s:
tatrāsti vivaro raudrastaṃ prapūraya satvaram ..
arbudaṃ nāgamādāya mitraṃ prāṇabhṛtāṃ varam .. 12 ..
14.3.d:
तत्रास्ति विवरो रौद्रस्तं प्रपूरय सत्वरम् ..
अर्बुदं नागमादाय मित्रं प्राणभृतां वरम् .. 12 ..
14.3.m: A dread chasm is there; fill it quickly, / taking the serpent Arbuda, your friend, the best of living beings.’

14.3.s:
.. naṃdivarddhana uvāca .. ..
pāpīyānsa vibho deśaḥ phalamūlairvivarjitaḥ ..
pālāśaiḥ khādirairāḍhyo dhavaiḥ śālmalibhistathā .. 13 ..
14.3.d:
.. नंदिवर्द्धन उवाच .. ..
पापीयान्स विभो देशः फलमूलैर्विवर्जितः ..
पालाशैः खादिरैराढ्यो धवैः शाल्मलिभिस्तथा .. 13 ..
14.3.m: Nandivardhana said: / ‘O lord, that region is very wretched, devoid of fruits and roots, / full of palāśa, khadira, dhava, and śālmali trees.’

14.3.s:
suniṣṭhurairnṛpaśubhirbhillaiśca vividhairapi ..
nadyo vahaṃti no tatra duṣṭā lokāśca vāsinaḥ ..
nārho'haṃ parvataśreṣṭha tatra gaṃtuṃ kathaṃcana .. 14 ..
14.3.d:
सुनिष्ठुरैर्नृपशुभिर्भिल्लैश्च विविधैरपि ..
नद्यो वहंति नो तत्र दुष्टा लोकाश्च वासिनः ..
नार्होऽहं पर्वतश्रेष्ठ तत्र गंतुं कथंचन .. 14 ..
14.3.m: with extremely cruel human-beasts and various Bhils. / No rivers flow there, and wicked are the people dwelling there. / I am not fit, O best of mountains, to go there under any circumstances."

14.3.s:
athovāca vasiṣṭhastaṃ saṃtrastaṃ naṃdivarddhanam ..
mā bhīḥ kāryā tvayā tatra deśe dauṣṭyātkathaṃcana .. 15 ..
14.3.d:
अथोवाच वसिष्ठस्तं संत्रस्तं नंदिवर्द्धनम् ..
मा भीः कार्या त्वया तत्र देशे दौष्ट्यात्कथंचन .. 15 ..
14.3.m: Then Vasiṣṭha spoke to the terrified Nandivardhana: / "You must not have any fear on account of the wickedness in that country.

14.3.s:
tava mūrdhni sadā vāso mama tatra bhaviṣyati ..
tīrthāni sarito devāḥ puṇyānyāyatanāni ca .. 16 ..
14.3.d:
तव मूर्ध्नि सदा वासो मम तत्र भविष्यति ..
तीर्थानि सरितो देवाः पुण्यान्यायतनानि च .. 16 ..
14.3.m: My abode will always be there upon your head, / as will sacred fords, rivers, deities, and sacred shrines.

14.3.s:
vṛkṣāśca vividhākārāḥ patrapuṣpaphalānvitāḥ ..
sadā tatra bhaviṣyaṃti mṛgāśca vihagāḥ śubhāḥ .. 17 ..
14.3.d:
वृक्षाश्च विविधाकाराः पत्रपुष्पफलान्विताः ..
सदा तत्र भविष्यंति मृगाश्च विहगाः शुभाः .. 17 ..
14.3.m: Trees of various forms, endowed with leaves, flowers, and fruits, / and auspicious beasts and birds will always be there.

14.3.s:
ahamevānayiṣyāmi tavārthe ca maheśvaram ..
tadā sthāsyaṃti vai tatra sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ .. .. 18 ..
14.3.d:
अहमेवानयिष्यामि तवार्थे च महेश्वरम् ..
तदा स्थास्यंति वै तत्र सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः .. .. 18 ..
14.3.m: I myself will bring Maheśvara for your sake; / then all the gods, along with Indra, will indeed dwell there."

14.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
vasiṣṭhasya vacaḥ śrutva saṃhṛṣṭo naṃdivarddhanaḥ ..
arbudaṃ nāgamāsādya vākyametaduvāca ha .. 19 ..
14.3.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
वसिष्ठस्य वचः श्रुत्व संहृष्टो नंदिवर्द्धनः ..
अर्बुदं नागमासाद्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 19 ..
14.3.m: Sūta said: / Having heard the words of Vasiṣṭha, Nandivardhana rejoiced, / approached the serpent Arbuda, and spoke these words:

14.3.s:
tatra yāvo'dya bhadraṃ te vayasya vinayānvita ..
etatkāryamahaṃ manye sāṃprataṃ dvijasaṃbhavam .. 7.3.3.20 ..
14.3.d:
तत्र यावोऽद्य भद्रं ते वयस्य विनयान्वित ..
एतत्कार्यमहं मन्ये सांप्रतं द्विजसंभवम् .. 7.3.3.20 ..
14.3.m: "Let us two go there today, may all be well with you, O humble friend! / I consider this deed, arising for the sake of the twice-born, [to be done] right now."

14.3.s:
.. arbuda uvāca .. ..
ahaṃ tatrāgamiṣyāmi snehātte parvatātmaja ..
tatraiva ca vasiṣyāmi tvayā sārddhamasaṃśayam.. 21 ..
14.3.d:
.. अर्बुद उवाच .. ..
अहं तत्रागमिष्यामि स्नेहात्ते पर्वतात्मज ..
तत्रैव च वसिष्यामि त्वया सार्द्धमसंशयम्.. 21 ..
14.3.m: Arbuda said: / "I will come there out of love for you, O son of the mountain! / And I will reside right there together with you, without a doubt.

14.3.s:
kiṃ tvahaṃ praṇayādbhrātarvakṣyāmi yadvacaḥ śṛṣu ..
praṇayānnānyathā kāryaṃ yadyahaṃ tava saṃmataḥ .. 22 ..
14.3.d:
किं त्वहं प्रणयाद्भ्रातर्वक्ष्यामि यद्वचः शृषु ..
प्रणयान्नान्यथा कार्यं यद्यहं तव संमतः .. 22 ..
14.3.m: However, my brother, hear the request which I will make out of affection; / out of affection it should not be disregarded, if I am dear to you.

14.3.s:
mannāmnā khyātimāyātu nānyatkiṃcidvṛṇomyaham..
tataḥ so'pi pratijñāya ārūḍhastasya copari ..
praṇamya pitarau caiva pratasthe muninā saha .. 23 ..
14.3.d:
मन्नाम्ना ख्यातिमायातु नान्यत्किंचिद्वृणोम्यहम्..
ततः सोऽपि प्रतिज्ञाय आरूढस्तस्य चोपरि ..
प्रणम्य पितरौ चैव प्रतस्थे मुनिना सह .. 23 ..
14.3.m: May [the place] attain renown by my name; I choose nothing else." / Then he too, having promised, mounted upon him, / and, bowing to both his parents, set out with the sage.

14.3.s:
divyairvṛkṣaiḥ śubhaiḥ pūrṇairnadīnirjharasaṃkulaiḥ ..
madhurairvihagairyukto mṛgaiḥ saumyaiḥ samanvitaḥ .. 24 ..
14.3.d:
दिव्यैर्वृक्षैः शुभैः पूर्णैर्नदीनिर्झरसंकुलैः ..
मधुरैर्विहगैर्युक्तो मृगैः सौम्यैः समन्वितः .. 24 ..
14.3.m: Filled with divine, auspicious trees, crowded with rivers and waterfalls, / accompanied by melodious birds, endowed with gentle beasts,

14.3.s:
mukto'rbudena tatraiva vivare munivākyataḥ ..
samastastatrānāsāgraṃ gataḥ parvatasattamaḥ .. 25 ..
14.3.d:
मुक्तोऽर्बुदेन तत्रैव विवरे मुनिवाक्यतः ..
समस्तस्तत्रानासाग्रं गतः पर्वतसत्तमः .. 25 ..
14.3.m: the best of mountains, completely [filling it] up to the rim of its nose, / was set down into the chasm right there by Arbuda, upon the word of the sage.

14.3.s:
vimukto vivare tasminnarbudena mahātmanā ..
paripūrṇe mahāraudre saṃtuṣṭo munipuṃgavaḥ .. 26 ..
14.3.d:
विमुक्तो विवरे तस्मिन्नर्बुदेन महात्मना ..
परिपूर्णे महारौद्रे संतुष्टो मुनिपुंगवः .. 26 ..
14.3.m: When it was released into that chasm by the noble-minded Arbuda, / and the terrible [chasm] was completely filled, the best of sages was delighted.

14.3.s:
bravīccārbudaṃ nāgaṃ varaṃ varaya suvrata ..
parituṣṭo'smi te bhadra karmaṇānena pannaga .. 27 ..
14.3.d:
ब्रवीच्चार्बुदं नागं वरं वरय सुव्रत ..
परितुष्टोऽस्मि ते भद्र कर्मणानेन पन्नग .. 27 ..
14.3.m: He said to the serpent Arbuda: "Choose a boon, O one of noble vows! / I am well-pleased with you, O serpent, on account of this deed, auspicious one!"

14.3.s:
.. arbuda uvāca .. ..
eṣa eva varo'smākaṃ yattvaṃ tuṣṭo mahāmune ..
avaśyaṃ yadi dātavyaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva dvijottama .. 28 ..
14.3.d:
.. अर्बुद उवाच .. ..
एष एव वरोऽस्माकं यत्त्वं तुष्टो महामुने ..
अवश्यं यदि दातव्यं तच्छृणुष्व द्विजोत्तम .. 28 ..
14.3.m: Arbuda said: / "This alone is a boon for us, that you are pleased, O great sage! / If it must certainly be given, then listen, O best of the twice-born:

14.3.s:
yaccaitacchikhare hyasminnirjharaṃ nirmalodakam ..
nāgatīrthamiti khyātiṃ bhūtale yātu sarvataḥ .. 29 ..
14.3.d:
यच्चैतच्छिखरे ह्यस्मिन्निर्झरं निर्मलोदकम् ..
नागतीर्थमिति ख्यातिं भूतले यातु सर्वतः .. 29 ..
14.3.m: Let whatever spring of clear water is on this peak / attain renown everywhere on the face of the earth as Nāgatīrtha.

14.3.s:
atraivāhaṃ vasiṣyāmi mitrasnehātsadā mune ..
tatra snātvā divaṃ yātu mānavastvatprasādataḥ .. 7.3.3.30 ..
14.3.d:
अत्रैवाहं वसिष्यामि मित्रस्नेहात्सदा मुने ..
तत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यातु मानवस्त्वत्प्रसादतः .. 7.3.3.30 ..
14.3.m: I shall dwell right here always, O sage, out of love for my friend. / Having bathed there, may a human go to heaven by your grace.

14.3.s:
api vaṃdhyā ca yā nārī snānamātraṃ samācaret..
sā syātputravatī vipra sukhasaubhāgyasaṃyutā .. 31 ..
14.3.d:
अपि वंध्या च या नारी स्नानमात्रं समाचरेत्..
सा स्यात्पुत्रवती विप्र सुखसौभाग्यसंयुता .. 31 ..
14.3.m: Even a barren woman who merely performs a ritual ablution, / let her become endowed with a son, O brahmin, and possessing happiness and good fortune."

14.3.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
yā vaṃdhyāsmiñjale pūrṇe snānamātraṃ kariṣyati ..
sāpi putramavāpnoti sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam .. 32 ..
14.3.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
या वंध्यास्मिञ्जले पूर्णे स्नानमात्रं करिष्यति ..
सापि पुत्रमवाप्नोति सर्वलक्षणलक्षितम् .. 32 ..
14.3.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / "A barren woman who merely performs a ritual ablution in this full water, / she too shall obtain a son endowed with all auspicious marks.

14.3.s:
nabhasaḥ śuklapaṃcamyāṃ phalaiḥ pūjāṃ karoti ca ..
api varṣaśatā nārī sā bhaviṣyati putriṇī .. 33 ..
14.3.d:
नभसः शुक्लपंचम्यां फलैः पूजां करोति च ..
अपि वर्षशता नारी सा भविष्यति पुत्रिणी .. 33 ..
14.3.m: And on the bright fifth day of Śrāvaṇa, if she worships with fruits, / even a woman of a hundred years will become possessed of sons.

14.3.s:
ye'tra snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti hyasmiṃstīrthe ca bhaktitaḥ ..
yāsyaṃti te paraṃ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam .. 34 ..
14.3.d:
येऽत्र स्नानं करिष्यंति ह्यस्मिंस्तीर्थे च भक्तितः ..
यास्यंति ते परं स्थानं जरामरणवर्जितम् .. 34 ..
14.3.m: Those who perform a ritual ablution here at this sacred ford with devotion, / they will go to the supreme abode, free from old age and death.

14.3.s:
śrāddhaṃ cātra kariṣyaṃti paṃcamyāṃ ye samāhitāḥ ..
māse nabhasi tīrthasya phalaṃ teṣāṃ bhaviṣyati .. 35 ..
14.3.d:
श्राद्धं चात्र करिष्यंति पंचम्यां ये समाहिताः ..
मासे नभसि तीर्थस्य फलं तेषां भविष्यति .. 35 ..
14.3.m: And those who, attentive, perform a ancestral rite here on the fifth day / in the month of Śrāvaṇa, will attain the fruit of the sacred ford."

14.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ dattvā varaṃ tasya vasiṣṭho bhagavānmuniḥ ..
naṃdivarddhanamabhyetya vākyametaduvāca ha .. 36 ..
14.3.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं दत्त्वा वरं तस्य वसिष्ठो भगवान्मुनिः ..
नंदिवर्द्धनमभ्येत्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 36 ..
14.3.m: Sūta said: / Having thus granted him a boon, the venerable sage Vasiṣṭha / approached Nandivardhana and spoke these words:

14.3.s:
varaṃ ca vriyatāṃ vatsa parituṣṭo'smi te'nagha ..
vinayātsauhṛdātsarvaṃ dāsyāmi yatsudurllabham.. 37 ..
14.3.d:
वरं च व्रियतां वत्स परितुष्टोऽस्मि तेऽनघ ..
विनयात्सौहृदात्सर्वं दास्यामि यत्सुदुर्ल्लभम्.. 37 ..
14.3.m: "Choose a boon, child; I am pleased with you, sinless one. / Out of [your] humility and affection, I will grant whatever is extremely difficult to obtain."

14.3.s:
.. naṃdivarddhana uvāca .. ..
tavāstu vacanaṃ satyaṃ pūrvoktaṃ munisattama ..
sāṃnidhyaṃ jāyatāmatra avaśyaṃ tava sarvadā .. 38 ..
14.3.d:
.. नंदिवर्द्धन उवाच .. ..
तवास्तु वचनं सत्यं पूर्वोक्तं मुनिसत्तम ..
सांनिध्यं जायतामत्र अवश्यं तव सर्वदा .. 38 ..
14.3.m: Nandivardhana said: / "Let your word spoken previously be true, O best of sages; / let your presence certainly remain here forever.

14.3.s:
yathāhamarbudetyevaṃ khyātiṃ gacchāmi bhūtale ..
prasādāccaiva te bhūyādetanme manasi sthitam .. 39 ..
14.3.d:
यथाहमर्बुदेत्येवं ख्यातिं गच्छामि भूतले ..
प्रसादाच्चैव ते भूयादेतन्मे मनसि स्थितम् .. 39 ..
14.3.m: And let it be so that I attain renown on the face of the earth as Arbuda; / by your grace, may this be, which rests in my heart."

14.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evamastviti taṃ procya vasiṣṭho bhagavānmuniḥ ..
cakre svamāśramaṃ tatra tasya vākyena noditaḥ .. 7.3.3.40 ..
14.3.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवमस्त्विति तं प्रोच्य वसिष्ठो भगवान्मुनिः ..
चक्रे स्वमाश्रमं तत्र तस्य वाक्येन नोदितः .. 7.3.3.40 ..
14.3.m: Sūta said: / Saying to him, "So be it," the venerable sage Vasiṣṭha, / impelled by his word, made his hermitage there.

14.3.s:
panasaiścaṃpakairāmraiḥ priyaṃgubilvadāḍimaiḥ ..
nānāpakṣisamāyukto devagandharvasevitaḥ .. 41 ..
14.3.d:
पनसैश्चंपकैराम्रैः प्रियंगुबिल्वदाडिमैः ..
नानापक्षिसमायुक्तो देवगन्धर्वसेवितः .. 41 ..
14.3.m: Abounding in jackfruit, campaka, mango, priyaṅgu, bilva, and pomegranate trees, / filled with various birds, frequented by gods and gandharvas,

14.3.s:
tasthau tatra muniśreṣṭho hyaruṃdhatyā samanvitaḥ ..
gomatīmānayāmāsa tapasā munisattamaḥ .. 42 ..
14.3.d:
तस्थौ तत्र मुनिश्रेष्ठो ह्यरुंधत्या समन्वितः ..
गोमतीमानयामास तपसा मुनिसत्तमः .. 42 ..
14.3.m: there the best of sages dwelt, together with Arundhatī. / The best of sages brought the Gomatī through austerity,

14.3.s:
yasyāṃ snātvā divaṃ yāṃti atipāpakṛto narāḥ ..
māghamāse viśeṣeṇa makarasthe divākare .. 43 ..
14.3.d:
यस्यां स्नात्वा दिवं यांति अतिपापकृतो नराः ..
माघमासे विशेषेण मकरस्थे दिवाकरे .. 43 ..
14.3.m: bathing in which even men who have committed extreme sins go to heaven, / especially in the month of Māgha when the sun stands in Capricorn.

14.3.s: yetra snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti te yāsyaṃti parāṃ gatim ..44..
14.3.d: येत्र स्नानं करिष्यंति ते यास्यंति परां गतिम् ..44..
14.3.m: Those who perform a ritual ablution here will attain the supreme state.

14.3.s:
māghamāse viśeṣeṇa tiladānaṃ karoti yaḥ ..
tilasaṃkhyāni varṣāṇi svarge tiṣṭhati mānavaḥ .. 45 ..
14.3.d:
माघमासे विशेषेण तिलदानं करोति यः ..
तिलसंख्यानि वर्षाणि स्वर्गे तिष्ठति मानवः .. 45 ..
14.3.m: Whoever especially gives a gift of sesame seeds in the month of Māgha, / that human remains in heaven for as many years as the number of sesame seeds.

14.3.s: bahunā kimihoktena stānamātraṃ samācaret .. 46 ..
14.3.d: बहुना किमिहोक्तेन स्तानमात्रं समाचरेत् .. 46 ..
14.3.m: What need is there of saying much here? One should merely perform a ritual ablution.

14.3.s:
vasiṣṭhasya mukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā punarjanma na vidyate ..
aruṃdhatī pūjanīyā pūjanīyā viśeṣataḥ .. 47 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe vasiṣṭhājñayā nandivardhanaparvatena vivarapūraṇavarṇanaṃnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ..3 ..
14.3.d:
वसिष्ठस्य मुखं दृष्ट्वा पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते ..
अरुंधती पूजनीया पूजनीया विशेषतः .. 47 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे वसिष्ठाज्ञया नन्दिवर्धनपर्वतेन विवरपूरणवर्णनंनाम तृतीयोऽध्यायः ..3 ..
14.3.m:
Upon seeing the face of Vasiṣṭha, there is no rebirth. / Arundhatī is to be worshipped, especially to be worshipped.
Thus ends the third chapter, named 'Description of the Filling of the Chasm by Mount Nandivardhana by the Command of Vasiṣṭha,' in the Arbudakhaṇḍa, the third [part] in the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [part] of the venerable Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

14.4.s:
sūta uvāca .. ..
sa kṛtvā svāśramaṃ tatra vasiṣṭho bhagavānmuniḥ ..
tatra śaṃbhornivāsāya tapastepe sudāruṇam.. 1 ..
14.4.d:
सूत उवाच .. ..
स कृत्वा स्वाश्रमं तत्र वसिष्ठो भगवान्मुनिः ..
तत्र शंभोर्निवासाय तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम्.. 1 ..
14.4.m: Sūta said: / Having established his hermitage there, the venerable sage Vasiṣṭha / performed extremely severe austerity for the sake of Śambhu's dwelling there.

14.4.s:
sa babhūva muniḥ samyakphalāhārasamanvitaḥ ..
śīrṇa parṇāśanaḥ paścāddve śate samapadyata .. 2 ..
14.4.d:
स बभूव मुनिः सम्यक्फलाहारसमन्वितः ..
शीर्ण पर्णाशनः पश्चाद्द्वे शते समपद्यत .. 2 ..
14.4.m: The sage subsisted fully on a diet of fruit; / afterwards, he spent two hundred [years] eating fallen leaves.

14.4.s:
jalāhāraḥ pañcaśatavarṣāṇi saṃbabhūva ha ..
varṣāṇāṃ vāyubhakṣo'bhūttato daśaśatāni ca .. 3 ..
14.4.d:
जलाहारः पञ्चशतवर्षाणि संबभूव ह ..
वर्षाणां वायुभक्षोऽभूत्ततो दशशतानि च .. 3 ..
14.4.m: He subsisted on water for five hundred years; / then for a thousand years he lived on air.

14.4.s:
pañcāgnisādhako grīṣme hemante salilāśayaḥ ..
varṣāsvākāśavāsī ca sahasraṃ ca tato'bhavat .. 4 ..
14.4.d:
पञ्चाग्निसाधको ग्रीष्मे हेमन्ते सलिलाशयः ..
वर्षास्वाकाशवासी च सहस्रं च ततोऽभवत् .. 4 ..
14.4.m: Practicing the five fires in summer, dwelling in water in winter, / and staying in the open air during the rains, a thousand [years] then passed.

14.4.s:
tatastuṣṭo mahādevastasyarṣeḥ sumahātmanaḥ ..
bhittvā taṃ parvataṃ sadyastatpuro liṃgamutthitam ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayāviṣṭo muniḥ stotramudairayat.. 5 ..
14.4.d:
ततस्तुष्टो महादेवस्तस्यर्षेः सुमहात्मनः ..
भित्त्वा तं पर्वतं सद्यस्तत्पुरो लिंगमुत्थितम् ..
तं दृष्ट्वा विस्मयाविष्टो मुनिः स्तोत्रमुदैरयत्.. 5 ..
14.4.m: Then Mahādeva, pleased with that great-souled seer, / split open that mountain, and a liṅga immediately arose before him. / Seeing it, filled with wonder, the sage uttered a hymn of praise:

14.4.s:
namaḥ śivāya śuddhāya sarvagāyā'mṛtāya ca ..
kaparddine namastubhyaṃ namastasmai trimūrttaye .. 6 ..
14.4.d:
नमः शिवाय शुद्धाय सर्वगायाऽमृताय च ..
कपर्द्दिने नमस्तुभ्यं नमस्तस्मै त्रिमूर्त्तये .. 6 ..
14.4.m: "Obeisance to Śiva, the pure, the omnipresent, and the immortal! / Obeisance to you who have matted hair; obeisance to him of threefold form!

14.4.s:
namaḥ sthūlāya sūkṣmāya vyāpakāya mahātmane ..
niṣaṃgiṇe namastubhyaṃ trinetrāya namonamaḥ .. 7 ..
14.4.d:
नमः स्थूलाय सूक्ष्माय व्यापकाय महात्मने ..
निषंगिणे नमस्तुभ्यं त्रिनेत्राय नमोनमः .. 7 ..
14.4.m: Homage to the gross, to the subtle, to the all-pervading, to the great Self! / Homage to you who hold a quiver; homage, homage to the three-eyed one! 7

14.4.s:
namaścandrakalādhāra namo digvasanāya ca ..
pinākapāṇaye tubhyamaṣṭamūrte namonamaḥ .. 8..
14.4.d:
नमश्चन्द्रकलाधार नमो दिग्वसनाय च ..
पिनाकपाणये तुभ्यमष्टमूर्ते नमोनमः .. 8..
14.4.m: Homage to the bearer of the crescent moon; homage to him whose garment is space! / Homage to you with Pināka in hand; homage, homage to the eight-formed one! 8

14.4.s:
namaste jñānarūpāya jñānagamyāya te namaḥ ..
namaste jñānadehāya sarvajñānamayāya ca .. 9 ..
14.4.d:
नमस्ते ज्ञानरूपाय ज्ञानगम्याय ते नमः ..
नमस्ते ज्ञानदेहाय सर्वज्ञानमयाय च .. 9 ..
14.4.m: Homage to you whose form is knowledge; homage to you who are accessible through knowledge! / Homage to you whose body is knowledge, and who are composed of all knowledge! 9

14.4.s:
kāśīpate namastubhyaṃ giriśāya namonamaḥ ..
jagatkāraṇarūpāya mahādevāya te namaḥ .. 7.3.4.10 ..
14.4.d:
काशीपते नमस्तुभ्यं गिरिशाय नमोनमः ..
जगत्कारणरूपाय महादेवाय ते नमः .. 7.3.4.10 ..
14.4.m: Homage to you, lord of Kāśī; homage, homage to the mountain-dweller! / Homage to you, Mahādeva, whose form is the cause of the universe! 10

14.4.s:
gaurīkānta nama stubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ śivātmane ..
brahmaviṣṇusvarūpāya trinetrāya namonamaḥ .. 11 ..
14.4.d:
गौरीकान्त नम स्तुभ्यं नमस्तुभ्यं शिवात्मने ..
ब्रह्मविष्णुस्वरूपाय त्रिनेत्राय नमोनमः .. 11 ..
14.4.m: O beloved of Gaurī, homage to you; homage to you whose essence is Śiva! / Homage, homage to the three-eyed one, who has the nature of Brahmā and Viṣṇu! 11

14.4.s:
viśvarūpāya śuddhāya namastubhyaṃ mahātmane ..
namo viśvasvarūpāya sarvadevamayāya ca .. 12 ..
14.4.d:
विश्वरूपाय शुद्धाय नमस्तुभ्यं महात्मने ..
नमो विश्वस्वरूपाय सर्वदेवमयाय च .. 12 ..
14.4.m: Homage to you, the universal-formed, the pure, the great Self! / Homage to you whose nature is the universe, and who are composed of all the gods! 12

14.4.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī ..
parituṣṭo'smi te bhadraṃ varaṃ varaya suvrata .. 13 ..
14.4.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु वागुवाचाशरीरिणी ..
परितुष्टोऽस्मि ते भद्रं वरं वरय सुव्रत .. 13 ..
14.4.m: Sūta said: / Just at that time, an incorporeal voice spoke: / “I am well pleased with you; may you have good fortune! Choose a boon, O you of noble vows!” 13

14.4.s: ityuktvā parvataṃ bhittvā tatpuro liṃgamutthitam .. 14 ..
14.4.d: इत्युक्त्वा पर्वतं भित्त्वा तत्पुरो लिंगमुत्थितम् .. 14 ..
14.4.m: Having said this, a liṅga burst through the mountain and arose before him. 14

14.4.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
liṃge'smiṃstava sāṃnidhyaṃ sadā bhavatu śaṃkara ..
mayā pūrvaṃ pratijñātaṃ nagasyeha mahātmane ..
satyaṃ kuru vaco me tvaṃ yadi tuṣṭo'si śaṃkara .. 15 ..
14.4.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
लिंगेऽस्मिंस्तव सांनिध्यं सदा भवतु शंकर ..
मया पूर्वं प्रतिज्ञातं नगस्येह महात्मने ..
सत्यं कुरु वचो मे त्वं यदि तुष्टोऽसि शंकर .. 15 ..
14.4.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / “May your presence always remain in this liṅga, O Śaṃkara! / I previously made a promise here to the great-souled mountain. / Make my word true, if you are pleased, O Śaṃkara!” 15

14.4.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
adyaprabhṛti liṃge'sminsāṃnidhyaṃ me bhaviṣyati ..
tvadvākyādbrāhmaṇaśreṣṭha sarvaṃ satyaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 16 ..
14.4.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
अद्यप्रभृति लिंगेऽस्मिन्सांनिध्यं मे भविष्यति ..
त्वद्वाक्याद्ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठ सर्वं सत्यं भविष्यति .. 16 ..
14.4.m: The Holy Lord said: / “From this day forth, my presence shall be in this liṅga. / By your word, O best of brahmins, everything shall come true. 16

14.4.s:
stotreṇānena yo martyo māṃ staviṣyati bhaktitaḥ ..
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāmāśvine munisattama .. 17 ..
14.4.d:
स्तोत्रेणानेन यो मर्त्यो मां स्तविष्यति भक्तितः ..
कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्यामाश्विने मुनिसत्तम .. 17 ..
14.4.m: Whatever mortal praises me with devotion using this hymn / on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight in Āśvina, O best of sages— 17

14.4.s:
matpriyārthaṃ tu śakreṇa preṣitā munisattama ..
mandākinīti vikhyātā nadī trailokyapāvinī .. 18 ..
14.4.d:
मत्प्रियार्थं तु शक्रेण प्रेषिता मुनिसत्तम ..
मन्दाकिनीति विख्याता नदी त्रैलोक्यपाविनी .. 18 ..
14.4.m: and sent by Śakra for my pleasure, O best of sages, / the river famed as Mandākinī, which purifies the three worlds, 18

14.4.s:
devasyottaradigbhāge kuṃḍaṃ tiṣṭhati nityaśaḥ ..
tasyāṃ snātvā muniśreṣṭha liṃgaṃ me paśyate tu yaḥ ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam .. 19 ..
14.4.d:
देवस्योत्तरदिग्भागे कुंडं तिष्ठति नित्यशः ..
तस्यां स्नात्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठ लिंगं मे पश्यते तु यः ..
स याति परमं स्थानं जरामरणवर्जितम् .. 19 ..
14.4.m: has a pool that remains constantly on the northern side of the god. / Having bathed in it, O best of sages, whoever beholds my liṅga / goes to the supreme abode, free from old age and death. 19

14.4.s:
acalaṃ bhedayitvā tu yasmānme liṃgamudgatam..
acaleśvaranāmnaiva loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati .. 7.3.4.20 ..
14.4.d:
अचलं भेदयित्वा तु यस्मान्मे लिंगमुद्गतम्..
अचलेश्वरनाम्नैव लोके ख्यातिं गमिष्यति .. 7.3.4.20 ..
14.4.m: Because my liṅga has burst forth through the mountain (acala), / it shall attain fame in the world by the very name ‘Acaleśvara’. 20

14.4.s:
asya liṃgasya māhātmyānna kadāciccaliṣyati ..
sarvathā ma idaṃ liṃgaṃ pralayānte na cālyate .. 21 ..
14.4.d:
अस्य लिंगस्य माहात्म्यान्न कदाचिच्चलिष्यति ..
सर्वथा म इदं लिंगं प्रलयान्ते न चाल्यते .. 21 ..
14.4.m: By virtue of the māhātmya of this liṅga, it shall never move. / By every means, this liṅga of mine will not be moved even at the end of dissolution.” 21

14.4.s:
.. sūta uvāca ..
etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ virarāma maheśvaraḥ ..
vasiṣṭho'pi suhṛṣṭātmā gautamādyā munīśvarāḥ .. 22 ..
14.4.d:
.. सूत उवाच ..
एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं विरराम महेश्वरः ..
वसिष्ठोऽपि सुहृष्टात्मा गौतमाद्या मुनीश्वराः .. 22 ..
14.4.m: Sūta said: / Having spoken this word, Maheśvara fell silent. / Vasiṣṭha too, his mind delighted, and Gautama and the other lords of sages, 22

14.4.s:
śakrādayastato devāstīrthānyāyatanāni ca ..
ānayāmāsa brahmarṣistapasā parvatottame .. 23 ..
14.4.d:
शक्रादयस्ततो देवास्तीर्थान्यायतनानि च ..
आनयामास ब्रह्मर्षिस्तपसा पर्वतोत्तमे .. 23 ..
14.4.m: as well as Śakra and the other gods, the sacred fords, and the temples, / the brahmin seer brought there to the best of mountains by his austerity. 23

14.4.s:
tatastuṣṭaḥ suraśreṣṭhastatra vāsamathākarot.. 24 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe'caleśvarotpatti varṇanaṃnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ .. 4 ..
14.4.d:
ततस्तुष्टः सुरश्रेष्ठस्तत्र वासमथाकरोत्.. 24 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडेऽचलेश्वरोत्पत्ति वर्णनंनाम चतुर्थोऽध्यायः .. 4 ..
14.4.m:
Pleased by that, the best of gods then took up residence there. 24
Thus ends the fourth chapter, titled ‘Description of the Origin of Acaleśvara,’ in the Arbuda Section, the third [section] of the Prabhāsa Section, in the seventh part of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 4

14.5.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
arbudasya ca māhātmyaṃ vistareṇa vadasva naḥ ..
kautukaṃ sūta no jātaṃ kathayasva yathā śubham .. 1 ..
14.5.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
अर्बुदस्य च माहात्म्यं विस्तरेण वदस्व नः ..
कौतुकं सूत नो जातं कथयस्व यथा शुभम् .. 1 ..
14.5.m: The seers said: / Tell us in detail the māhātmya of Arbuda. / Curiosity has arisen in us, O Sūta; relate it properly and auspiciously. 1

14.5.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
purāsīcca ṛṣiśreṣṭhaḥ pulastyo bhagavānmuniḥ ..
yayāteśca gṛhe yātastaṃ natvā cābravīnnṛpaḥ.. 2 .. .
14.5.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
पुरासीच्च ऋषिश्रेष्ठः पुलस्त्यो भगवान्मुनिः ..
ययातेश्च गृहे यातस्तं नत्वा चाब्रवीन्नृपः.. 2 .. .
14.5.m: Sūta said: / Long ago there was an excellent seer, the venerable sage Pulastya. / He went to the house of Yayāti, and having bowed to him, the king said: 2

14.5.s:
. yayātiruvāca .. ..
svāgataṃ te muniśreṣṭha saphalaṃ me'dyajīvitam ..
kathayasva prasādena kathāmarbudasaṃbhavām .. 3 ..
14.5.d:
. ययातिरुवाच .. ..
स्वागतं ते मुनिश्रेष्ठ सफलं मेऽद्यजीवितम् ..
कथयस्व प्रसादेन कथामर्बुदसंभवाम् .. 3 ..
14.5.m: Yayāti said: / “Welcome to you, O best of sages! My life is fruitful today. / By your grace, relate the story concerning the origin of Arbuda. 3

14.5.s:
arbudākhyo nago nāma vikhyāto yo dharātale ..
tasya yātrākramaṃ brūhi tatphalaṃ dvijasattama .. 4 ..
14.5.d:
अर्बुदाख्यो नगो नाम विख्यातो यो धरातले ..
तस्य यात्राक्रमं ब्रूहि तत्फलं द्विजसत्तम .. 4 ..
14.5.m: Regarding the mountain named Arbuda, celebrated on the surface of the earth, / declare the order of pilgrimage to it and its fruit, O best of the twice-born! 4

14.5.s:
sarvaṃ vistarato brūhi tīrthayātrāparāyaṇa ..
tasmādvada muniśreṣṭha yena yātrāṃ karomyaham ..5 ..
14.5.d:
सर्वं विस्तरतो ब्रूहि तीर्थयात्रापरायण ..
तस्माद्वद मुनिश्रेष्ठ येन यात्रां करोम्यहम् ..5 ..
14.5.m: Tell everything in detail, devoted as you are to pilgrimage to sacred fords! / Therefore speak, O best of sages, so that I may undertake the pilgrimage.” 5

14.5.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
bahudharmamayo rājannarbudaḥ parvatottamaḥ ..
aśakto vistarādvaktumapi varṣaśatairapi .. 6 ..
14.5.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
बहुधर्ममयो राजन्नर्बुदः पर्वतोत्तमः ..
अशक्तो विस्तराद्वक्तुमपि वर्षशतैरपि .. 6 ..
14.5.m: Pulastya said: / “O king, Arbuda, the best of mountains, abounds in many religious duties. / It is impossible to speak [of it] in full even in hundreds of years. 6

14.5.s:
saṃkṣepādeva vakṣyāmi tīrthamukhyāni te tathā ..
nāgatīrthaṃ tu tatrādyaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām .. 7 ..
14.5.d:
संक्षेपादेव वक्ष्यामि तीर्थमुख्यानि ते तथा ..
नागतीर्थं तु तत्राद्यं सर्वकामप्रदं नृणाम् .. 7 ..
14.5.m: I shall declare to you concisely the principal sacred fords there. / The first among them is Nāgatīrtha, which grants all desires to human beings, 7

14.5.s:
nārīṇāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa putrasaubhāgyadāyakam ..
śṛṇu rājanpurāvṛttaṃ yato'tyāścaryamuttamam.. 8 ..
14.5.d:
नारीणां च विशेषेण पुत्रसौभाग्यदायकम् ..
शृणु राजन्पुरावृत्तं यतोऽत्याश्चर्यमुत्तमम्.. 8 ..
14.5.m: and especially bestows sons and good fortune upon women. / Listen, O king, to an ancient event that is most extraordinary and excellent. 8

14.5.s:
gautamī brāhmaṇī nāmnā satī sādhvī pativratā ..
bālavaidhavyasaṃprāptā tīrthayātrāparāyaṇā .. 9 ..
14.5.d:
गौतमी ब्राह्मणी नाम्ना सती साध्वी पतिव्रता ..
बालवैधव्यसंप्राप्ता तीर्थयात्रापरायणा .. 9 ..
14.5.m: A brahmin woman named Gautamī, chaste, virtuous, devoted to her husband, / attained widowhood in her childhood and became devoted to pilgrimage to sacred fords. 9

14.5.s:
arbudaṃ sā ca saṃprāptā nāgatīrthaṃ viveśa ha ..
tasmiñjale nimagnā sā snātumabhyāyayau purā .. 7.3.5.10 ..
14.5.d:
अर्बुदं सा च संप्राप्ता नागतीर्थं विवेश ह ..
तस्मिञ्जले निमग्ना सा स्नातुमभ्याययौ पुरा .. 7.3.5.10 ..
14.5.m: She arrived at Arbuda and entered Nāgatīrtha. / Submerged in that water, she came there long ago to bathe. 10

14.5.s:
nāyakā putrasaṃyuktā tattīrthaṃ samupāgatā ..
śuśrūṣāṃ sā tastasyāścakre nānāvidhāṃ nṛpa .. 11 ..
14.5.d:
नायका पुत्रसंयुक्ता तत्तीर्थं समुपागता ..
शुश्रूषां सा तस्तस्याश्चक्रे नानाविधां नृप .. 11 ..
14.5.m: A woman accompanied by her son arrived at that sacred ford. / She performed various kinds of service for her [mother], O king, 11

14.5.s:
sarvopakaraṇairdarbhaiḥ sumanobhiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ..
atha sā ciṃtayāmāsa gautamī putraduḥkhitā .. 12 ..
14.5.d:
सर्वोपकरणैर्दर्भैः सुमनोभिः पृथग्विधैः ..
अथ सा चिंतयामास गौतमी पुत्रदुःखिता .. 12 ..
14.5.m: with all the requisites, darbha grass, and various kinds of flowers. / Then that Gautamī, grieved for want of a son, thought: 12

14.5.s:
dhanyo'yaṃ tanayo hyasyāḥ śuśrūṣāṃ kurute sadā ..
putrayuktā tviyaṃ dhanyā dhigahaṃ putravarjitā .. 13 ..
14.5.d:
धन्योऽयं तनयो ह्यस्याः शुश्रूषां कुरुते सदा ..
पुत्रयुक्ता त्वियं धन्या धिगहं पुत्रवर्जिता .. 13 ..
14.5.m: ‘Blessed is this son of hers, who always renders service [to her]! / Truly she is blessed, having a son; fie upon me, who am devoid of a son! 13

14.5.s:
ahaṃ bhartrā viyuktā ca putrahīnā suduḥkhitā ..
atha sā nirgatā tasmātsalilānnṛpasattama ..14..
14.5.d:
अहं भर्त्रा वियुक्ता च पुत्रहीना सुदुःखिता ..
अथ सा निर्गता तस्मात्सलिलान्नृपसत्तम ..14..
14.5.m: Separated from my husband, devoid of a son, I am sorely afflicted.’ / Then she emerged from that water, O best of kings. 14

14.5.s:
vinā'pi bhartṛsaṃyogātsadyo garbhavatī hyabhūt ..
sā garbhalakṣaṇairyuktā sujanavrīḍayā'nvitā .. 15 ..
14.5.d:
विनाऽपि भर्तृसंयोगात्सद्यो गर्भवती ह्यभूत् ..
सा गर्भलक्षणैर्युक्ता सुजनव्रीडयाऽन्विता .. 15 ..
14.5.m: Even without union with a husband, she immediately became pregnant. / Endowed with the signs of pregnancy, she was filled with shame before virtuous people. 15

14.5.s: cakāra maraṇe buddhiṃ jvālayāmāsa pāvakam .. etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī .. 16 ..
14.5.d: चकार मरणे बुद्धिं ज्वालयामास पावकम् .. एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु वागुवाचाशरीरिणी .. 16 ..
14.5.m: She resolved upon death and kindled a fire. / Just at that time, an incorporeal voice spoke: 16

14.5.s:
.. vāguvāca .. ..
no tvaṃ gautami cityāgnau praveśaṃ kartumarhasi ..
doṣo nāsti tavātrārthe tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ .. 17 ..
14.5.d:
.. वागुवाच .. ..
नो त्वं गौतमि चित्याग्नौ प्रवेशं कर्तुमर्हसि ..
दोषो नास्ति तवात्रार्थे तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावतः .. 17 ..
14.5.m: The voice said: / “O Gautamī, you should not enter the fire of the funeral pyre! / There is no fault in you in this matter, by the power of this sacred ford. 17

14.5.s:
yo yadvāṃchati citte ca jalamadhye sthito naraḥ ..
cintitaṃ ca tadāpnoti nārī vā nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 18 ..
14.5.d:
यो यद्वांछति चित्ते च जलमध्ये स्थितो नरः ..
चिन्तितं च तदाप्नोति नारी वा नात्र संशयः .. 18 ..
14.5.m: Whatever a man desires in his mind while standing in the water, / or a woman, that desired thing they obtain; there is no doubt about this. 18

14.5.s:
tvayā tasyāḥ sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā putravāṃchā kṛtā hṛdi ..
tava garbhagato nūnaṃ putraḥ putri bhaviṣyati .. 19 ..
14.5.d:
त्वया तस्याः सुतं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रवांछा कृता हृदि ..
तव गर्भगतो नूनं पुत्रः पुत्रि भविष्यति .. 19 ..
14.5.m: Having seen her son, a longing for a son was formed by you in your heart. / Surely a son has entered your womb, O daughter, and he shall be born. 19

14.5.s:
tasmādvirama bhadraṃ te nirdoṣāsi pativrate ..
virarāma tataḥ sādhvī gautamī maraṇānnṛpa .. 7.3.5.20 ..
14.5.d:
तस्माद्विरम भद्रं ते निर्दोषासि पतिव्रते ..
विरराम ततः साध्वी गौतमी मरणान्नृप .. 7.3.5.20 ..
14.5.m: Therefore desist, may good fortune be yours; you are free of fault, O devoted wife!” / Thereupon the virtuous Gautamī desisted from death, O king. 20

14.5.s:
śrutvā''kāśagatāṃ vāṇīṃ devadūtena bhāṣitām ..
dṛṣṭvā patiṃ vinā garbhaṃ vākyameta duvāca ha .. 21 ..
14.5.d:
श्रुत्वा'ऽकाशगतां वाणीं देवदूतेन भाषिताम् ..
दृष्ट्वा पतिं विना गर्भं वाक्यमेत दुवाच ह .. 21 ..
14.5.m: Having heard the voice in the sky spoken by a divine messenger, / and seeing the pregnancy without a husband, she spoke this word: 21

14.5.s:
aho tīrthaprabhāvo'yamapūrvaḥ pratibhāti me ..
yatra saṃjāyate garbhaḥ strīṇāṃ śukrarajovinā .. 22 ..
14.5.d:
अहो तीर्थप्रभावोऽयमपूर्वः प्रतिभाति मे ..
यत्र संजायते गर्भः स्त्रीणां शुक्ररजोविना .. 22 ..
14.5.m: ‘Ah, the power of this sacred ford appears extraordinary to me, / where pregnancy occurs in women without semen and menstrual blood! 22

14.5.s:
nāhaṃ kutrāpi yāsyāmi muktvedaṃ tīrthamuttamam ..
evamuktvā tataḥ sādhvī tatraiva nyavasatsadā ..23..
14.5.d:
नाहं कुत्रापि यास्यामि मुक्त्वेदं तीर्थमुत्तमम् ..
एवमुक्त्वा ततः साध्वी तत्रैव न्यवसत्सदा ..23..
14.5.m: I shall not go anywhere leaving behind this excellent sacred ford.’ / Having spoken thus, the virtuous woman lived right there forever.” 23

14.5.s:
putraṃ vai janayāmāsa sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam ..
tatra pārthivaśārdūla kṛṣṇapakṣe 'śvinasya ca ..24..
14.5.d:
पुत्रं वै जनयामास सर्वलक्षणलक्षितम् ..
तत्र पार्थिवशार्दूल कृष्णपक्षे ऽश्विनस्य च ..24..
14.5.m: She indeed gave birth to a son endowed with all auspicious marks. / There, O tiger among kings, during the dark fortnight of the month of Āśvina,

14.5.s:
yaḥ punaḥ kurute śrāddhaṃ tasya vaṃśo na naśyati ..
na preto jāyate rājanvaṃśe tasya kadācana ..25..
14.5.d:
यः पुनः कुरुते श्राद्धं तस्य वंशो न नश्यति ..
न प्रेतो जायते राजन्वंशे तस्य कदाचन ..25..
14.5.m: whoever performs a śrāddha, his lineage does not perish; / no ghost is ever born in his family, O king.

14.5.s:
yaḥ pumānkāmarahitaḥ snānaṃ tatra samācaret..
śrāddhaṃ ca pārthivaśreṣṭha tasya lokāḥ sanātanāḥ ..26..
14.5.d:
यः पुमान्कामरहितः स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत्..
श्राद्धं च पार्थिवश्रेष्ठ तस्य लोकाः सनातनाः ..26..
14.5.m: A man who, devoid of desire, takes a ritual bath there / and performs a śrāddha, O best among kings, his realms are eternal.

14.5.s:
yā strī puṣpaphalānyeva tīrthe cāsminvisarjayet ..
sā syātputravatī dhanyā saubhāgyaṃ ca prapadyate .. 27 ..
14.5.d:
या स्त्री पुष्पफलान्येव तीर्थे चास्मिन्विसर्जयेत् ..
सा स्यात्पुत्रवती धन्या सौभाग्यं च प्रपद्यते .. 27 ..
14.5.m: A woman who casts flowers and fruits into this sacred ford / becomes blessed, possesses sons, and attains good fortune.

14.5.s:
niṣkāmā svargamāpnoti duṣprāpyaṃ tridaśairapi ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena yātrāṃ tasya samācaret .. 28 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe nāgatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 5 .. ..
14.5.d:
निष्कामा स्वर्गमाप्नोति दुष्प्राप्यं त्रिदशैरपि ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन यात्रां तस्य समाचरेत् .. 28 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे नागतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पंचमोऽध्यायः .. 5 .. ..
14.5.m:
Free from desire, she attains heaven, hard to reach even by the gods. / Therefore, with all effort, one should undertake a pilgrimage to it.
Thus ends the fifth chapter, titled "Description of the Māhātmya of Nāgatīrtha," in the third Arbudakhaṇḍa of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

14.6.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha vasiṣṭhaṃ tapasāṃ nidhim ..
yaṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavaḥ samyakkṛtārthatvamavāpnuyāt .. 1 ..
14.6.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ वसिष्ठं तपसां निधिम् ..
यं दृष्ट्वा मानवः सम्यक्कृतार्थत्वमवाप्नुयात् .. 1 ..
14.6.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go, O best of kings, to Vasiṣṭha, a treasure of austerities, / by seeing whom a person attains complete fulfillment.

14.6.s:
tatrāsti jalasampūrṇaṃ kuṇḍaṃ pāpaharaṃ nṛṇām..
tasminkuṇḍe nṛpaśreṣṭha vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā .. 2 ..
14.6.d:
तत्रास्ति जलसम्पूर्णं कुण्डं पापहरं नृणाम्..
तस्मिन्कुण्डे नृपश्रेष्ठ वसिष्ठेन महात्मना .. 2 ..
14.6.m: There is a pool full of water, which removes sins from mortals. / In that pool, O best of kings, by the noble Vasiṣṭha,

14.6.s:
gomatī ca samānītā tapasā nṛpasattama ..
tatra snāto naraḥ samyakpātakai rvipramucyate ..3..
14.6.d:
गोमती च समानीता तपसा नृपसत्तम ..
तत्र स्नातो नरः सम्यक्पातकै र्विप्रमुच्यते ..3..
14.6.m: the Gomatī was brought down through austerity, O best of kings. / A man who has bathed there is completely freed from sins.

14.6.s:
ṛṣidhānyena yastatra śrāddhaṃ nṛpa samācaret ..
sa pitṛṃstārayetsarvānpakṣayorubhayorapi ..4..
14.6.d:
ऋषिधान्येन यस्तत्र श्राद्धं नृप समाचरेत् ..
स पितृंस्तारयेत्सर्वान्पक्षयोरुभयोरपि ..4..
14.6.m: One who performs a śrāddha there with wild grain, O king, / rescues all his ancestors in both lineages.

14.6.s:
atra gāthā purā gītā nāradena mahātma nā ..
snātvā puṇyodake tatra dṛṣṭvā taṃ munisattamam .. 5 ..
14.6.d:
अत्र गाथा पुरा गीता नारदेन महात्म ना ..
स्नात्वा पुण्योदके तत्र दृष्ट्वा तं मुनिसत्तमम् .. 5 ..
14.6.m: Here a verse was formerly sung by the great-souled Nārada: / 'Having bathed there in the sacred water and having seen that best of sages,

14.6.s:
kiṃ gayāśrāddhadānena kimanyairmakhavistaraiḥ ..
vasiṣṭhasyāśramaṃ prāpya yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ ..
sa pitṝṃstārayetsarvānātmanā nṛpasattama .. 6 ..
14.6.d:
किं गयाश्राद्धदानेन किमन्यैर्मखविस्तरैः ..
वसिष्ठस्याश्रमं प्राप्य यः श्राद्धं कुरुते नरः ..
स पितॄंस्तारयेत्सर्वानात्मना नृपसत्तम .. 6 ..
14.6.m: what is the use of offering a śrāddha at Gayā? What is the use of other elaborate sacrifices? / A man who, having reached Vasiṣṭha's hermitage, performs a śrāddha, / rescues all his ancestors along with himself, O best of kings.'

14.6.s:
tatraivāruṃdhatī sādhvī vasiṣṭhasya samīpataḥ ..
pūjanīyā viśeṣeṇa sarvakāmapradā nṛṇām .. 7 ..
14.6.d:
तत्रैवारुंधती साध्वी वसिष्ठस्य समीपतः ..
पूजनीया विशेषेण सर्वकामप्रदा नृणाम् .. 7 ..
14.6.m: Right there, near Vasiṣṭha, the virtuous Arundhatī / is to be especially worshipped; she grants all desires to mortals.

14.6.s:
bālye vayasi yatpāpaṃ vārddhake yauvane'pi vā ..
vasiṣṭhadarśanātsadyo narāṇāṃ yāti saṃkṣayam ..8..
14.6.d:
बाल्ये वयसि यत्पापं वार्द्धके यौवनेऽपि वा ..
वसिष्ठदर्शनात्सद्यो नराणां याति संक्षयम् ..8..
14.6.m: Whatever sin was committed in childhood, in old age, or in youth, / instantly perishes for men upon the darśana of Vasiṣṭha.

14.6.s:
dīpaṃ prayacchate yastu vasiṣṭhāgre samāhitaḥ ..
sukhasaubhāgyasaṃyuktastejasvī jāyate naraḥ .. 9 ..
14.6.d:
दीपं प्रयच्छते यस्तु वसिष्ठाग्रे समाहितः ..
सुखसौभाग्यसंयुक्तस्तेजस्वी जायते नरः .. 9 ..
14.6.m: One who with concentrated mind offers a lamp in front of Vasiṣṭha / becomes endowed with happiness and good fortune, full of splendor.

14.6.s:
upavāsaparo yastu tatraikā rajanīṃ nayet ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra saptarṣayo'malāḥ .. 7.3.6.10 ..
14.6.d:
उपवासपरो यस्तु तत्रैका रजनीं नयेत् ..
स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र सप्तर्षयोऽमलाः .. 7.3.6.10 ..
14.6.m: One devoted to fasting who spends a single night there / goes to the supreme abode where the immaculate Seven Seers dwell.

14.6.s:
trirātriṃ kurute yastu vasiṣṭhāgre samāhitaḥ ..
sa yāti ca maharlokaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ .. 11 ..
14.6.d:
त्रिरात्रिं कुरुते यस्तु वसिष्ठाग्रे समाहितः ..
स याति च महर्लोकं जरामरणवर्जितः .. 11 ..
14.6.m: One who, with concentrated mind, undertakes a three-night fast in front of Vasiṣṭha / goes to Maharloka, free from old age and death.

14.6.s:
yastu māsopavāsaṃ ca vasiṣṭhāgre karoti ca ..
so'pi muktimavāpnoti na yāti sa bhavārṇavam.. 12..
14.6.d:
यस्तु मासोपवासं च वसिष्ठाग्रे करोति च ..
सोऽपि मुक्तिमवाप्नोति न याति स भवार्णवम्.. 12..
14.6.m: And one who performs a month-long fast in front of Vasiṣṭha, / he also attains liberation and does not go to the ocean of mundane existence.

14.6.s:
śrāvaṇasya site pakṣe paurṇamāsyāṃ samāhitaḥ..
ṛṣiṃ tarpayate yastu brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati..13..
14.6.d:
श्रावणस्य सिते पक्षे पौर्णमास्यां समाहितः..
ऋषिं तर्पयते यस्तु ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति..13..
14.6.m: One who, with concentrated mind, offers libations to the seer / on the full moon day of the bright fortnight of Śrāvaṇa, goes to the world of Brahmā.

14.6.s:
vasiṣṭhasyāgrato yastu gāyatryaṣṭaśataṃ japet..
ājanmamaraṇātpāpātsadyo mucyeta mānavaḥ.. 14..
14.6.d:
वसिष्ठस्याग्रतो यस्तु गायत्र्यष्टशतं जपेत्..
आजन्ममरणात्पापात्सद्यो मुच्येत मानवः.. 14..
14.6.m: One who recites the Gāyatrī a hundred and eight times before Vasiṣṭha / is instantly freed from sin from birth unto death.

14.6.s:
vāmadevaṃ yajettatra yadi śraddhāsamanvitaḥ..
agniṣṭomaphalaṃ rājansadyaḥ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 15 ..
14.6.d:
वामदेवं यजेत्तत्र यदि श्रद्धासमन्वितः..
अग्निष्टोमफलं राजन्सद्यः प्राप्नोति मानवः .. 15 ..
14.6.m: If one worships Vāmadeva there with faith, / a person instantly attains the fruit of an Agniṣṭoma sacrifice, O king.

14.6.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena draṣṭavyo'sau mahāmuniḥ ..
śucibhiḥ śraddhayā yuktāste yāsyaṃti paraṃ padam .. 16 ..
14.6.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन द्रष्टव्योऽसौ महामुनिः ..
शुचिभिः श्रद्धया युक्तास्ते यास्यंति परं पदम् .. 16 ..
14.6.m: Therefore, that great sage should be seen with every effort. / Endowed with faith and purified, they will go to the supreme state.

14.6.s:
tasmātsarvātmanā rājanvāmadevaṃ ca pūjayet.. 17 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe vasiṣṭhāśramamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ .. 6 ..
14.6.d:
तस्मात्सर्वात्मना राजन्वामदेवं च पूजयेत्.. 17 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडे वसिष्ठाश्रममाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षष्ठोऽध्यायः .. 6 ..
14.6.m:
Therefore, with all one's heart, O king, one should worship Vāmadeva.
Thus ends the sixth chapter, titled "Description of the Māhātmya of Vasiṣṭha's Hermitage," in the third Arbudakhaṇḍa of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

14.7.s:
pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha supuṇyamacaleśvaram ..
yaṃ dṛṣṭvā siddhimāpnoti naraḥ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ .. 1 ..
14.7.d:
पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ सुपुण्यमचलेश्वरम् ..
यं दृष्ट्वा सिद्धिमाप्नोति नरः श्रद्धासमन्वितः .. 1 ..
14.7.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go, O best of kings, to the most sacred Acaleśvara, / by seeing whom a person endowed with faith attains perfection.

14.7.s:
tatra kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ ..
āśvine phālgune vāpi sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 2 ..
14.7.d:
तत्र कृष्णचतुर्दश्यां यः श्राद्धं कुरुते नरः ..
आश्विने फाल्गुने वापि स याति परमां गतिम् .. 2 ..
14.7.m: A man who performs a śrāddha there on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, / either in Āśvina or in Phālguna, attains the supreme destination.

14.7.s:
yastu pūjayate bhaktyā dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāsthitaḥ ..
puṣpaiḥ patraiḥ phalaiścaiva so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 3 ..
14.7.d:
यस्तु पूजयते भक्त्या दक्षिणां दिशमास्थितः ..
पुष्पैः पत्रैः फलैश्चैव सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 3 ..
14.7.m: One who worships with devotion while facing the southern direction, / with flowers, leaves, and fruits, obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice.

14.7.s:
paṃcāmṛtena yastatra tarpaṇaṃ kuru te naraḥ ..
so'pi devasya sāṃnidhyaṃ śivalokamavāpnuyāt .. 4 ..
14.7.d:
पंचामृतेन यस्तत्र तर्पणं कुरु ते नरः ..
सोऽपि देवस्य सांनिध्यं शिवलोकमवाप्नुयात् .. 4 ..
14.7.m: A man who performs a propitiation there with the five nectars, / he too attains presence with the god and the realm of Śiva.

14.7.s:
pradakṣiṇāṃte yastasya praṇāmaṃ kurute naraḥ ..
naśyaṃti sarvapāpāni pradakṣiṇapadepade .. 5 ..
14.7.d:
प्रदक्षिणांते यस्तस्य प्रणामं कुरुते नरः ..
नश्यंति सर्वपापानि प्रदक्षिणपदेपदे .. 5 ..
14.7.m: A man who bows down to him at the end of circumambulation— / all his sins are destroyed with every step of the circumambulation.

14.7.s:
tatrāścaryamabhūtpūrvaṃ tattvaṃ śṛṇu mahāmate ..
mayā pūrvaṃ śrutaṃ svarge nāradācchakrasannidhau .. 6 ..
14.7.d:
तत्राश्चर्यमभूत्पूर्वं तत्त्वं शृणु महामते ..
मया पूर्वं श्रुतं स्वर्गे नारदाच्छक्रसन्निधौ .. 6 ..
14.7.m: A wonder occurred there in the past; hear it in truth, O wise one, / as it was previously heard by me in heaven from Nārada, in the presence of Śakra.

14.7.s:
tatra pūrvaṃ śuko nīḍaṃ vṛkṣe caivākaroddvijaḥ ..
gatāgatena nīḍasya kurute taṃ pradakṣiṇām.. 7 ..
14.7.d:
तत्र पूर्वं शुको नीडं वृक्षे चैवाकरोद्द्विजः ..
गतागतेन नीडस्य कुरुते तं प्रदक्षिणाम्.. 7 ..
14.7.m: In ancient times a parrot, a bird, built a nest there in a tree. / By going and coming from the nest, he performed circumambulation around him.

14.7.s:
na ca bhaktyā mahārāja pakṣiyonisamudbhavaḥ ..
athāsau mṛtyumāpannaḥ kālena mahatā śukaḥ .. 8 ..
14.7.d:
न च भक्त्या महाराज पक्षियोनिसमुद्भवः ..
अथासौ मृत्युमापन्नः कालेन महता शुकः .. 8 ..
14.7.m: It was not out of devotion, O great king, since he was born from the womb of a bird. / Then, after a long time, that parrot met his death.

14.7.s:
saṃjātaḥ pārthive vaṃśe rājā veṇuriti smṛtaḥ ..
jātismaro mahārāja sarvaśatrunikṛntanaḥ .. 9 ..
14.7.d:
संजातः पार्थिवे वंशे राजा वेणुरिति स्मृतः ..
जातिस्मरो महाराज सर्वशत्रुनिकृन्तनः .. 9 ..
14.7.m: He was born in a royal lineage as a king known as Veṇu, / remembering his previous births, O great king, a destroyer of all enemies.

14.7.s:
sa taṃ smṛtvā prabhāvaṃ hi pradakṣiṇāsamudbhavam ..
acaleśvaramāsādya pradakṣiṇāmathākarot .. 7.3.7.10 ..
14.7.d:
स तं स्मृत्वा प्रभावं हि प्रदक्षिणासमुद्भवम् ..
अचलेश्वरमासाद्य प्रदक्षिणामथाकरोत् .. 7.3.7.10 ..
14.7.m: Remembering indeed the power arising from circumambulation, / he approached Acaleśvara and then performed circumambulation.

14.7.s:
naktaṃ dinaṃ mahārāja nānyatkiṃcitkaroti saḥ ..
na tathā tapase yatno na naivedye kathaṃcana .. 11 ..
14.7.d:
नक्तं दिनं महाराज नान्यत्किंचित्करोति सः ..
न तथा तपसे यत्नो न नैवेद्ये कथंचन .. 11 ..
14.7.m: Day and night, O great king, he did nothing else at all; / he made no effort for austerity in that way, nor for food offerings by any means,

14.7.s:
na puṣpe dhūpadāne ca pradakṣiṇāparaḥ sadā ..
kenacittvatha kālena munayo'tra samāgatāḥ .. 12 ..
14.7.d:
न पुष्पे धूपदाने च प्रदक्षिणापरः सदा ..
केनचित्त्वथ कालेन मुनयोऽत्र समागताः .. 12 ..
14.7.m: nor for flowers and the offering of incense; he was always devoted solely to circumambulation. / Then, after some time, sages arrived there:

14.7.s:
nāradaḥ śaunakaścaiva hārīto devalastathā ..
gālavaḥ kapilo naṃdaḥ suhotraḥ kaśyapo nṛpaḥ .. 13 ..
14.7.d:
नारदः शौनकश्चैव हारीतो देवलस्तथा ..
गालवः कपिलो नंदः सुहोत्रः कश्यपो नृपः .. 13 ..
14.7.m: Nārada, Śaunaka, Hārīta, Devala, / Gālava, Kapila, Nanda, Suhotra, and the king Kaśyapa.

14.7.s:
ete cānye ca bahavo devavrataparāyaṇāḥ ..
kecitsnānaṃ kārayaṃti tasya liṃgasya bhaktitaḥ .. 14 ..
14.7.d:
एते चान्ये च बहवो देवव्रतपरायणाः ..
केचित्स्नानं कारयंति तस्य लिंगस्य भक्तितः .. 14 ..
14.7.m: These and many others devoted to divine vows [arrived]. / Some performed the ablution of that liṅga with devotion;

14.7.s:
anye ca vividhāṃ pūjāṃ japamanye samāhitāḥ ..
eke nṛtyaṃti rājeṃdra gāyaṃti ca tathā pare .. 15 ..
14.7.d:
अन्ये च विविधां पूजां जपमन्ये समाहिताः ..
एके नृत्यंति राजेंद्र गायंति च तथा परे .. 15 ..
14.7.m: others performed various kinds of worship; others, concentrated, recited prayers; / some danced, O lord of kings, and others likewise sang;

14.7.s:
balimanye prayacchaṃti stutiṃ kurvaṃti cāpare ..
athāścaryaṃ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā pradakṣiṇāparaṃ nṛpam .. 16 ..
14.7.d:
बलिमन्ये प्रयच्छंति स्तुतिं कुर्वंति चापरे ..
अथाश्चर्यं परं दृष्ट्वा प्रदक्षिणापरं नृपम् .. 16 ..
14.7.m: others offered oblations, and others offered hymns of praise. / Then, seeing the extraordinary wonder of the king devoted to circumambulation,

14.7.s:
paraṃ kautukamāpannā vākyametadathābruvan ..
pradakṣiṇāsamudbhūtaṃ kāraṇaṃ jñātumicchavaḥ .. 17 .. ..
14.7.d:
परं कौतुकमापन्ना वाक्यमेतदथाब्रुवन् ..
प्रदक्षिणासमुद्भूतं कारणं ज्ञातुमिच्छवः .. 17 .. ..
14.7.m: struck with extreme curiosity, they spoke this word, / wishing to know the reason born of circumambulation.

14.7.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kasmāttvaṃ pārthivaśreṣṭha pradakṣiṇāparaḥ sadā ..
devasyāsya viśeṣeṇa satyaṃ no vaktumarhasi .. 18 ..
14.7.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
कस्मात्त्वं पार्थिवश्रेष्ठ प्रदक्षिणापरः सदा ..
देवस्यास्य विशेषेण सत्यं नो वक्तुमर्हसि .. 18 ..
14.7.m: The seers said: / Why, O best of kings, are you constantly devoted to circumambulation / of this god especially? You ought to tell us the truth.

14.7.s:
na dadāsi jalaṃ liṃge prabhūtaṃ sumanoharam ..
puṣpadhūpādikaṃ vātha stotrāṇi vividhāni ca .. 19 ..
14.7.d:
न ददासि जलं लिंगे प्रभूतं सुमनोहरम् ..
पुष्पधूपादिकं वाथ स्तोत्राणि विविधानि च .. 19 ..
14.7.m: You do not offer abundant, captivating water on the liṅga, / nor flowers, incense, and the like, nor various hymns of praise.

14.7.s:
samartho'si tathānyeṣāṃ dānānāṃ tvaṃ mahīpate ..
etannaḥ kautukaṃ sarvaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi .. 7.3.7.20 ..
14.7.d:
समर्थोऽसि तथान्येषां दानानां त्वं महीपते ..
एतन्नः कौतुकं सर्वं यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि .. 7.3.7.20 ..
14.7.m: "You are capable of other gifts as well, O lord of the earth. / You ought to tell us truly the reason for this whole wonder."

14.7.s:
.. veṇuruvāca .. ..
yadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śrūyatāṃ dvijasattamāḥ ..
pūrvadehāṃtare vṛttaṃ sarvaṃ satyaṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 21 ..
14.7.d:
.. वेणुरुवाच .. ..
यदहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि श्रूयतां द्विजसत्तमाः ..
पूर्वदेहांतरे वृत्तं सर्वं सत्यं विशेषतः .. 21 ..
14.7.m: Veṇu said: / "Listen, O best among the twice-born, to what I shall declare: / what occurred in a previous body, all entirely true.

14.7.s:
prāsāde'sminpurā pakṣī śuko'haṃ sthitavāṃstadā ..
kṛtavāṃśca tadā devaṃ pradakṣiṇāmaharniśam ..22..
14.7.d:
प्रासादेऽस्मिन्पुरा पक्षी शुकोऽहं स्थितवांस्तदा ..
कृतवांश्च तदा देवं प्रदक्षिणामहर्निशम् ..22..
14.7.m: "Formerly, in this temple, I lived as a bird, a parrot; / and then I performed circumambulation around the deity day and night.

14.7.s:
kṛpayā'sya prabhāvācca jāto jātismarastvaham ..
adhunā parayā bhaktyā yatkaromi pradakṣiṇām .. 23 ..
14.7.d:
कृपयाऽस्य प्रभावाच्च जातो जातिस्मरस्त्वहम् ..
अधुना परया भक्त्या यत्करोमि प्रदक्षिणाम् .. 23 ..
14.7.m: "By his grace and by the power thereof, I was born with memory of past lives; / that I now perform circumambulation with supreme devotion—

14.7.s:
na jāne kiṃ phalaṃ me'dya devasyāsya prasādataḥ ..
etasmātkāraṇāccāhaṃ nānyatkiṃcitkaromi bhoḥ .. 24 .. ..
14.7.d:
न जाने किं फलं मेऽद्य देवस्यास्य प्रसादतः ..
एतस्मात्कारणाच्चाहं नान्यत्किंचित्करोमि भोः .. 24 .. ..
14.7.m: "I know not what fruit awaits me today through the favor of this god. / For this reason, O sirs, I do nothing else."

14.7.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
veṇuvākyaṃ tataḥ śrutvā munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ ..
vismayotphullanayanāḥ sādhusādhviti cābruvan .. 25 ..
14.7.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
वेणुवाक्यं ततः श्रुत्वा मुनयः शंसितव्रताः ..
विस्मयोत्फुल्लनयनाः साधुसाध्विति चाब्रुवन् .. 25 ..
14.7.m: Pulastya said: / Then, having heard the words of Veṇu, the sages of celebrated vows, / their eyes wide with wonder, said, "Well done! Well done!"

14.7.s:
tataḥ pradakṣiṇa parāḥ sarve tatra maharṣayaḥ ..
babhūvurmunayaḥ sarve śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ .. 26 ..
14.7.d:
ततः प्रदक्षिण पराः सर्वे तत्र महर्षयः ..
बभूवुर्मुनयः सर्वे श्रद्धया परया युताः .. 26 ..
14.7.m: Then all the great seers there became devoted to circumambulation; / all the sages were filled with supreme faith.

14.7.s:
so'pi rājā mahābhāgo veṇuḥ śaṃbhoḥ prasādataḥ ..
śāśvataṃ sthānamāpanno durllabhaṃ tridaśairapi .. 27 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe'caleśvaraprabhāvavarṇanaṃnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 7 ..
14.7.d:
सोऽपि राजा महाभागो वेणुः शंभोः प्रसादतः ..
शाश्वतं स्थानमापन्नो दुर्ल्लभं त्रिदशैरपि .. 27 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडेऽचलेश्वरप्रभाववर्णनंनाम सप्तमोऽध्यायः .. 7 ..
14.7.m:
And that noble king, Veṇu, by the favor of Śambhu, / attained the eternal abode, difficult to attain even for the gods.
Thus ends the seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Power of Acaleśvara', in the third [part], the Arbudakhaṇḍa, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

14.8.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha bhadrakarṇaṃ mahāhradam ..
trinetrābhāḥ śilā yatra dṛśyaṃte'dyāpi bhūriśaḥ ..1..
14.8.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ भद्रकर्णं महाह्रदम् ..
त्रिनेत्राभाः शिला यत्र दृश्यंतेऽद्यापि भूरिशः ..1..
14.8.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go, O best of kings, to the great pool Bhadrakarṇa, / where stones resembling the Three-eyed One are still seen in abundance today.

14.8.s:
tasyaiva paścime bhāge liṃgamasti pinākinaḥ ..
yaṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavastatra trinetrasadṛśo bhavet .. 2 ..
14.8.d:
तस्यैव पश्चिमे भागे लिंगमस्ति पिनाकिनः ..
यं दृष्ट्वा मानवस्तत्र त्रिनेत्रसदृशो भवेत् .. 2 ..
14.8.m: On the western side of that very pool is the liṅga of the Wielder of the Pināka, / seeing which a mortal there becomes equal to the Three-eyed One.

14.8.s:
bhadrakarṇagaṇonāma purāsīcchivavallabhaḥ ..
tenātra sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ hradaścaiva vinirmitaḥ .. 3 ..
14.8.d:
भद्रकर्णगणोनाम पुरासीच्छिववल्लभः ..
तेनात्र स्थापितं लिंगं ह्रदश्चैव विनिर्मितः .. 3 ..
14.8.m: Formerly there was an attendant named Bhadrakarṇa, dear to Śiva; / by him this liṅga was installed here, and the pool was also fashioned.

14.8.s:
kenacittvatha kālena saṃgrāme dānavaiḥ saha ..
yuyudhe purataḥ śaṃbhornānāgaṇasamanvitaḥ .. 4 ..
14.8.d:
केनचित्त्वथ कालेन संग्रामे दानवैः सह ..
युयुधे पुरतः शंभोर्नानागणसमन्वितः .. 4 ..
14.8.m: Then, after some time, in a battle with the dānavas, / accompanied by various attendants, he fought before Śambhu.

14.8.s:
naṣṭe skaṃde hate sainye vīrabhadre parājite ..
gatāste bhayasaṃtrastā mahākāle vinirjite .. 5 ..
14.8.d:
नष्टे स्कंदे हते सैन्ये वीरभद्रे पराजिते ..
गतास्ते भयसंत्रस्ता महाकाले विनिर्जिते .. 5 ..
14.8.m: When Skanda had fled, the army was slain, Vīrabhadra was defeated, / and Mahākāla was conquered, they fled, terrified with fear.

14.8.s:
balavānnamucirnāma dānavo balavattaraḥ ..
khaḍgacarmadharaḥ śīghraṃ maheśvaramupādravat .. 6 ..
14.8.d:
बलवान्नमुचिर्नाम दानवो बलवत्तरः ..
खड्गचर्मधरः शीघ्रं महेश्वरमुपाद्रवत् .. 6 ..
14.8.m: A mighty dānava named Namuci, exceedingly strong, / bearing a sword and shield, swiftly rushed upon Maheśvara.

14.8.s:
bhadrakarṇastu taṃ dṛṣṭvā dānavaṃ tadanaṃtaram ..
pataṃtaṃ saṃmukhastasya tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cābravīt .. 7 ..
14.8.d:
भद्रकर्णस्तु तं दृष्ट्वा दानवं तदनंतरम् ..
पतंतं संमुखस्तस्य तिष्ठतिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् .. 7 ..
14.8.m: Then Bhadrakarṇa, seeing that dānava / charging right before him, said, "Halt! Halt!"

14.8.s:
chittvā'simasinā tasya carma cāpi mahābalaḥ ..
stanayoraṃtare daityaṃ kopāviṣṭo'hanannṛpa .. 8 ..
14.8.d:
छित्त्वाऽसिमसिना तस्य चर्म चापि महाबलः ..
स्तनयोरंतरे दैत्यं कोपाविष्टोऽहनन्नृप .. 8 ..
14.8.m: Having cut through his sword and also his shield with a sword, the mighty one, / overcome with wrath, struck the daitya between his breasts, O king.

14.8.s:
athāsau nihatastena praviśya vipulaṃ tamaḥ ..
nipapāta mahīpṛṣṭhe vāyubhagna iva drumaḥ ..
vadhaṃ prāptastu daityo'sau natvā haramasau sthitaḥ ..
satye sthitaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ .. 7.3.8.10 ..
14.8.d:
अथासौ निहतस्तेन प्रविश्य विपुलं तमः ..
निपपात महीपृष्ठे वायुभग्न इव द्रुमः ..
वधं प्राप्तस्तु दैत्योऽसौ नत्वा हरमसौ स्थितः ..
सत्ये स्थितं च तं दृष्ट्वा ततस्तुष्टो महेश्वरः .. 7.3.8.10 ..
14.8.m: Then he, struck down by him, entering into vast darkness, / fell upon the surface of the earth like a tree broken by the wind. / Having met his death, that daitya bowed to Hara and stood; / and seeing him abiding in truth, Maheśvara was pleased.

14.8.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
tava vīryeṇa saṃtuṣṭo dharmeṇa ca viśeṣataḥ ..
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te nityaṃ yo hṛdaye sthitaḥ .. 11 ..
14.8.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
तव वीर्येण संतुष्टो धर्मेण च विशेषतः ..
वरं वरय भद्रं ते नित्यं यो हृदये स्थितः .. 11 ..
14.8.m: The Blessed Lord said: / "I am pleased with your valor and especially with your righteousness. / Choose a boon—blessing be upon you—which has ever dwelt in your heart."

14.8.s:
.. bhadrakarṇaṃ uvāca .. ..
yanmayā sthāpitaṃ liṃgamarbude surasattama ..
atrāstu tava sāṃnidhyaṃ hrade'smiṃśca sthiro bhava .. 12 ..
14.8.d:
.. भद्रकर्णं उवाच .. ..
यन्मया स्थापितं लिंगमर्बुदे सुरसत्तम ..
अत्रास्तु तव सांनिध्यं ह्रदेऽस्मिंश्च स्थिरो भव .. 12 ..
14.8.m: Bhadrakarṇa said: / "The liṅga which was installed by me on Arbuda, O best of gods— / let there be your presence here, and be steadfast in this pool."

14.8.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
māghamāse caturddaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe sadā mama ..
sāṃnidhyaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa hrade liṃge bhaviṣyati .. 13 ..
14.8.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
माघमासे चतुर्द्दश्यां कृष्णपक्षे सदा मम ..
सांनिध्यं च विशेषेण ह्रदे लिंगे भविष्यति .. 13 ..
14.8.m: The Blessed Lord said: / "In the month of Māgha, on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, / my special presence will always be in the pool and in the liṅga.

14.8.s:
bhadrakarṇahrade snātvā trinetraṃ yaḥ samāhitaḥ ..
drakṣyate sa tu me sthānaṃ śāśvataṃ yāsyati dhuvam .. 14 ..
14.8.d:
भद्रकर्णह्रदे स्नात्वा त्रिनेत्रं यः समाहितः ..
द्रक्ष्यते स तु मे स्थानं शाश्वतं यास्यति धुवम् .. 14 ..
14.8.m: He who, having bathed in the pool of Bhadrakarṇa, focused in mind, / sees the Three-eyed One, will surely attain my eternal abode.

14.8.s:
tasmātsarvatra yatnena snānaṃ tatra samācaret ..
pūjayitvā ca talliṃgaṃ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati .. 15 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe bhadrakarṇahradatrinetramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 8 ..
14.8.d:
तस्मात्सर्वत्र यत्नेन स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् ..
पूजयित्वा च तल्लिंगं शिवलोकं स गच्छति .. 15 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडे भद्रकर्णह्रदत्रिनेत्रमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टमोऽध्यायः .. 8 ..
14.8.m:
Therefore, by every effort, one should perform a ritual ablution there; / and having worshipped that liṅga, he goes to the world of Śiva."
Thus ends the eighth chapter, named 'Description of the Greatness of the Pool of Bhadrakarṇa and the Three-eyed One', in the third [part], the Arbudakhaṇḍa, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
